title: Synthesis and Magnetism of Silver Chromium Selenide Spinels
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Chalcogenide spinels exhibit electronic and magnetic properties that are tunable through lattice occupancy and composition. Here, we report the first synthesis of spinel-phase Ag2Cr2Se4 and AgCr2Se4 and demonstrate an oxidation-induced ferro-to-ferrimagnetic transition accompanied by a massive increase in TC of >250 K associated with changes in Ag+ site occupancy. The Ag spinels are synthesized through air-free cation exchange of CuCr2Se4 nanocrystals driven by excess AgNO3 to yield ferromagnetic Ag2Cr2Se4 (a = 10.838(4) Å, TC = 152 K, 2 K saturation = 3.1 μB/Cr) with Ag+ occupying both Td 8a and Oh 16c sites. Upon air exposure, Ag2Cr2Se4 converts to ferrimagnetic AgCr2Se4 (a = 10.6085(19) Å, TC > 400 K, 2 K saturation = 2.2 μB/Cr) through a loss of Oh-Ag+ alongside the formation of Ag2Se. We attribute the ferro-to-ferrimagnetic transition to the generation of holes in Ag–Se bands, which couple antiferromagnetically to Cr3+. This Ag–Cr–Se spinel system demonstrates the largest change in TC reported and provides an excellent framework for further exploration of magnetic coupling as a function of oxidation and structure.
title_zh: 银硒化铬尖晶石的合成及磁性
abstract_zh: 摘要 硫族尖晶石具有可通过晶格占据和组成进行调节的电子和磁性特性。在这里，我们报告了尖晶石相 Ag2Cr2Se4 和 AgCr2Se4 的首次合成，并证明了氧化诱导的铁磁到亚铁磁转变，伴随着与 Ag+ 位点占用变化相关的 TC 大幅增加 >250 K。 Ag 尖晶石是通过过量 AgNO3 驱动的 CuCr2Se4 纳米晶体的无空气阳离子交换合成的，产生铁磁性 Ag2Cr2Se4（a = 10.838(4) Å，TC = 152 K，2 K 饱和度 = 3.1 μB/Cr），其中 Ag+ 占据 Td 8a 和 Oh 16c 位点。暴露在空气中后，Ag2Cr2Se4 通过失去 Oh-Ag+ 并形成 Ag2Se，转化为亚铁磁性 AgCr2Se4（a = 10.6085(19) Å，TC > 400 K，2 K 饱和度 = 2.2 μB/Cr）。我们将铁磁到亚铁磁的转变归因于 Ag-Se 带中空穴的产生，这些空穴与 Cr3+ 反铁磁耦合。这种 Ag-Cr-Se 尖晶石体系展示了所报道的 TC 的最大变化，并为进一步探索磁耦合作为氧化和结构的函数提供了一个极好的框架。

title: Organic Metal Halogenide Netted Colloidal Quantum Dot Superlattice
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The bottom-up assembly of colloidal quantum dots (CQDs) into superlattice structures is attractive for leveraging nanocrystal quantum features into films and optoelectronic devices. However, current CQD superlattices often require tedious control of the assembly kinetics, and they suffer from either excessively long interfacial distances, which impede carrier transport, or facet fusion, which brings high defect density. These hinder CQD superlattice applications in optoelectronic devices, where low defect density and large carrier diffusion lengths are essential. Herein, inspired by the growth of a two-dimensional (2D) perovskite layer, a class of aromatic organic cation ligands is adopted to stabilize CQDs and induce close and ordered packing of CQDs into a superlattice netted by an organic metal halogenide (QD@OMH), giving rise to a high carrier diffusion length (>250 nm) for lead sulfide (PbS) CQD film. The superlattice-based infrared photodetectors achieve a responsivity of 0.663 A W–1 at 1560 nm and an order-of-magnitude reduction in noise current density, yielding a detectivity exceeding 1013 Jones. Furthermore, the infrared light-emitting diodes achieve a high radiance (22.4 W sr–1 m–2) and an operational T90 lifetime exceeding 200 h under continuous operation at peak luminance.
title_zh: 有机金属卤化物网状胶体量子点超晶格
abstract_zh: 摘要：将胶体量子点（CQD）自下而上组装成超晶格结构对于将纳米晶体量子特征应用于薄膜和光电器件具有吸引力。然而，当前的CQD超晶格通常需要对组装动力学进行繁琐的控制，并且它们要么界面距离过长（阻碍载流子传输），要么面临面融合（带来高缺陷密度）。这些阻碍了 CQD 超晶格在光电器件中的应用，在光电器件中，低缺陷密度和大载流子扩散长度至关重要。在此，受二维（2D）钙钛矿层生长的启发，采用一类芳香族有机阳离子配体来稳定CQD，并诱导CQD紧密有序地堆积到由有机金属卤化物（QD@OMH）组成的超晶格中，从而使硫化铅（PbS）CQD薄膜具有高载流子扩散长度（> 250 nm）。基于超晶格的红外光电探测器在 1560 nm 处实现了 0.663 A W–1 的响应度，并且噪声电流密度降低了一个数量级，从而产生超过 1013 Jones 的探测率。此外，红外发光二极管具有高辐射率（22.4 W sr–1 m–2），在峰值亮度下连续工作时，T90 寿命超过 200 小时。

title: Scalable Synthesis of Robust Polyimide Covalent Organic Framework Cathodes for High-Capacity and Durable Aqueous Zn-Ion Batteries
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Aqueous Zn-ion batteries are promising due to their high safety, low cost, and environmental friendliness, but developing cathode materials with high capacity, excellent rate capability, and long cycle life remains challenging. Herein, we design and construct a series of highly crystalline, stable, and porous polyimide covalent organic frameworks (COFs) featuring large conjugated aromatic structures and dense multiple active groups, making them ideal cathodes for Zn-ion batteries. The resulting COF cathodes deliver a high reversible capacity of 320 mAh/g at 0.1 A/g (energy density 240 Wh/kg), excellent rate capability (55% retention at 100 A/g), and exceptional durability (98% capacity retention after 50,000 cycles at 10 A/g), placing them among the best reported COF-based cathodes. A combination of in situ/ex-situ characterizations and DFT calculations reveals the behavior and mechanism of charge storage in detail. Benefiting from gram-scale flux synthesis, we assemble large-sized functional COF-based pouch batteries that achieve a reversible capacity of 300 mAh/g at 0.1 A/g (total capacity 0.6 Ah, approaching theoretical design), along with outstanding rate capability and long-term stability. This work paves a new avenue for designing multifunctional COFs toward high-performance, long-life aqueous Zn-ion batteries.
title_zh: 用于高容量和耐用水性锌离子电池的鲁棒聚酰亚胺共价有机框架阴极的可扩展合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 水系锌离子电池由于其高安全性、低成本和环境友好而具有广阔的前景，但开发高容量、优异的倍率性能和长循环寿命的正极材料仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们设计并构建了一系列高结晶、稳定、多孔的聚酰亚胺共价有机骨架（COF），具有大的共轭芳香族结构和密集的多个活性基团，使其成为锌离子电池的理想正极。由此产生的 COF 正极在 0.1 A/g 电流下具有 320 mAh/g 的高可逆容量（能量密度 240 Wh/kg）、出色的倍率性能（在 100 A/g 电流下保持 55% 的容量）和出色的耐用性（在 10 A/g 电流下经过 50,000 次循环后容量保持率为 98%），使它们跻身报道最好的 COF 基正极之列。原位/异位表征和 DFT 计算相结合，详细揭示了电荷存储的行为和机制。受益于克级通量合成，我们组装了大尺寸功能性COF软包电池，在0.1 A/g电流下可实现300 mAh/g的可逆容量（总容量0.6 Ah，接近理论设计），并具有出色的倍率性能和长期稳定性。这项工作为设计多功能COF以实现高性能、长寿命的水性锌离子电池铺平了一条新途径。

title: Reversible Local Coordination Relaxation of Lattice-Embedded Rh Single Sites Enables Efficient and Durable Propene Hydroformylation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Efficient atomically dispersed Rh catalysts for propene hydroformylation require active sites that combine coordination flexibility during turnover with resistance to leaching and aggregation. Here we report Rh1@ZnO, in which Rh single sites are incorporated into cation vacancies in the ZnO lattice to couple coordination adaptability with lattice confinement. In propene hydroformylation, Rh1@ZnO affords C4 aldehydes with 100% chemoselectivity at a turnover frequency of 1.6 × 105 h–1 and reaches a cumulative turnover number of 2.2 × 105 while showing robust stability, outperforming surface-bound Rh1/ZnO and a homogeneous Rh benchmark. Kinetic analysis shows that Rh1@ZnO remains in a CO-inhibited regime but shifts the rate-controlling region toward steps involving H2. DFT calculations reveal that the embedded Rh site undergoes reversible local coordination relaxation, whereby CO coordination relaxes specific Rh–O lattice constraints and relieves local geometric strain during CO insertion, lowering the acylation barrier. Following C–C bond formation, the Rh site relaxes back to restore Rh–O lattice anchoring. These results establish lattice embedding coupled with reversible local coordination relaxation as a design principle for adaptive yet persistent Rh single sites in heterogeneous hydroformylation.
title_zh: 晶格嵌入的 Rh 单位点的可逆局部配位弛豫可实现高效且持久的丙烯氢甲酰化
abstract_zh: 摘要 用于丙烯加氢甲酰化的高效原子分散 Rh 催化剂需要将周转过程中的配位灵活性与抗浸出和聚集性结合起来的活性位点。在这里，我们报道了Rh1@ZnO，其中Rh单位点被纳入ZnO晶格中的阳离子空位中，以将配位适应性与晶格限制结合起来。在丙烯氢甲酰化中，Rh1@ZnO 以 1.6 × 105 h–1 的周转频率提供具有 100% 化学选择性的 C4 醛，并达到 2.2 × 105 的累积周转数，同时表现出强大的稳定性，优于表面结合的 Rh1/ZnO 和均匀的 Rh 基准。动力学分析表明，Rh1@ZnO 仍处于 CO 抑制状态，但将速率控制区域转向涉及 H2 的步骤。 DFT 计算表明，嵌入的 Rh 位点经历可逆的局部配位弛豫，从而 CO 配位放松了特定的 Rh-O 晶格约束，并减轻了 CO 插入过程中的局部几何应变，从而降低了酰化势垒。 C-C 键形成后，Rh 位点松弛恢复 Rh-O 晶格锚定。这些结果将晶格嵌入与可逆局部配位弛豫相结合，作为异质氢甲酰化中自适应且持久的 Rh 单位点的设计原则。

title: Photon-Induced Modulation of Reaction Pathways in Ruthenium Homologous Heteroclusters with a Ruδ+-Ru0 Interface for Photothermal Dry Reforming of Methane
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Photothermal dry reforming of methane (PDRM) is a promising technology for mitigating greenhouse gas (CH4 and CO2) emissions and generating syngas under mild conditions. However, it faces challenges from the catalyst deactivation because of carbon deposition and unbalanced H2/CO ratio caused by side reactions such as reverse water–gas shift (RWGS). In this work, Ru subnanometric homologous clusters are anchored onto TiO2 to address these issues. The metallic Ru0 and oxidized Ruδ+ sites with suitable proximity are created, while the carbon layers serve as the migration channels for photon-induced electrons to Ru clusters in PDRM. This configuration enables Ruδ+ to activate CH4 while electron-enriched Ru0 sites activate CO2, facilitating direct C–O coupling of *CHx and *CO2 intermediates and reducing the reliance on lattice oxygen (OL) migration and replenishment. Consequently, the optimized catalyst delivers superior activity for H2 (416.9 mmol·g–1·h–1) and CO (344.0 mmol·g–1·h–1) production with high conversion rates of CH4 (∼60%) and CO2 (∼51%) at 540 °C. The improved H2/CO ratio and negligible deactivation in long-term stability tests are simultaneously achieved, outperforming those from thermal catalysis at the same temperature. This work provides critical insight into photon-induced reaction pathway modulation for efficient PDRM.
title_zh: 具有 Ruδ+-Ru0 界面的钌同系异质团簇中用于甲烷光热干重整的反应路径的光子诱导调制
abstract_zh: 摘要 甲烷光热干重整（PDRM）是一种在温和条件下减少温室气体（CH4 和 CO2）排放并产生合成气的有前途的技术。然而，它面临着由于积碳导致催化剂失活以及逆水煤气变换（RWGS）等副反应引起的H2/CO比例不平衡等挑战。在这项工作中，Ru 亚纳米同源簇被锚定在 TiO2 上来解决这些问题。金属 Ru0 和氧化 Ruδ+ 位点具有适当的接近度，而碳层则充当光子诱导电子向 PDRM 中 Ru 簇的迁移通道。这种配置使 Ruδ+ 能够激活 CH4，而富电子的 Ru0 位点激活 CO2，促进 *CHx 和 *CO2 中间体的直接 C-O 偶联，并减少对晶格氧 (OL) 迁移和补充的依赖。因此，优化后的催化剂在 540 °C 下具有优异的 H2 (416.9 mmol·g–1·h–1) 和 CO (344.0 mmol·g–1·h–1) 生产活性，并且 CH4 (∼60%) 和 CO2 (∼51%) 的转化率较高。同时实现了改进的 H2/CO 比和长期稳定性测试中可忽略不计的失活，优于相同温度下的热催化。这项工作为高效 PDRM 的光子诱导反应途径调节提供了重要的见解。

title: GDP-Loaded K-Ras Transiently Binds to Effector B-Raf RBD, Mirroring the Structure of the Active GTP-Loaded Complex
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The Ras-Raf protein association initiates the downstream mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling cascade. This interaction depends on the Ras-nucleotide ligand, whereby Raf preferentially binds to the active guanosine triphosphate (GTP)-loaded state over the guanosine diphosphate (GDP)-loaded state of Ras. Whether GDP-bound Ras can also form specific protein–protein interactions with Raf, however, remains unclear. Here, we characterize the interaction between human K-Ras in both nucleotide states and the Ras-binding domain (RBD) of B-Raf by solution NMR. Active K-Ras·GTP forms a tight, conformationally restricted complex with RBD, causing pronounced chemical shift perturbations at the binding interface consistent with existing cryo-EM and X-ray crystallography structures. Surprisingly, we detect specific binding between “inactive” wild-type K-Ras·GDP with RBD in the millimolar affinity range, whereby the oncogenic G12D mutant of K-Ras further strengthens this interaction. NMR relaxation dispersion and chemical exchange saturation transfer (CEST) experiments allow the detailed structural characterization of the transient K-Ras·GDP·RBD complex, along with the determination of the interaction affinity and kinetics. The results demonstrate that the transient K-Ras·GDP·RBD bound state closely resembles the active K-Ras·GTP·RBD complex, providing a quantitative understanding at the backbone 15N-level of the nucleotide-specific K-Ras-Raf interaction. These findings underscore the prospect of the highly adaptable GDP-bound state of K-Ras for both signaling and as a drug target.
title_zh: GDP 负载的 K-Ras 瞬时与效应器 B-Raf RBD 结合，反映了活性 GTP 负载复合物的结构
abstract_zh: 摘要 Ras-Raf 蛋白关联启动下游丝裂原激活蛋白激酶 (MAPK) 信号级联。这种相互作用取决于 Ras-核苷酸配体，因此 Raf 优先与 Ras 的活性三磷酸鸟苷 (GTP) 负载状态结合，而不是与二磷酸鸟苷 (GDP) 负载状态结合。然而，GDP 结合的 Ras 是否也可以与 Raf 形成特定的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过溶液 NMR 表征了两种核苷酸状态下的人类 K-Ras 与 B-Raf 的 Ras 结合域 (RBD) 之间的相互作用。活性 K-Ras·GTP 与 RBD 形成紧密的构象限制复合物，在结合界面处引起明显的化学位移扰动，与现有的冷冻电镜和 X 射线晶体学结构一致。令人惊讶的是，我们检测到“无活性”野生型 K-Ras·GDP 与 RBD 在毫摩尔亲和力范围内的特异性结合，从而 K-Ras 的致癌 G12D 突变体进一步增强了这种相互作用。 NMR 弛豫色散和化学交换饱和转移 (CEST) 实验可以对瞬态 K-Ras·GDP·RBD 复合物进行详细的结构表征，并确定相互作用亲和力和动力学。结果表明，瞬时 K-Ras·GDP·RBD 结合态与活性 K-Ras·GTP·RBD 复合物非常相似，提供了对核苷酸特异性 K-Ras-Raf 相互作用的主链 15N 水平的定量理解。这些发现强调了 K-Ras 高度适应性的 GDP 结合状态对于信号传导和作为信号传导的前景。

title: Catalyst-Free Thiol–yne Nucleophilic Photoclick Chemistry
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract X-yne nucleophilic addition reactions are essential and powerful tools in a range of synthetic routes for realizing functional and stimuli-responsive materials. Unfortunately, the lack of spatiotemporal control and the requirement for catalyst addition in these reactions limit their full potential in synthetic and materials-based applications, including in light-driven 3D printing. Herein, we close this critical gap and exploit a spirothiopyran (STP) photoswitch as a synthon for photoinduced and catalyst-free thiol–yne click reactions, an important class of X-yne click chemistries. We further employ our photoswitch-based entity for rapid and facile postpolymerization modification as well as photopolymerization under very mild and aerobic conditions.
title_zh: 无催化剂硫醇-炔亲核光点击化学
abstract_zh: 摘要 X-yne 亲核加成反应是实现功能性和刺激响应材料的一系列合成路线中必不可少且强大的工具。不幸的是，这些反应中缺乏时空控制以及需要添加催化剂限制了它们在合成和基于材料的应用中的全部潜力，包括光驱动的 3D 打印。在这里，我们弥补了这一关键差距，并利用螺噻喃（STP）光开关作为光诱导和无催化剂的硫醇-炔点击反应的合成子，这是一类重要的X-yne点击化学。我们进一步利用基于光开关的实体进行快速、简便的后聚合改性以及在非常温和和有氧条件下的光聚合。

title: Decoupling Ion Transport from Water Flow in Rigid Subnanometer Channels for Efficient Osmotic Energy Harvesting
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Conventional ion separation membranes employed for osmotic energy harvesting rely on nano- or subnanoscale channels that inherently facilitate the transport of hydrated ions, a mechanism that couples ion transport with parasitic solvent flow and fundamentally limits on energy conversion performance. Here, we break this paradigm by constructing continuous NASICON-type Li1.5Al0.5Ge1.5(PO4)3 membranes featuring rigid naked-ion transport channels. At this subnanometer scale, the channels no longer accommodate hydrated ions but enforce complete dehydration, enabling a naked-ion conduction mechanism. This shift eliminates the hydration shell, yielding two transformative outcomes: first, enabling near-ideal Li+ selectivity (transference number t+ ≈ 0.99) via unscreened electrostatic interactions and precise steric exclusion; second, completely decoupling ion transport from water permeation, eradicating the primary source of energy dissipation and achieving 488.6 W·m–2 osmotic energy generation under 200-fold Li+ concentration gradient. Remarkably, this design uniquely leverages impurity counterions in complex brines, boosting the power density over 56-fold to 517 W·m–2 under the 10-fold Li+ concentration gradients. This work establishes naked-ion transport as a foundational and paradigm-shifting design principle for next-generation ion-exchange membranes, opening new avenues for high-efficiency osmotic energy conversion and beyond.
title_zh: 在刚性亚纳米通道中将离子传输与水流解耦，以实现高效的渗透能量收集
abstract_zh: 摘要 用于渗透能量收集的传统离子分离膜依赖于本质上促进水合离子传输的纳米或亚纳米级通道，这是一种将离子传输与寄生溶剂流耦合的机制，并从根本上限制了能量转换性能。在这里，我们通过构建具有刚性裸离子传输通道的连续 NASICON 型 Li1.5Al0.5Ge1.5(PO4)3 膜打破了这种范式。在这种亚纳米尺度上，通道不再容纳水合离子，而是强制完全脱水，从而实现裸离子传导机制。这种转变消除了水化壳，产生了两个变革性的结果：首先，通过未屏蔽的静电相互作用和精确的空间排斥，实现近乎理想的 Li+ 选择性（转移数 t+ ≈ 0.99）；其次，将离子传输与水渗透完全解耦，消除了能量耗散的主要来源，并在200倍Li+浓度梯度下实现了488.6 W·m–2渗透能的产生。值得注意的是，该设计独特地利用了复杂盐水中的杂质抗衡离子，在 10 倍的 Li+ 浓度梯度下将功率密度提高了 56 倍以上，达到 517 W·m–2。这项工作将裸离子传输确立为下一代离子交换膜的基础和范式转换设计原则，为高效渗透能转换等开辟了新途径。

title: Metallic Ag-BiAg Heterostructured Dendrites Accelerate Carbon–Nitrogen Coupling for Air Plasma-Derived Amino Acid Electrosynthesis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Electrochemical C–N coupling driven by renewable electricity provides a sustainable strategy for amino acid synthesis, yet achieving high catalytic efficiency still remains challenging. Herein, a metallic Ag-BiAg heterostructured dendritic electrode is developed by a simple electrodeposition strategy for efficient amino acid electrosynthesis. The optimized catalyst achieves a high glycine Faradaic efficiency of 80.72%, accompanied by a yield rate of 993.3 μmol h–1 cm–2 at −0.9 V vs RHE, outperforming previously reported catalysts. Operando spectroscopic investigations combined with theoretical calculations reveal that the metallic Ag-BiAg heterointerface synergistically optimizes the electronic structure and adsorption behavior of key reaction intermediates, thereby accelerating the generation of the crucial *NH2OH intermediate, enhancing the activation and hydrogenation of glyoxylic acid oxime, and promoting the overall C–N coupling kinetics toward highly selective glycine electrosynthesis. Remarkably, an energy-efficient paired electrosynthesis system integrated with air plasma-derived feedstocks was further constructed, achieving high-performance glycine and formate coproduction over a broad voltage range of 1.2–1.6 V, together with promising long-term stability over 120 h. This work provides a sustainable strategy for air plasma-to-amino acid electrosynthesis through the rational interfacial engineering of dual-site catalytic systems.
title_zh: 金属Ag-BiAg异质结构枝晶加速空气等离子体衍生氨基酸电合成的碳氮耦合
abstract_zh: 摘要：由可再生电力驱动的电化学 C-N 耦合为氨基酸合成提供了一种可持续的策略，但实现高催化效率仍然具有挑战性。在此，通过简单的电沉积策略开发了金属Ag-BiAg异质结构树突电极，用于有效的氨基酸电合成。优化后的催化剂实现了高达 80.72% 的甘氨酸法拉第效率，在 -0.9 V vs RHE 下的产率为 993.3 μmol h–1 cm–2，优于之前报道的催化剂。操作光谱研究结合理论计算表明，金属Ag-BiAg异质界面协同优化关键反应中间体的电子结构和吸附行为，从而加速关键*NH2OH中间体的生成，增强乙醛酸肟的活化和氢化，并促进整体C-N耦合动力学向高选择性甘氨酸电合成发展。值得注意的是，进一步构建了与空气等离子体衍生原料集成的节能配对电合成系统，在 1.2-1.6 V 的宽电压范围内实现了高性能甘氨酸和甲酸联产，并有望在 120 小时内保持长期稳定性。这项工作通过双位点催化系统的合理界面工程，为空气等离子体到氨基酸的电合成提供了一种可持续的策略。

title: Structure and Dynamics of the HIV-1 Envelope Protein on the Virion Envelope
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract HIV-1 buds from infected cells as immature virion particles with a scattered envelope glycoprotein (Env) distribution on their envelope. It then undergoes maturation, during which the viral protease cleaves the Gag polyprotein at multiple sites, leading to structural reorganization of the viral particle and lateral redistribution of Env proteins, ultimately rendering the virion infectious. However, the underlying mechanism of maturation-induced Env reorganization remains elusive. In this study, we combine microsecond-long all-atom (AA) and bottom-up coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics simulations and diffusion model-based backmapping to investigate the structural organization and key interactions of Env in viral membranes. AA simulations of fully glycosylated Env embedded in HIV-1 mimetic asymmetric bilayers were first performed to characterize its conformational dynamics and Env–lipid interactions. We then developed a bottom-up CG model of glycosylated Env from the AA data and simulated the mature HIV-1 virion envelope containing multiple Env proteins. The CG simulations predict that Env proteins form clusters through interactions mediated by the cytoplasmic tail domain and adopt diverse tilted conformations within these clusters. These CG simulations were then backmapped to AA resolution, and further AA simulations were carried out to identify, in detail, the specific interacting residues in the Env clusters. Additionally, analysis of epitope accessibility shows that broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) targeting the V1/V2 and V3 loops may efficiently interact with Env clusters on the mature virion surface. Together, these results provide a molecular mechanism for Env oligomerization during viral maturation and offer new insights into the accessibility of bnAb epitopes on Env clusters.
title_zh: 病毒体包膜上 HIV-1 包膜蛋白的结构和动力学
abstract_zh: 摘要来自受感染细胞的 HIV-1 芽是未成熟的病毒粒子，其包膜上分布有分散的包膜糖蛋白 (Env)。然后它经历成熟，在此期间病毒蛋白酶在多个位点裂解 Gag 多蛋白，导致病毒颗粒的结构重组和 Env 蛋白的横向重新分布，最终使病毒粒子具有感染性。然而，成熟诱导的环境重组的潜在机制仍然难以捉摸。在这项研究中，我们结合微秒长的全原子（AA）和自下而上的粗粒度（CG）分子动力学模拟和基于扩散模型的反向映射来研究病毒膜中Env的结构组织和关键相互作用。首先对嵌入 HIV-1 模拟不对称双层中的完全糖基化的 Env 进行 AA 模拟，以表征其构象动力学和 Env-脂质相互作用。然后，我们根据 AA 数据开发了一个自下而上的糖基化 Env CG 模型，并模拟了包含多个 Env 蛋白的成熟 HIV-1 病毒体包膜。 CG 模拟预测 Env 蛋白通过细胞质尾部结构域介导的相互作用形成簇，并在这些簇内采用不同的倾斜构象。然后将这些 CG 模拟反向映射到 AA 分辨率，并进行进一步的 AA 模拟以详细识别 Env 簇中的特定相互作用残基。此外，表位可及性分析表明，针对 V1/V2 和 V3 环的广泛中和抗体 (bnAb) 可以有效地介导

title: Cofactor-Free Tau Filaments Are Dynamic and Undergo Structural Evolution Driven by Thermodynamic Control
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Tau filaments are a hallmark of neurodegenerative tauopathies, such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Structural studies have revealed that patient-derived tau fibrils adopt distinct folds in different tauopathies; however, it is unclear what forces guide this process. To explore this question, we investigated the assembly of a tau fragment containing four disease-associated phospho-mimetics (termed Tau(297–407)-4D) in vitro. Under cofactor-free and quiescent conditions, Tau(297–407)-4D forms fibrils with a core structure that partially resembles the AD fold after about 7 days. Strikingly, we noticed that this filament behaves as a hydrogel and evolves into two new polymorphs as it ages over the next 35 days. Thus, tau fibrils formed under cofactor-free conditions are dynamic, exhibiting substantial nonequilibrium behavior. To probe what types of perturbations might stabilize these structures, we applied mechanical agitation, which drove the filaments toward thermodynamic equilibrium in a mechanism consistent with Ostwald ripening into solid-phase, micrometer-sized particles. Likewise, the addition of polyanionic cofactors to preformed Tau(297–407)-4D fibrils significantly stabilized them, as judged by solubility equilibria and chemical denaturation experiments. A subset of the polyanions also remodeled the fibril structure and tuned the extent of fibril–fibril interactions (i.e., “clumping”). We conclude that environmental factors, such as mechanical stress and/or polyanions, play an important role in promoting the thermodynamic stability of otherwise dynamic tau fibrils. We speculate that, in patients, such factors might contribute to the maturation of disease-specific conformers.
title_zh: 无辅因子的 Tau 丝是动态的，并经历热力学控制驱动的结构进化
abstract_zh: 摘要 Tau 丝是神经退行性 tau 病的标志，例如阿尔茨海默病 (AD)。结构研究表明，患者来源的 tau 原纤维在不同的 tau 病中采用不同的折叠方式。然而，尚不清楚是什么力量引导这一过程。为了探索这个问题，我们研究了包含四种疾病相关磷酸模拟物（称为 Tau(297–407)-4D）的 tau 片段的体外组装。在无辅因子和静止条件下，大约 7 天后，Tau(297–407)-4D 形成具有部分类似于 AD 折叠的核心结构的原纤维。引人注目的是，我们注意到这种细丝表现为水凝胶，并随着其在接下来的 35 天的老化而演变成两种新的多晶型物。因此，在无辅因子条件下形成的 tau 原纤维是动态的，表现出显着的非平衡行为。为了探究哪些类型的扰动可以稳定这些结构，我们应用机械搅拌，以与奥斯特瓦尔德成熟为固相微米尺寸颗粒一致的机制驱动细丝达到热力学平衡。同样，根据溶解度平衡和化学变性实验判断，向预先形成的 Tau(297–407)-4D 原纤维中添加聚阴离子辅助因子可显着稳定它们。聚阴离子的一个子集还重塑了原纤维结构并调整了原纤维与原纤维相互作用的程度（即“结块”）。我们得出的结论是，环境因素，例如机械应力和/或聚阴离子，在促进动态 tau 纤维的热力学稳定性方面发挥着重要作用。

title: Interfacial Lithium Redox Kinetics Regulated by Solvent Asymmetry and Moment of Inertia in Li Metal Batteries
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) offer high energy density, but interfacial charge-transfer kinetics remain a bottleneck for high-rate operation. In this work, we construct a library of 12 ether solvents with systematic variations in symmetry and fluorination, confirming that molecular asymmetry is an important feature that results in enhanced Li+ redox kinetics and more stable solid electrolyte interphases on Li0. Furthermore, we developed a mechanistic understanding of the underlying process. We show that more tilted dipoles and lower moments of inertia strongly correlate with higher exchange current densities. Among the solvents in our study, the asymmetric F5MPE (1-methoxy-2-(2,2,3,3,3-pentafluoropropoxy) ethane) molecule, a previously unreported solvent molecule, enabled >170 stable cycles in high-rate Li||NMC full cells, outperforming the previously reported best single-salt-single-solvent ether solvent, F5DEE molecule. Overall, this work links molecular-level information with the behavior at electrochemical interfaces and provides an understanding of molecular design considerations for next-generation electrolytes tailored for high-power, fast-charging LMBs.
title_zh: 锂金属电池中溶剂不对称性和转动惯量调控的界面锂氧化还原动力学
abstract_zh: 摘要 锂金属电池（LMB）具有高能量密度，但界面电荷转移动力学仍然是高速率运行的瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个由 12 种醚溶剂组成的库，这些溶剂在对称性和氟化方面具有系统的变化，证实分子不对称性是一个重要特征，可以增强 Li+ 氧化还原动力学，并在 Li0 上形成更稳定的固体电解质界面。此外，我们对基本过程有了机械的理解。我们表明，更多的倾斜偶极子和更低的惯性矩与更高的交换电流密度密切相关。在我们研究的溶剂中，不对称 F5MPE（1-甲氧基-2-（2,2,3,3,3-五氟丙氧基）乙烷）分子是一种先前未报道的溶剂分子，可在高倍率 Li||NMC 全电池中实现 >170 个稳定循环，优于先前报道的最佳单盐单溶剂醚溶剂 F5DEE 分子。总体而言，这项工作将分子级信息与电化学界面的行为联系起来，并提供了对专为高功率、快速充电 LMB 定制的下一代电解质的分子设计考虑因素的理解。

abstract_zh: 氢键在铵离子电池中发挥着双刃作用，促进离子传输和灵活存储，同时引起不稳定性。这些相互作用的合理调节对于实现高绩效至关重要。

title: Insights into the Life Cycle and Therapeutic Agents for Monkeypox Virus Infection
source: Chemical Reviews: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Since the first confirmed case in 1970, the monkeypox virus (MPXV) has emerged as a significant threat to global public health. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on two occasions. Despite decades of research, only tecovirimat has been approved by the European Medicines Agency (EMA) for the treatment of MPXV infection. The genome and structure are similar between MPXV and other orthopoxviruses (OPXVs), suggesting that the strategies used for other OPXVs may be applicable to MPXV. This review systematically summarizes the genome, structure, and critical stages in the life cycle of OPXVs, especially MPXV. A variety of antiviral agents against MPXV and other OPXVs are discussed according to their distinct mechanisms of action: 1) blocking viral entry and fusion, 2) inhibiting DNA replication and processing, 3) disrupting transcription and mRNA processing, 4) preventing virion assembly, maturation and release, 5) modulating immune responses, and 6) mechanism unknown. Overall, this article provides a systematic review of current research progress on potential therapeutic targets and agent for MPXV, aiming to offer innovative insights and strategies for the development of effective therapeutic agents against mpox.
title_zh: 深入了解猴痘病毒感染的生命周期和治疗药物
abstract_zh: 摘要 自 1970 年出现第一例确诊病例以来，猴痘病毒（MPXV）已成为对全球公共卫生的重大威胁。世界卫生组织（WHO）曾两次宣布其为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件（PHEIC）。尽管经过数十年的研究，只有替科维马已获得欧洲药品管理局 (EMA) 批准用于治疗 MPXV 感染。 MPXV 和其他正痘病毒 (OPXV) 的基因组和结构相似，表明用于其他 OPXV 的策略可能适用于 MPXV。这篇综述系统地总结了OPXV，特别是MPXV的基因组、结构和生命周期的关键阶段。根据其不同的作用机制讨论了多种针对 MPXV 和其他 OPXV 的抗病毒药物：1) 阻止病毒进入和融合，2) 抑制 DNA 复制和加工，3) 破坏转录和 mRNA 加工，4) 防止病毒粒子组装、成熟和释放，5) 调节免疫反应，6) 机制未知。总体而言，本文对当前 MPXV 潜在治疗靶点和药物的研究进展进行了系统综述，旨在为开发有效的 MPXV 治疗药物提供创新见解和策略。

title: Ingestible Hydrogel-Encapsulated Optogenetic Yeast Controlled by Wearable Electronics Enables Programmable IL-10 Delivery for Inflammatory Bowel Disease Therapy
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Engineered yeast-living drugs offer significant potential for oral protein therapy but remain limited by poor intestinal retention and lack of precise spatiotemporal control over therapeutic delivery. Here, we developed an ingestible hydrogel-encapsulated optogenetic yeast system controlled by a wearable electronic device for programmable interleukin-10 (IL-10) delivery in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). We engineered Pichia pastoris with an EL222-based blue-light-inducible circuit achieving rapid, stringent IL-10 secretion (50% saturated concentration within just 1 h upon induction). The yeast was encapsulated in a photo-crosslinkable HAMA hydrogel that was gelated within 60 s upon blue-light exposure, exhibiting robust mechanical stability and tissue adhesion. A lightweight (2.27 g) wearable Bluetooth-controlled electronic device delivered targeted blue light transdermally, enabling simultaneous in situ hydrogel crosslinking and optogenetic activation in yeast cells. This system significantly extended the time yeast stays in the mouse gut, with reporter gene expression lasting over 5 h, while the unencapsulated control group lasted less than 2 h. In DSS-induced colitis mice, our strategy reduced proinflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α) by >60%, restored intestinal barrier integrity, and normalized gut microbiota diversity to near-healthy levels, which performed significantly better than in other groups. This integrated “extracorporeal instruction−intracorporeal response” paradigm establishes a digitally programmable platform for precision live biotherapeutics. However, limited blue-light tissue penetration remains a key constraint; future work should focus on near-infrared photosensitive systems, programmable-degradation hydrogels, and wireless closed‑loop feedback to advance clinical translation.
title_zh: 由可穿戴电子设备控制的可摄入水凝胶封装的光遗传学酵母可实现可编程 IL-10 递送，用于炎症性肠病治疗
abstract_zh: 摘要 工程酵母活性药物为口服蛋白质治疗提供了巨大的潜力，但仍然受到肠道滞留不良和缺乏对治疗递送的精确时空控制的限制。在这里，我们开发了一种由可穿戴电子设备控制的可摄入水凝胶封装的光遗传学酵母系统，用于在炎症性肠病（IBD）中进行可编程白细胞介素 10（IL-10）输送。我们利用基于 EL222 的蓝光诱导电路对毕赤酵母进行了改造，实现了快速、严格的 IL-10 分泌（诱导后仅 1 小时内即可达到 50% 饱和浓度）。酵母被封装在可光交联的 HAMA 水凝胶中，在蓝光照射下 60 秒内凝胶化，表现出强大的机械稳定性和组织粘附性。一种轻质（2.27 克）可穿戴蓝牙控制电子设备可透皮传输目标蓝光，从而能够在酵母细胞中同时进行原位水凝胶交联和光遗传学激活。该系统显着延长了酵母在小鼠肠道中的停留时间，报告基因表达持续超过 5 小时，而未封装的对照组持续时间不到 2 小时。在 DSS 诱导的结肠炎小鼠中，我们的策略将促炎细胞因子（IL-1β、IL-6 和 TNF-α）减少了 60% 以上，恢复了肠道屏障完整性，并将肠道微生物群多样性正常化到接近健康的水平，其表现明显优于其他组。这种集成的“体外指令-体内反应”范式为精准活体生物建立了数字可编程平台

title: Se4+-Doped Indium-Based Perovskites via NaCl-Driven Structural Transformation for Dynamic Luminescence Modulation in Multimodal Anti-counterfeiting and Encryption
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The growing risks of counterfeiting and information security breaches have spurred the demand for high-security stimuli-responsive optical materials. However, many reported materials exhibit discontinuous luminescence switching or require harsh external stimuli. Herein, we report a facile luminescence modulation strategy for indium-based perovskites by employing Se4+ as an efficient luminescent modulator, which enables continuous color evolution via a mild NaCl-triggered 0D-to-3D phase transition. During this phase transition, the Se4+-doped Cs2InCl5·H2O converts to the Cs2NaInCl6 phase, accompanied by emission color evolution from orange-red to green. This optical evolution stems from the altered local coordination environment of Se4+ dopants, which modulates the formation and emission energy of self-trapped excitons (STEs). For practical applications, the as-prepared functional ink is fabricated into patterned films via screen printing to realize dynamic anti-counterfeiting with tunable emission colors and response kinetics by adjusting NaCl concentration and temperature. Furthermore, a multi-level optical encryption design enables three-stage information readout through sequential stimuli. This work establishes a mild, phase-transition-driven luminescence evolution approach for indium-based perovskites, providing a versatile platform with continuous dynamic color evolution for advanced anti-counterfeiting and information encryption.
title_zh: Se4+ 掺杂铟基钙钛矿通过 NaCl 驱动的结构转变用于多模态防伪和加密中的动态发光调制
abstract_zh: 摘要 日益增长的伪造和信息安全漏洞风险刺激了对高安全性刺激响应光学材料的需求。然而，许多报道的材料表现出不连续的发光切换或需要严酷的外部刺激。在此，我们报告了一种基于铟的钙钛矿的简便发光调制策略，采用 Se4+ 作为有效的发光调制剂，通过温和的 NaCl 触发的 0D 到 3D 相变实现连续颜色演化。在此相变过程中，Se4+ 掺杂的 Cs2InCl5·H2O 转变为 Cs2NaInCl6 相，同时发射颜色从橙红色变为绿色。这种光学演化源于 Se4+ 掺杂剂局部配位环境的改变，它调节自陷激子 (STE) 的形成和发射能量。在实际应用中，通过丝网印刷将所制备的功能墨水制成图案薄膜，通过调节NaCl浓度和温度来实现可调节发射颜色和响应动力学的动态防伪。此外，多级光学加密设计可通过顺序刺激实现三级信息读出。这项工作为铟基钙钛矿建立了一种温和的、相变驱动的发光演化方法，为先进的防伪和信息加密提供了一个具有连续动态颜色演化的多功能平台。

title: Embedded injustice under the developmental state: Taiwan's reflexive governance on just transition
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
abstract: Taiwan has incorporated just transition into net zero governance, but implementation proceeds through institutions shaped by developmental state industrialization. This study examines how labor and environmental movements contributed to legal development and how unresolved legacies shape a just energy transition. It combines thematic and doctrinal legal analysis with a purposive comparison of ten labor and ten environmental cases, including one negative institutional comparator, and six net zero transition cases: the carbon fee, high carbon industrial dependence, worker and regional support, fishery–solar co-location, offshore wind, and geothermal development. Historical cases indicate that protections often strengthened only after collective action exposed occupational, livelihood, pollution, and territorial harms. Reforms expanded rights and administrative review, yet responsibilities remained fragmented, remedies delayed, and red–green relations weakly institutionalized. Similar tensions are visible in net zero policy: carbon fee design affords regulated firms adjustment flexibility without equivalent worker or regional safeguards, while renewable energy siting addresses livelihood and territorial claims mainly through permitting, consultation, and compensation. Because the carbon fee is recent, estimates identify structural exposure rather than observed employment or regional effects. The analysis develops brown economy dependence, the sacrifice system, and hidden and delayed governance as mechanisms through which accumulated harms become normalized in legal categories, administrative routines, and development priorities. Embedded injustice reveals how accumulated harms condition net zero governance, sensitizes just transition policy to these legacies, and supports cautious comparison across sectors and developmental state contexts. Reflexive governance in Taiwan therefore requires earlier coordination and revisable decisions.
title_zh: 发展状态下的内嵌不公正：台湾正义转型的反思性治理

title: Broadly positive, slightly split: How political orientation links to early perceptions of seasonal thermal energy storage
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
abstract: Energy technologies have increasingly become the subject of politicisation, which ultimately impacts their deployment. Existing research has primarily examined polarisation around established or widely debated energy technologies, such as in relation to wind or nuclear energy. Building on this literature and public opinion research, this study investigates to what extent public perceptions of a novel energy storage technology might already be shaped along political lines, even before its widespread deployment or popularity, and its potential politicisation. To do so, it examines the relationship between individuals’ political orientation and perceptions of seasonal thermal energy storage (STES) among Swiss citizens. Drawing on cross-sectional survey data collected in Switzerland (N = 1433), this study assesses how the perceived general importance of STES and its potential to address challenges related to the energy transition, climate change, energy security and energy independence varies by left-right ideology and party alignment. The findings reveal that, while STES is overall positively evaluated across the ideological spectrum and party alignment, differences already exist. These differences are more nuanced regarding general perceived importance and become less significant in terms of perceived potential, once respondents had slightly more engaged with STES throughout the survey. Moreover, the results suggest how the potential for polarisation seems mainly driven by individuals of the right-wing of the ideological and partisan spectrum. Therefore, this study demonstrates that political predispositions appear to inform perceptions of energy technology at an early stage of diffusion, implying that potential grounds for its polarisation are set prior to popularity and politicisation.

title: The fiscal and socioeconomic impact of the energy transition in the transport sector: The case of the Basque Country
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
abstract: This paper analyses the fiscal challenges of the climate-neutral economy transition by 2050 in line with the European Green Deal's goals. It focuses on the regional level and examines the Basque Country, one of the sub-state entities with the greatest fiscal power in the European Union, and aims to quantify the implications of decarbonising the transport sector for public finances. To this end, it applies DERIO, a dynamic econometric New Keynesian Input-Output model, designed to evaluate the economic effects of scenarios and policies at regional level, particularly those related to energy and climate change. Our analysis indicates that transport electrification increases revenues from taxes on production, income, wealth, and corporate profits, as well as social-security contributions. However, it reduces receipts from taxes on products and yields an overall net decline in public revenues. The results highlight the complex, cross-sectoral transmission mechanisms at play during the transition and offer actionable insights for designing revenue-stable fiscal frameworks in the face of large structural changes.
title_zh: 交通运输部门能源转型的财政和社会经济影响：巴斯克地区的案例
abstract_zh: 本文根据欧洲绿色协议的目标，分析了 2050 年气候中和经济转型所面临的财政挑战。它侧重于区域层面，并研究了巴斯克地区（欧盟财政实力最强的次国家实体之一），旨在量化交通部门脱碳对公共财政的影响。为此，它应用了DERIO，一种动态计量经济学新凯恩斯主义投入产出模型，旨在评估区域层面的情景和政策的经济影响，特别是与能源和气候变化相关的情景和政策。我们的分析表明，交通电气化增加了生产税、收入税、财富税、企业利润以及社会保障缴款的收入。然而，它减少了产品税收收入，导致公共收入总体净下降。研究结果凸显了转型期间发挥作用的复杂的跨部门传导机制，并为面对重大结构性变化时设计收入稳定的财政框架提供了可行的见解。

title: Degradation-assisted doping of organic semiconductors enabled by Lewis acids
source: Nature Materials
abstract: The chemical doping of organic semiconductors with molecular dopants is crucial for high-performance organic electronic devices. Chemically stable dopants are commonly used, enabling electron transfer until a thermodynamic equilibrium is reached, which then terminates the doping process. Here we demonstrate that using p-dopants that chemically degrade after electron transfer via their radical anion can increase the hole densities in the semiconductor host by up to two orders of magnitude. In this degradation-assisted doping mechanism, the electron affinity of the doping agent only enables a limited amount of charge transfer. Subsequent dopant degradation effectively removes its products from co-defining the thermodynamic equilibrium and, thus, allows the doping reaction to persist. We demonstrate that the prototypical Lewis acid tris(pentafluorophenyl)borane (B(C6F5)3) exemplifies degradation-assisted doping, and provide the theoretical framework for this doping strategy offering new avenues for optimizing charge carrier densities in organic semiconductors.
title_zh: 路易斯酸实现有机半导体的降解辅助掺杂
abstract_zh: 用分子掺杂剂对有机半导体进行化学掺杂对于高性能有机电子器件至关重要。通常使用化学稳定的掺杂剂，使电子转移直至达到热力学平衡，然后终止掺杂过程。在这里，我们证明，使用在电子转移后通过自由基阴离子发生化学降解的 p 掺杂剂可以将半导体主体中的空穴密度增加多达两个数量级。在这种降解辅助掺杂机制中，掺杂剂的电子亲和力只能实现有限量的电荷转移。随后的掺杂剂降解有效地将其产物从共同定义的热力学平衡中去除，从而使掺杂反应持续存在。我们证明了原型路易斯酸三（五氟苯基）硼烷（B（C6F5）3）是降解辅助掺杂的例证，并为这种掺杂策略提供了理论框架，为优化有机半导体中的载流子密度提供了新途径。

title: Failure Mechanisms and Modification Strategies of Silicon-Carbon and Derivative Anodes for Lithium-Ion Batteries
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) with high energy density, as emerging energy-storage systems, rely on high-capacity electrode to drive the energy transition. Silicon (Si) has been considered as a promising alternative to graphite anodes due to its exceptional theoretical capacity, exhibiting enormous potential to meet the demand for high-energy-density energy storage. However, Si anodes are constrained by substantial volume expansion during lithiation, unstable solid electrolyte interphase (SEI), and poor electrical conductivity. To address these challenges, researchers have integrated the advantages of different materials to develop silicon/carbon (Si@C) composites as LIBs anodes, which offer a unique balance between structural toughness and electrochemical performance. Nevertheless, Si@C materials still face unsatisfactory structural stability, interfacial compatibility, and electrochemical kinetics during electrochemical cycling. Combined with recent research advances, this review summarizes and comparatively analyzes the mainstream preparation methods of Si@C composites. Based on the lithium storage mechanism of silicon, the multi-dimensional failure mechanisms of Si@C anodes are systematically clarified. Focusing on the key bottlenecks, including structural degradation, interfacial instability, inferior intrinsic conductivity, and industrial application limitations, current modification strategies are comprehensively reviewed and critically compared. Furthermore, the cutting-edge development trends of Si@C anodes are prospected, providing systematic theoretical support and technical guidance for future mechanism exploration, process optimization, and large-scale industrial applications.
title_zh: 锂离子电池硅碳及其衍生负极的失效机理及改性策略
abstract_zh: 摘要 高能量密度的锂离子电池（LIB）作为新兴的储能系统，依靠大容量电极来驱动能量转换。硅（Si）因其卓越的理论容量而被认为是石墨阳极的有前途的替代品，在满足高能量密度储能需求方面表现出巨大的潜力。然而，硅阳极受到锂化过程中体积大幅膨胀、不稳定的固体电解质界面（SEI）和较差的导电性的限制。为了应对这些挑战，研究人员综合了不同材料的优点，开发了硅/碳（Si@C）复合材料作为LIB阳极，它在结构韧性和电化学性能之间提供了独特的平衡。然而，Si@C材料在电化学循环过程中的结构稳定性、界面相容性和电化学动力学方面仍然存在不令人满意的问题。本文结合近年来的研究进展，对Si@C复合材料的主流制备方法进行了总结和比较分析。基于硅的储锂机理，系统阐明了Si@C负极的多维失效机制。针对结构退化、界面不稳定性、本征电导率差和工业应用限制等关键瓶颈，对当前的改性策略进行了全面的回顾和批判性的比较。并对Si@C负极的前沿发展趋势进行了展望，提供系统的理论支撑。

title: Strategies for the Integration of Multifunctional Thermal Management Materials: A Review
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The rapid development of high-power electronics, flexible devices, and advanced energy systems has created a growing demand for thermal management materials that combine heat dissipation with additional functions such as electrical insulation, electromagnetic interference shielding, flame retardancy, mechanical compliance, and environmental stability or other application-specific functions. The central challenge in multifunctional thermal management materials (MTMMs) lies not simply in improving thermal conductivity but in integrating thermal management with other required functions within the same material system. From the perspective of functional integration, this review classifies MTMMs as passive or stimuli-responsive. Passive MTMMs rely on material composition, filler design, and structural construction to form heat-conduction pathways while supporting other functions. Stimuli-responsive MTMMs regulate heat transport and associated functional performance through reversible changes induced by electric or magnetic fields, light, or humidity. This classification clarifies the design logic, relationships among integrated functions, and applicability of different MTMM systems. Representative applications, including wearable electronics and battery thermal management, are also discussed to connect material design to practical requirements. Future research directions include recyclable MTMMs, long-term thermomechanical stability, and AI-assisted analysis of structure–function relationships. This review provides a systematic perspective for the development of next-generation thermal management materials.
title_zh: 多功能热管理材料的集成策略：综述
abstract_zh: 摘要 高功率电子、柔性设备和先进能源系统的快速发展对热管理材料的需求不断增长，这些材料将散热与电气绝缘、电磁干扰屏蔽、阻燃、机械合规性和环境稳定性或其他特定应用功能等附加功能结合起来。多功能热管理材料 (MTMM) 的核心挑战不仅在于提高导热性，还在于将热管理与同一材料系统内的其他所需功能集成。从功能整合的角度来看，本综述将 MTMM 分为被动型和刺激响应型。无源 MTMM 依靠材料成分、填料设计和结构构造来形成热传导路径，同时支持其他功能。刺激响应 MTMM 通过电场或磁场、光或湿度引起的可逆变化来调节热传输和相关的功能性能。这种分类阐明了不同MTMM系统的设计逻辑、集成功能之间的关系以及适用性。还讨论了代表性应用，包括可穿戴电子产品和电池热管理，以将材料设计与实际要求联系起来。未来的研究方向包括可回收的 MTMM、长期热机械稳定性以及结构-功能关系的人工智能辅助分析。本综述为下一代的发展提供了系统的视角

title: Giant Electrostrain from Inherent Strain for KNN-Based Ceramics
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Lead-free potassium sodium niobate (KNN)-based piezoelectric ceramics with different sizes sintered in a reducing atmosphere are prepared. By determining the frequency dependence of the unipolar strain, it provides researchers with an effective and convenient method to distinguish between bending deformation and inherent electrostrain. A highly operable strategy to enhance inherent electrostrain by reducing the area of thin samples has been provided. There is a significant dependence between multivalent manganese ions and thickness changes in ceramics. With decreasing thickness from 400 to 200 μm, the Mn2+ ions in A-site vacancies absorb holes due to re-oxidation to become Mn4+ ions, and then, these Mn4+ ions with increased valence states substitute for Nb5+ ions in the B-site to form a defect (Mn′Nb) and increase the defect (V′Na/K) concentration. In this work, giant electrostrain in ceramics (200 μm) without the defect (V′Na/K–VO··) gradient distribution should originate from the inherent strain due to the synergistic effect of dipole defects (Mn′Nb–VO·· and V′Na/K–VO··) and stripe (100 nm) domains. The thin (200 μm) ceramics show a significant inherent electrostrain (1068 pm/V at 15 kV/cm). Our research provides an innovative way of designing high-performance lead-free piezoelectric ceramics sintered in a reducing atmosphere that are promising for low-cost multilayer piezoelectric actuator applications co-fired with base metal nickel electrodes.
title_zh: KNN 基陶瓷的固有应变产生的巨大静电应变
abstract_zh: 摘要 在还原气氛中烧结制备了不同尺寸的无铅铌酸钾钠（KNN）基压电陶瓷。通过确定单极应变的频率依赖性，它为研究人员提供了区分弯曲变形和固有电应变的有效且方便的方法。提供了一种高度可操作的策略，通过减少薄样品的面积来增强固有的静电应变。多价锰离子与陶瓷的厚度变化之间存在显着的依赖性。随着厚度从400μm减小到200μm，A位空位中的Mn2+离子因再氧化而吸收空穴，成为Mn4+离子，然后这些价态升高的Mn4+离子取代B位中的Nb5+离子，形成缺陷（Mn'Nb）并增加缺陷（V'Na/K）浓度。在这项工作中，没有缺陷（V'Na/K–VO··）梯度分布的陶瓷（200μm）中的巨大电应变应该源于偶极子缺陷（Mn'Nb–VO··和V'Na/K–VO··）和条纹（100 nm）域的协同效应所产生的固有应变。薄 (200 μm) 陶瓷表现出显着的固有静电应变（15 kV/cm 时为 1068 pm/V）。我们的研究提供了一种设计在还原气氛中烧结的高性能无铅压电陶瓷的创新方法，该陶瓷有望用于与贱金属镍电极共烧的低成本多层压电执行器应用。

title: Multifunctional Device Design and Applications of GaN and Transition Metal Dichalcogenides Heterojunctions
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract This review comprehensively explores the cutting-edge applications of gallium nitride (GaN) and two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) heterojunctions in next-generation high-performance devices. With a strong focus on practical implementation, we systematically analyze the pivotal roles of GaN/TMDs heterostructures across electronics, optoelectronics, sensing, and energy conversion. Key advancements in high-frequency transistors, low-power neuromorphic computing, broadband photodetectors (UV to NIR), self-powered sensors, and efficient photocatalytic systems are highlighted. The discussion extends to innovative fabrication techniques enabling large-area integration and flexible electronics. Furthermore, we showcase their application potential in strategic fields such as 5G communication, artificial intelligence, imaging systems, environmental monitoring, and clean energy technologies. By addressing critical challenges in interface engineering, material synthesis, and device integration, this review provides a valuable roadmap for developing high-performance, commercially viable semiconductor devices.
title_zh: GaN与过渡金属二硫属化物异质结的多功能器件设计及应用
abstract_zh: 摘要：本文全面探讨了氮化镓（GaN）和二维过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）异质结在下一代高性能器件中的前沿应用。我们重点关注实际实施，系统地分析了 GaN/TMD 异质结构在电子、光电子、传感和能量转换领域的关键作用。重点介绍了高频晶体管、低功耗神经拟态计算、宽带光电探测器（紫外到近红外）、自供电传感器和高效光催化系统的关键进展。讨论延伸到实现大面积集成和柔性电子产品的创新制造技术。此外，我们还展示了它们在5G通信、人工智能、成像系统、环境监测和清洁能源技术等战略领域的应用潜力。通过解决接口工程、材料合成和器件集成方面的关键挑战，这篇综述为开发高性能、商业上可行的半导体器件提供了有价值的路线图。

title: Regulating Triplet Energy Level and Intramolecular Motion: An Aggregation-Induced Emission BODIPY for Near-Infrared Type I Photodynamic/Photothermal Synergistic Therapy
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The combination of photodynamic therapy (PDT) and photothermal therapy (PTT) holds considerable promise for cancer treatment, but conventional Type II PDT is strongly limited by tumor hypoxia. Here, we designed a D-π-A-π-D BODIPY-based near-infrared aggregation-induced emission (AIE) photosensitizer, TBSN, by integrating tetraphenylethylene units and a rotatable N,N-diethylaniline moiety. Theoretical calculations identified S1 → T2 as the predominant intersystem crossing pathway and showed that the N,N-diethylaniline unit participated in the electronic redistribution of the T2 state. The calculated T1 → S0 energy of 0.42 eV made the energy-transfer process required for singlet-oxygen sensitization thermodynamically unfavorable. Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spin-trapping experiments detected light-induced superoxide radical anions (O2·–) and hydroxyl radicals (·OH), but no discernible singlet oxygen (1O2) signal, supporting predominantly Type I reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation. Molecular dynamics simulations further showed that the molecular rotor retained considerable rotational freedom after aggregation, consistent with the photothermal conversion efficiency of 54.44%. After encapsulation with DSPE-PEG2000, TBSN@PEG retained pronounced ROS-generating and photothermal activities and exhibited effective photocytotoxicity under both normoxic and hypoxic conditions. Following intratumoral administration and 730 nm irradiation, TBSN@PEG produced localized heating and markedly inhibited 4T1 tumor growth, while showing favorable preliminary short-term biosafety at the tested dose. These results demonstrate a molecular design strategy that jointly regulates triplet-state electronic structure and residual rotor motion to balance Type I ROS generation and photothermal conversion.
title_zh: 调节三线态能级和分子内运动：用于近红外 I 型光动力/光热协同治疗的聚集诱导发射 BODIPY
abstract_zh: 摘要 光动力疗法（PDT）和光热疗法（PTT）的结合在癌症治疗中具有广阔的前景，但传统的II型PDT受到肿瘤缺氧的强烈限制。在这里，我们通过整合四苯乙烯单元和可旋转的 N,N-二乙基苯胺部分，设计了一种基于 D-π-A-π-D BODIPY 的近红外聚集诱导发射（AIE）光敏剂 TBSN。理论计算确定S1→T2是主要的系间穿越路径，并表明N,N-二乙基苯胺单元参与了T2态的电子重新分布。计算得出的 T1 → S0 能量为 0.42 eV，这使得单线态氧敏化所需的能量转移过程在热力学上不利。电子顺磁共振 (EPR) 自旋捕获实验检测到光诱导的超氧自由基阴离子 (O2·–) 和羟基自由基 (·OH)，但没有可辨别的单线态氧 (1O2) 信号，主要支持 I 型活性氧 (ROS) 的生成。分子动力学模拟进一步表明，分子转子在聚集后保留了相当大的旋转自由度，与54.44%的光热转换效率一致。用 DSPE-PEG2000 封装后，TBSN@PEG 保留了显着的 ROS 生成和光热活性，并在常氧和缺氧条件下表现出有效的光细胞毒性。瘤内给药和 730 nm 照射后，TBSN@PEG 产生局部加热并显着抑制 4T1 肿瘤生长，同时显示出良好的初步短期双

title: Stem Cell-Derived Extracellular Matrix Biofunctionalized Small Intestinal Submucosa for the Repair of Rotator Cuff Tears
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Large to massive rotator cuff tears (RCTs) frequently lead to high retear rates, and small intestinal submucosa (SIS) has been applied in RCT repair but is limited by insufficient regenerative capacity. To enhance the tendon-bone healing potential of SIS, we modified it with extracellular matrix (ECM) derived from bone marrow−derived mesenchymal stem cells (BM-MSCs), generating a scaffold termed BME-SIS. The morphology, surface roughness, hydrophilicity, mechanical properties, and growth factor content of BME-SIS were systematically characterized. In vitro, the BME-SIS extract significantly promoted BM-MSC proliferation, migration, and the expression of osteogenic, chondrogenic, and tenogenic lineage-related differentiation markers, despite its slightly reduced mechanical strength. In a rat model of RCT, BME-SIS was implanted at the tendon-bone interface (TBI) and evaluated at four and eight weeks post surgery by gait analysis, biomechanical testing, microcomputed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, and histological assessment. Compared with SIS, BME-SIS exhibited increased surface roughness, enhanced hydrophilicity, and enriched growth factors, which translated into superior biological performance. In vivo, BME-SIS markedly improved gait recovery, facilitated tendon-bone integration, and promoted cartilage regeneration at the TBI. Collectively, these results demonstrate that BM-MSC-derived ECM significantly augments the reparative potential of SIS, highlighting BME-SIS as a promising biomaterial for RCT repair.
title_zh: 干细胞衍生的细胞外基质生物功能化小肠粘膜下层用于修复肩袖撕裂
abstract_zh: 摘要 大到大量的肩袖撕裂（RCT）经常导致较高的再愈合率，小肠粘膜下层（SIS）已应用于RCT修复，但由于再生能力不足而受到限制。为了增强 SIS 的腱骨愈合潜力，我们用源自骨髓间充质干细胞 (BM-MSC) 的细胞外基质 (ECM) 对其进行了修改，生成了一种称为 BME-SIS 的支架。对 BME-SIS 的形貌、表面粗糙度、亲水性、机械性能和生长因子含量进行了系统表征。在体外，BME-SIS 提取物显着促进 BM-MSC 增殖、迁移以及成骨、软骨形成和肌腱谱系相关分化标记物的表达，尽管其机械强度略有降低。在 RCT 大鼠模型中，BME-SIS 被植入腱骨界面 (TBI)，并在术后 4 周和 8 周通过步态分析、生物力学测试、微计算机断层扫描、磁共振成像和组织学评估进行评估。与 SIS 相比，BME-SIS 表现出更高的表面粗糙度、增强的亲水性和丰富的生长因子，从而转化为优异的生物学性能。在体内，BME-SIS 显着改善步态恢复，促进肌腱-骨整合，并促进 TBI 处的软骨再生。总的来说，这些结果表明 BM-MSC 衍生的 ECM 显着增强了 SIS 的修复潜力，凸显了 BME-SIS 作为 RCT 修复有前景的生物材料。

title: Anomalous n−p Sensing Conversion in Cobalt Ferrite: The Role of Surface Adsorption and Carrier Scattering
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Cobalt ferrite stands out as a versatile gas-sensing material, offering tunable composition and dual redox couples. We report a remarkable n−p sensing conversion in cobalt ferrite-based sensors—an anomalous resistance modulation that contradicts conventional intrinsic semiconductor behavior. While occasionally observed in metal oxides, such phenomena remain largely unexplored in the context of cobalt ferrite. Here, by regulating the proportion of metal elements in cobalt ferrite, we systematically decouple the unconventional sensing switching and the intriguing dynamic selectivity induced by diverse volatile organic compounds (VOCs) across a temperature range of 140−230 °C. Leveraging in situ XPS, Raman spectroscopy, and photoluminescence (PL), we propose a mechanistic framework: the competitive interplay between surface adsorbed oxygen and carrier scattering mechanisms governs the electronic transport. This study not only elucidates the underlying physics of the sensing conversion phenomenon but also establishes a fundamental “structure−chemistry−property” framework for the rational design of advanced cobalt ferrite gas sensors.
title_zh: 钴铁氧体中的反常 n−p 传感转换：表面吸附和载流子散射的作用
abstract_zh: 摘要 钴铁氧体作为一种多功能气敏材料脱颖而出，提供可调成分和双氧化还原对。我们报告了基于钴铁氧体的传感器中显着的 n−p 传感转换，这是一种与传统的固有半导体行为相矛盾的反常电阻调制。虽然在金属氧化物中偶尔观察到这种现象，但在钴铁氧体中这种现象仍然很大程度上未被探索。在这里，通过调节钴铁氧体中金属元素的比例，我们系统地解耦了非常规传感开关和在 140−230 °C 温度范围内由多种挥发性有机化合物 (VOC) 引起的有趣的动态选择性。利用原位 XPS、拉曼光谱和光致发光 (PL)，我们提出了一个机制框架：表面吸附的氧和载流子散射机制之间的竞争性相互作用控制着电子传输。这项研究不仅阐明了传感转换现象的基本物理原理，而且为先进钴铁氧体气体传感器的合理设计建立了基本的“结构-化学-性能”框架。

title: A Core–Shell Nanotherapeutic Platform Reprograms the Infected Wound Microenvironment through Dual Bactericidal and Immunomodulatory Actions for Accelerated Healing
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The treatment of wounds caused by drug-resistant bacteria is a significant challenge in clinical medicine. Silver (Ag) nanoparticles have attracted considerable attention due to their ability to inhibit drug-resistant bacteria. Nevertheless, the propensity of Ag nanoparticles to aggregate as well as their elevated toxicity have restricted their practical application. To address this issue, this study involved the design of a core–shell-type ZnO@ZIF-8/Ag nanocomposite material that combines high antibacterial activity with excellent biocompatibility. The mean diameter of the Ag nanoparticles in this material was approximately 2.4 nm, and they were highly dispersed. Within the wound microenvironment, antibacterial factors, such as hydroxyl radicals (·OH), singlet oxygen (1O2), Zn2+, and Ag+, were generated. The material induced bacterial death by altering the structure of the cell wall of drug-resistant bacteria, thereby inhibiting respiration, lysing phospholipid layers, and causing cellular content leakage. The introduction of zinc oxide (ZnO) significantly reduced the toxicity of the Ag nanoparticles and regulated macrophage polarization, which inhibited the secretion of tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) and interleukin-6 (IL-6) by M1-type macrophages (M1) while concomitantly promoting the secretion of interleukin-10 (IL-10) and vascular endothelial growth factor by M2-type macrophages (M2). The expression of platelet-endothelial cell adhesion molecule-1 (CD31), type I collagen/fibronectin (COL-I/FN), and proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) was significantly promoted, which significantly enhanced wound healing in infected wounds. This study thus offers a strategy for developing therapies against drug-resistant bacterial infections with the potential for clinical application.
title_zh: 核壳纳米治疗平台通过双重杀菌和免疫调节作用重新编程感染伤口微环境以加速愈合
abstract_zh: 摘要 耐药细菌引起的伤口的治疗是临床医学的重大挑战。银（Ag）纳米颗粒因其抑制耐药细菌的能力而引起了广泛关注。然而，银纳米颗粒的聚集倾向及其较高的毒性限制了其实际应用。为了解决这个问题，本研究设计了一种核壳型ZnO@ZIF-8/Ag纳米复合材料，该材料结合了高抗菌活性和优异的生物相容性。该材料中Ag纳米粒子的平均直径约为2.4 nm，且高度分散。在伤口微环境中，产生羟基自由基（·OH）、单线态氧（1O2）、Zn2+和Ag+等抗菌因子。该材料通过改变耐药细菌细胞壁的结构来诱导细菌死亡，从而抑制呼吸、裂解磷脂层并导致细胞内容物泄漏。氧化锌（ZnO）的引入显着降低了Ag纳米颗粒的毒性并调节了巨噬细胞极化，抑制了M1型巨噬细胞（M1）分泌肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白细胞介素6（IL-6），同时促进M2型巨噬细胞（M2）分泌白细胞介素-10（IL-10）和血管内皮生长因子。血小板内皮细胞粘附分子-1 (CD31)、I 型胶原/纤连蛋白 (COL-I/FN) 和增殖细胞核抗原 (PCNA) 的表达显着升高。

title: Strategy for Optical Transparent Broadband Frequency-Tunable Microwave Absorption: Double Fabry−Pérot Resonant Cavities
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The limited modulation range and optical opacity have long restricted the practical application of frequency-tunable microwave absorbers. To address this challenge, we propose a transparent tunable microwave meta-absorber based on double Fabry−Pérot (FP) cavities and a vanadium dioxide (VO2) mesh. By thermally tuning the sheet resistance of the VO2 mesh, the dominant absorption resonance can be switched between FP cavities with different optical thicknesses, while also adjusting the impedance matching with free space, thereby enabling dynamic absorption peak frequency tuning over a 4.2 GHz range and achieving a high amplitude modulation depth of 93.15%. This work also utilizes multibeam interference theory and a reflection coefficient mechanism model to support the theoretical analysis and reveal the physical mechanism underlying the tunable absorption. Experimental results further show that the absorber maintains a broadband optical transmittance exceeding 72.48% across the 380−4000 nm spectral range. Compared with conventional tuning strategies, this work simultaneously achieves structural simplicity, broadband frequency and amplitude modulation capabilities, and high optical transparency, providing a feasible solution for applications in transparent electronics, smart windows, and electromagnetic modulation systems.
title_zh: 光学透明宽带频率可调微波吸收策略：双法布里-珀罗谐振腔
abstract_zh: 摘要 有限的调制范围和光学不透明性长期以来限制了频率可调微波吸收器的实际应用。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于双法布里-珀罗（FP）腔和二氧化钒（VO2）网的透明可调谐微波元吸收器。通过热调节VO2网格的薄层电阻，可以在不同光学厚度的FP腔之间切换主导吸收谐振，同时还可以调整与自由空间的阻抗匹配，从而实现4.2 GHz范围内的动态吸收峰值频率调谐，并实现93.15%的高调幅深度。这项工作还利用多光束干涉理论和反射系数机制模型来支持理论分析并揭示可调谐吸收背后的物理机制。实验结果进一步表明，吸收体在380−4000 nm光谱范围内保持超过72.48%的宽带光学透过率。与传统的调谐策略相比，该工作同时实现了结构简单、宽带频率和幅度调制能力以及高光学透明度，为透明电子、智能窗户和电磁调制系统中的应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Layer-engineered quantum anomalous Hall effect in twisted rhombohedral graphene
source: Nature Materials
abstract: Realizing programmable topological states in quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) insulators requires tuning their topological invariant, the Chern number C. Here we report a QAH platform based on twisted rhombohedral graphene, in which C becomes a programmable and electrically tunable degree of freedom. In twisted monolayer-multilayer (1 + N) rhombohedral graphene, we find QAH states with C = N, where the layer number N = 3, 4, 5 directly sets the Chern number. We further demonstrate in situ electrical control. In a twisted monolayer-trilayer device, the sign of C is switched by electrostatic doping or displacement field. In addition, in twisted Bernal bilayer-rhombohedral tetralayer graphene, we drive a displacement-field-induced topological phase transition between two distinct QAH states with C = 3 and C = 4. Our work establishes a layer-engineered and electrically tunable platform that could lead to the on-demand engineering of correlated topological states.
title_zh: 扭曲菱面体石墨烯中的层工程量子反常霍尔效应
abstract_zh: 在量子反常霍尔（QAH）绝缘体中实现可编程拓扑态需要调整其拓扑不变量，陈数C。在这里，我们报告了一种基于扭曲菱面体石墨烯的QAH平台，其中C成为可编程且电可调的自由度。在扭曲的单层-多层(1 + N)菱面体石墨烯中，我们发现C = N的QAH状态，其中层数N = 3,4,5直接设置陈数。我们进一步演示了原位电气控制。在扭曲的单层-三层器件中，C的符号通过静电掺杂或位移场切换。此外，在扭曲的伯纳尔双层-菱面体四层石墨烯中，我们在 C = 3 和 C = 4 的两个不同 QAH 状态之间驱动位移场诱导的拓扑相变。我们的工作建立了一个层工程和电可调平台，可以实现相关拓扑状态的按需工程。

title: Unraveling the coastal marine plastisphere archaeome
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Plastic pollution has created an expanding anthropogenic microbial niche, the plastisphere, raising questions about microbial ecology and associated impacts. Archaea, the third domain of life with fundamental ecological and evolutionary significance, remain poorly understood in this habitat. Here, using paired plastic debris and bulk-water samples from coastal marine ecosystems, key archaeal habitats increasingly threatened by plastic pollution, we characterize the plastisphere archaeome through archaeal amplicon sequencing and metagenomics. We show that the archaeome is significantly reshaped in the plastisphere, exhibiting higher taxonomic diversity, greater community heterogeneity, and selective enrichment of Euryarchaeota and Crenarchaeota. Archaeal genes involved in methane, nitrogen, and sulfur cycling are enriched in the plastisphere. Taxonomic and functional divergence between the plastisphere and bulk water increases with anthropogenic chemical stress. These findings suggest that plastic pollution could alter marine archaeal diversity, biogeography, and biogeochemical potential, extending understanding of plastisphere impacts to the archaeal domain.
title_zh: 解开沿海海洋塑料球古菌组
abstract_zh: 塑料污染创造了一个不断扩大的人为微生物生态位，即塑料圈，引发了有关微生物生态学和相关影响的问题。古细菌是具有基本生态和进化意义的第三个生命领域，但人们对该栖息地的了解仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用来自沿海海洋生态系统（日益受到塑料污染威胁的关键古菌栖息地）的配对塑料碎片和大量水样本，通过古菌扩增子测序和宏基因组学来表征塑料球古菌组。我们发现古菌组在塑料圈中显着重塑，表现出更高的分类多样性、更大的群落异质性以及广古菌门和泉古菌门的选择性富集。参与甲烷、氮和硫循环的古菌基因在塑料圈中富集。塑料圈和散装水之间的分类和功能差异随着人为化学压力的增加而增加。这些发现表明，塑料污染可能会改变海洋古菌多样性、生物地理学和生物地球化学潜力，从而将塑料圈影响的理解扩展到古菌领域。

title: Bioresorbable and optically readable triboelectric implants enabled by nanoscale iridophosphors
source: Nature Nanotechnology
abstract: Implantable bioelectronics are typically inaccessible once implanted, and therefore structural damage, degradation and functional loss often go undetected until complications arise. Reliance on batteries further exacerbates these risks by imposing limited lifetimes, leakage hazards and non-resorbable components that may require surgical removal. Here we report a battery-free, bioresorbable triboelectric implant that enables externally readable, on-demand visualization of device status while generating electrical output. A data-driven materials-to-device workflow combines machine-learning-assisted photophysical screening with molecular-dipole-moment-based selection to identify nanoscale iridium(III) complexes optimized for both optical reporting and triboelectric charge generation. The resulting devices integrate a transcutaneous phosphorescent readout with ultrasound-driven energy harvesting, producing outlines visible to the unaided eye under handheld illumination and generating up to 3.6 Vpp at 0.5 W cm-2 of ultrasound power. In vivo studies in mice demonstrate that optical readouts track implant position, morphology and damage, correlate structural defects with loss of electrical output, and monitor integrity and bioresorption over 38 weeks. This work establishes a transient in vivo power platform whose morphology reports on structural integrity and energy-harvesting function, offering a route to observable bioelectronic implants and supporting timely intervention.
title_zh: 由纳米级虹彩磷实现的生物可吸收和光学可读摩擦电植入物
abstract_zh: 植入式生物电子设备一旦植入后通常无法接近，因此结构损伤、退化和功能丧失通常不会被发现，直到出现并发症。对电池的依赖会带来有限的使用寿命、泄漏危险和可能需要手术切除的不可吸收组件，进一步加剧了这些风险。在此，我们报告了一种无电池、可生物吸收的摩擦电植入物，可在产生电力输出的同时实现外部可读、按需可视化的设备状态。数据驱动的材料到设备的工作流程将机器学习辅助的光物理筛选与基于分子偶极矩的选择相结合，以识别针对光学报告和摩擦电荷生成进行优化的纳米级铱 (III) 复合物。由此产生的设备将经皮磷光读数与超声波驱动的能量收集相结合，在手持照明下产生肉眼可见的轮廓，并在 0.5Wcm-2 的超声波功率下产生高达 3.6Vpp 的超声波功率。小鼠体内研究表明，光学读数可跟踪植入物位置、形态和损伤，将结构缺陷与电输出损失相关联，并在 38 周内监测完整性和生物吸收。这项工作建立了一个瞬态体内动力平台，其形态报告结构完整性和能量收集功能，为可观察的生物电子植入物提供了一条途径并支持及时干预。

title: Architecting Percolating Ionic Networks in Spiro-OMeTAD via Radical-Dopant Cooperation for Enhanced Hole Transport and Stability
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Doping spiro-OMeTAD has contributed to the power conversion efficiency (PCE) improvement of perovskite solar cells. Nevertheless, the actual roles of the radical and dopant, and their influence on the hole transport, have not been identified much. Herein, we explore the roles of the radical and dopant in doped spiro-OMeTAD and study their effects on hole transport. In particular, we identify the formation of a percolating ionic network (PIN), driven by cooperative radical-dopant interactions, as a previously unrecognized origin of efficient hole transport in doped spiro-OMeTAD. Moreover, we optimized the dopant design by changing the cation bulkiness to maximize hole transport without co-solvents. Finally, we introduce in situ polymerization of the dopant for fixation of the percolated network to improve morphological stability. As a result, we achieve 25.59% PCE with improved stability, retaining over 90% of its initial efficiency after 1600 h under 85 °C and over 95% after 800 h under 60 ± 10% relative humidity.
title_zh: 通过自由基-掺杂剂合作在 Spiro-OMeTAD 中构建渗透离子网络以增强空穴传输和稳定性
abstract_zh: 摘要 掺杂spiro-OMeTAD有助于钙钛矿太阳能电池功率转换效率（PCE）的提高。然而，自由基和掺杂剂的实际作用及其对空穴传输的影响尚未明确。在此，我们探讨了自由基和掺杂剂在掺杂螺-OMeTAD中的作用，并研究了它们对空穴传输的影响。特别是，我们确定了由自由基-掺杂剂协同相互作用驱动的渗滤离子网络（PIN）的形成，这是掺杂螺-OMeTAD中以前未被认识到的高效空穴传输的起源。此外，我们通过改变阳离子体积来优化掺杂剂设计，以在没有共溶剂的情况下最大化空穴传输。最后，我们引入掺杂剂的原位聚合来固定渗透网络，以提高形态稳定性。结果，我们实现了 25.59% 的 PCE 和更高的稳定性，在 85 °C 下 1600 小时后保持超过 90% 的初始效率，在 60 ± 10% 相对湿度下 800 小时后保持超过 95% 的初始效率。

title: Building a Physics-Aware AI Ecosystem for Solid-State Hydrogen Storage Materials
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Hydrogen storage remains a central bottleneck for scalable hydrogen energy systems due to the multiscale and coupled nature of the thermodynamics, kinetics, and microstructural evolution of hydrogen storage materials (HSMs). Although artificial intelligence (AI) has accelerated materials discovery, current approaches remain constrained by fragmented data, limited physical consistency, and weak integration with experimental validation. Here, we propose a unified framework that integrates coherent data infrastructure, physics-grounded modeling, and AI-driven inverse design within a closed-loop discovery paradigm. By constraining optimization with thermodynamics, kinetics, uncertainty, provenance, and experimental feedback, this approach enables adaptive, physically consistent optimization, thereby establishing a pathway toward autonomous, digital-twin-enabled discovery of HSMs.
title_zh: 为固态储氢材料构建物理感知人工智能生态系统
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于储氢材料（HSM）的热力学、动力学和微观结构演化的多尺度和耦合性质，储氢仍然是可扩展氢能系统的中心瓶颈。尽管人工智能 (AI) 加速了材料的发现，但当前的方法仍然受到数据分散、物理一致性有限以及与实验验证集成薄弱的限制。在这里，我们提出了一个统一的框架，在闭环发现范式中集成了连贯的数据基础设施、基于物理的建模和人工智能驱动的逆向设计。通过利用热力学、动力学、不确定性、来源和实验反馈来约束优化，该方法可以实现自适应、物理一致的优化，从而建立一条通往自主的、支持数字孪生的 HSM 发现的途径。

title: Progress on Halide Solid State Electrolytes: Structural Regulation, Interfacial Engineering, and Machine Learning Driven Paradigms
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Halide solid state electrolytes are applicable for all-solid-state batteries due to their favorable ionic conductivity, desirable mechanical deformability, and wide electrochemical stability window. Here we review recent advances in both lithium-based and sodium-based halide electrolytes. Beginning with materials classification and synthesis methods, this review delves into the effects of crystal framework architecture, coordination environment, and the synergistic regulation of occupancy and vacancies on ion conduction mechanisms, particularly emphasizing the advantages of amorphous halide solid state electrolytes. The underlying origins of air instability and electrolyte/interface failure in halide-based batteries are systematically summarized, followed by a discussion of stability enhancement strategies, including elemental doping, interfacial engineering, and structural optimization. Notably, this review introduces a machine learning perspective, exploring its applications in materials screening, elucidation of ion transport mechanisms, and prediction of interfacial reactions. This review provides a theoretical foundation and technical guidance for the rational design of all-solid-state batteries.
title_zh: 卤化物固态电解质的进展：结构调控、界面工程和机器学习驱动范式
abstract_zh: 摘要 卤化物固态电解质具有良好的离子电导率、良好的机械变形能力和宽的电化学稳定性窗口，适用于全固态电池。在这里，我们回顾了锂基和钠基卤化物电解质的最新进展。本文从材料分类和合成方法入手，深入研究了晶体骨架结构、配位环境以及占据和空位的协同调节对离子传导机制的影响，特别强调了非晶卤化物固态电解质的优势。系统地总结了卤化物电池中空气不稳定和电解质/界面失效的根本原因，然后讨论了稳定性增强策略，包括元素掺杂、界面工程和结构优化。值得注意的是，这篇综述引入了机器学习的视角，探索其在材料筛选、离子传输机制阐明和界面反应预测方面的应用。该综述为全固态电池的合理设计提供了理论基础和技术指导。
