title: Odorant receptor coexpression and multi-expression in the dengue mosquito
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Drosophila olfactory sensory neurons tend to express a single ligand-specific receptor, following a one-receptor-per-neuron rule expected to apply broadly across insects. Recent work challenges this view by showing that some neurons in the mosquito Aedes aegypti coexpress multiple receptors. However, the full extent and nature of coexpression in Ae. aegypti remains unclear. We sequenced the transcriptomes of 46,000 female antennal neurons to resolve all olfactory neuron subtypes and identify expressed receptors. Half of all subtypes coexpress multiple receptors. However, coexpression occurs almost exclusively among receptors from the same family; cross-family coexpression of odorant receptors with ionotropic receptors is rare. We also document a phenomenon called multi-expression, wherein one receptor is expressed in multiple neuron subtypes, often alongside distant paralogs. Drosophila provides rare examples of both coexpression and multi-expression, suggesting that Drosophila and Aedes are not fundamentally different, but instead located at different positions along a continuum likely to encompass diverse insects.
title_zh: 登革热蚊子中气味受体的共表达和多重表达
abstract_zh: 果蝇嗅觉感觉神经元倾向于表达单一配体特异性受体，遵循每个神经元一个受体的规则，预计广泛适用于昆虫。最近的研究挑战了这一观点，表明埃及伊蚊的一些神经元同时表达多种受体。然而，Ae 中共表达的全部范围和性质。埃及伊蚊仍不清楚。我们对 46,000 个雌性触角神经元的转录组进行了测序，以解析所有嗅觉神经元亚型并鉴定表达的受体。所有亚型的一半共表达多种受体。然而，共表达几乎只发生在来自同一家族的受体之间。气味受体与离子型受体的跨家族共表达是罕见的。我们还记录了一种称为多重表达的现象，其中一种受体在多种神经元亚型中表达，通常与远处的旁系同源物一起表达。果蝇提供了共表达和多重表达的罕见例子，表明果蝇和伊蚊并没有本质上的不同，而是位于可能包含不同昆虫的连续体上的不同位置。

title: Solution-phase transition zones govern crystallographic perfection in metal halide perovskite single crystals
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Despite rapid progress in solution-grown metal halide perovskite single crystals for optoelectronic applications, further enhancement of their intrinsic crystallographic quality through solution engineering remains challenging. In particular, the fundamental links between precursor solution properties and crystal quality, as well as a universal mechanism governing crystallization from solution, remains poorly understood. Here, using in-situ microscopic spectroscopy, we identify key solution properties of viscosity, concentration, coordination number and growing temperature as critical determinants of crystal quality through their modulation of solution-phase transition zones, which are directly observed experimentally located 10 – 60 μm away from the crystal-solution interface. We reveal a direct correlation between crystal quality, quantified by the carrier mobility–lifetime product, and the width of the transition zone, providing a clear guideline for improving crystallographic quality by widening this zone. As a result, FAPbBr3 single crystals with markedly improved crystallographic perfection are achieved via solution engineering, demonstrating a high charge-collection efficiency of 99% and an energy resolution of 1.32% for 662 keV γ-rays from a 137Cs source.
title_zh: 溶液相转变区控制金属卤化物钙钛矿单晶的晶体学完美性
abstract_zh: 尽管用于光电应用的溶液生长金属卤化物钙钛矿单晶取得了快速进展，但通过溶液工程进一步提高其内在晶体质量仍然具有挑战性。特别是，前体溶液性质和晶体质量之间的基本联系以及控制溶液结晶的通用机制仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们利用原位显微光谱，通过对溶液相变区的调节，确定了粘度、浓度、配位数和生长温度等关键溶液特性，作为晶体质量的关键决定因素，这些相变区在距离晶体-溶液界面 10 – 60 μm 处通过实验直接观察。我们揭示了晶体质量（通过载流子迁移率-寿命乘积量化）与过渡区宽度之间的直接相关性，为通过加宽该区域来提高晶体学质量提供了明确的指导。结果，通过溶液工程实现了晶体学完美性显着改善的 FAPbBr3 单晶，对于来自 137Cs 源的 662 keV γ 射线表现出 99% 的高电荷收集效率和 1.32% 的能量分辨率。

title: Detection of the elusive cyclo−1,2-dihydrotetrazete (N4H2) in the gas phase
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Nitrogen hydrides (NnHm) have attracted significant interest for their potential in developing high-energy-density materials. The synthesis of cyclic nitrogen hydrides is particularly challenging due to their inherently high strain energies. Here we report the preparation of the hitherto elusive trans- and cis-cyclo−1,2-dihydrotetrazete (2a and 2b, cyclo-N4H2) along with its open chain isomer azidamide (5a, N=N=N−NH2) by exposing low temperature (5 K) ice of ammonia (NH3) to high-energy electrons. These compounds were detected and discriminated in the gas phase during the temperature programmed desorption phase exploiting isomer selectivity soft photoionization reflectron time-of-flight mass spectrometry. The cyclo−1,2-dihydrotetrazete signifies a free gas phase species containing a tetranitrogen ring existing without recourse to high-pressure conditions or conjugative stabilization. Our approach may provide feasible strategies for designing higher-order nitrogen ring systems and for elucidating their chemical bonding and stability.
title_zh: 检测气相中难以捉摸的环−1,2-二氢四氮烷 (N4H2)
abstract_zh: 氮氢化物（NnHm）因其在开发高能量密度材料方面的潜力而引起了人们的极大兴趣。环状氮氢化物的合成由于其固有的高应变能而特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了通过将氨（NH3）的低温（5 K）冰暴露于高能电子来制备迄今为止难以捉摸的反式和顺式环−1,2-二氢四氮杂物（2a和2b，环-N4H2）及其开链异构体叠氮酰胺（5a，N=N=N−NH2）。在程序升温解吸阶段，利用异构体选择性软光电离反射飞行时间质谱法在气相中检测和区分这些化合物。环−1,2-二氢四氮烷表示含有四氮环的游离气相物质，其存在不依赖于高压条件或共轭稳定。我们的方法可以为设计高阶氮环系统并阐明其化学键合和稳定性提供可行的策略。

title: Machine learning-driven optimization of high-velocity impact resistance for three-dimensional biphasic composites
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Under high-velocity loading conditions, composite materials inevitably exhibit wave propagation and localized temperature rise, yet their complex microstructural arrangement contributes to the characteristic stress localization and attenuation behaviors. To mitigate this challenge and optimize the impact resistance of composite materials, we developed a three-dimensional convolutional neural network (3D-CNN) with experimental and simulation methods to quantitatively correlate microstructural configurations with the dynamic response of biphasic composites. This methodology synergizes experimental data from split Hopkinson pressure bar (SHPB) dynamic tests with finite element (FE) simulations, enabling a comprehensive characterization of the dynamic behavior of composites. The optimized microstructures improve dynamic stress uniformity from 21.54% to 97.45% and increase dynamic load capacity by approximately 22% to 57% compared with random designs at the same stiff-phase fractions. This machine learning-driven approach can improve dynamic stress equilibrium properties for soft and stiff composites. The thermal transport module enables integrated evaluation of impact resistance and heat-spreading performance, revealing multi-material architectures that sustain high dynamic mechanical performance while allowing effective thermal conductivity through phase connectivity and percolation pathways. This proposed 3D CNN framework facilitates rapid exploration of the design space and accurate prediction of thermomechanical properties, thereby enabling the inverse design of next-generation impact-resistant composites for aerospace and automotive applications.
title_zh: 机器学习驱动的三维双相复合材料高速抗冲击性优化
abstract_zh: 在高速加载条件下，复合材料不可避免地会表现出波传播和局部温升，但其复杂的微观结构排列导致了特征应力局部化和衰减行为。为了缓解这一挑战并优化复合材料的抗冲击性，我们通过实验和模拟方法开发了三维卷积神经网络（3D-CNN），以定量地将微观结构配置与双相复合材料的动态响应相关联。该方法将分体式霍普金森压力杆 (SHPB) 动态测试的实验数据与有限元 (FE) 模拟相结合，从而能够全面表征复合材料的动态行为。与相同刚性相分数的随机设计相比，优化的微观结构将动态应力均匀性从 21.54% 提高到 97.45%，并将动态负载能力提高约 22% 到 57%。这种机器学习驱动的方法可以改善软质和硬质复合材料的动态应力平衡特性。热传输模块能够对抗冲击性和散热性能进行综合评估，揭示了维持高动态机械性能的多材料架构，同时通过相连接和渗透路径实现有效的导热性。这种提出的 3D CNN 框架有助于快速探索设计空间和准确预测热机械性能，从而实现下一代的逆向设计

title: Towards unified AI-driven fracture mechanics: the extended deep energy method (XDEM)
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently emerged as powerful tools for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), with the Deep Energy Method (DEM) proving especially effective in fracture mechanics due to its energy-based formulation. Despite these advances, existing DEM approaches require dense collocation near cracks, face stability challenges, and typically treat discrete and continuous fracture models separately. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the Extended Deep Energy Method (XDEM), a unified deep learning framework that incorporates both displacement discontinuities and crack-tip asymptotics in the discrete setting, while flexibly coupling displacement and phase fields in the continuous setting. This integration enables accurate fracture predictions using uniformly distributed, relatively sparse collocation points. Validation across benchmark problems including stress intensity factor evaluation, straight and kinked crack growth, and complex crack initiation demonstrates that XDEM consistently outperforms standard DEM in accuracy and efficiency. By bridging discrete and phase-field models within a single framework, XDEM establishes a robust foundation for applying AI to fracture mechanics and opens new avenues for predictive modeling in engineering and materials science.
title_zh: 迈向统一的人工智能驱动断裂力学：扩展深能法 (XDEM)
abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 最近已成为求解偏微分方程 (PDE) 的强大工具，深能量法 (DEM) 由于其基于能量的公式而被证明在断裂力学中特别有效。尽管取得了这些进步，现有的 DEM 方法需要裂缝附近的密集搭配，面临稳定性挑战，并且通常单独处理离散和连续裂缝模型。为了克服这些限制，我们引入了扩展深度能量方法（XDEM），这是一种统一的深度学习框架，它在离散设置中结合了位移不连续性和裂纹尖端渐进性，同时在连续设置中灵活耦合位移和相场。这种集成可以使用均匀分布、相对稀疏的配置点进行准确的裂缝预测。跨基准问题（包括应力强度因子评估、直裂纹扩展和扭结裂纹扩展以及复杂裂纹萌生）的验证表明，XDEM 在精度和效率方面始终优于标准 DEM。通过在单一框架内桥接离散模型和相场模型，XDEM 为将人工智能应用于断裂力学奠定了坚实的基础，并为工程和材料科学中的预测建模开辟了新途径。

title: Acid-base bifunctional porous liquids
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Basic solutions are essential for gas-involved catalytic transformations, yet their ultralow free volume limits gas solubility and diffusivity. Engineering permanent porosity in such reactive liquids has remained a longstanding challenge. Here, we introduce a surface-sacrifice strategy that incorporates Brønsted-acidic zeolite nanocrystals into strong organic bases to create permanently porous reactive liquids. Stereochemically controlled acid–base neutralization at the external zeolite surface forms a thin ionic solvation shell that stabilizes the dispersion while fully preserving the internal microporosity and crystallinity of the zeolite framework. The resulting basic media exhibit persistent microporosity, confirmed by inert-gas sorption, 129Xe nuclear magnetic resonance, neutron scattering, and theoretical simulations. These porous liquids show significantly enhanced catalytic performance in CO2 conversion and hydrogenation reactions. The coexisting acidic and basic sites further enable antagonistic cascade catalysis within a single liquid phase. This surface-sacrifice approach provides a general route to introduce permanent porosity into reactive media, enabling boosted gas transformations.
title_zh: 酸碱双功能多孔液体
abstract_zh: 碱性溶液对于涉及气体的催化转化至关重要，但其超低的自由体积限制了气体的溶解度和扩散率。在这种反应性液体中设计永久孔隙率仍然是一个长期的挑战。在这里，我们引入了一种表面牺牲策略，将布朗斯台德酸性沸石纳米晶体融入强有机碱中，以产生永久多孔的反应液体。沸石外表面的立体化学控制的酸碱中和形成薄薄的离子溶剂化壳，稳定分散体，同时充分保留沸石骨架的内部微孔性和结晶度。由此产生的基本介质表现出持久的微孔性，经惰性气体吸附、129Xe 核磁共振、中子散射和理论模拟证实。这些多孔液体在二氧化碳转化和加氢反应中表现出显着增强的催化性能。共存的酸性和碱性位点进一步实现了单一液相内的拮抗级联催化。这种表面牺牲方法提供了将永久孔隙引入反应介质中的通用途径，从而促进气体转化。

title: Achieving Near 21% Efficiency Organic Solar Cells through Controlled Packing of Fused-Ring Electron Acceptors
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Non-radiative energy loss remains a challenge in organic solar cells. Here we show that introducing bulky chlorobenzene moieties at the end of inner side chains yields two acceptor materials, Y6-2Cl and Y6-4Cl. The introduction of chlorobenzene groups enhances the solubility, while also boosting the photoluminescence quantum yield and inducing a distinct molecular packing mode in Y6-2Cl and Y6-4Cl. Rather than following the conventional three-dimensional network structure observed in Y-series acceptors, these materials form a highly ordered, array-like arrangement while maintaining excellent crystalline characteristics. This unique structural feature not only preserves high charge-transport properties but also optimizes aggregation behavior and morphology of the active layers. The D18:Y6-2Cl binary device demonstrates a PCE of 20.0%. The ternary device composed of D18:L8-BO:Y6-2Cl achieves a PCE of 20.92%, accompanied by a fill factor of 82.93%. Overall, the side-chain functionalization strategy proposed in this study offers a direction for developing high-performance non-fullerene acceptors.
title_zh: 通过熔环电子受体的受控堆积实现接近 21% 的有机太阳能电池效率
abstract_zh: 非辐射能量损失仍然是有机太阳能电池的一个挑战。在这里，我们表明，在内侧链末端引入庞大的氯苯部分会产生两种受体材料，Y6-2Cl 和 Y6-4Cl。氯苯基团的引入增强了溶解度，同时也提高了 Y6-2Cl 和 Y6-4Cl 的光致发光量子产率并诱导了独特的分子堆积模式。这些材料并不遵循 Y 系列受体中观察到的传统三维网络结构，而是形成高度有序的阵列状排列，同时保持优异的晶体特性。这种独特的结构特征不仅保留了高电荷传输特性，而且还优化了活性层的聚集行为和形态。 D18:Y6-2Cl 二元装置的 PCE 为 20.0%。由D18:L8-BO:Y6-2Cl组成的三元器件的PCE达到20.92%，填充因子达到82.93%。总体而言，本研究提出的侧链功能化策略为开发高性能非富勒烯受体提供了方向。

title: De-occluding broadband metalens
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Obstructions such as raindrops, fences, or dust degrade images, especially when cleaning is infeasible. Conventional approaches use bulky compound-lens arrays or computational inpainting, compromising compactness or fidelity. Metalenses promise compact imaging, but achieving both broadband and obstruction-free imaging remains challenging, since a metalens cannot simultaneously focus distant scenes and defocus nearby occlusions across a broadband spectrum. We introduce a de-occluding broadband metalens that suppresses obstructions while enabling broadband imaging with a learned phase profile. Our approach divides the spectrum of each color channel into pass and stop bands with multi-band spectral filtering; the metalens focuses light from far objects through pass bands, then light from nearby obstructions falls in the stop bands and is rejected. A neural network further enhances imaging quality. Compared with a conventional hyperbolic metalens under obstructions, our system improves PSNR by 32.29% and raises performance on object detection and two semantic segmentation benchmarks by 13.54%, 48.45% and 20.35%, respectively. This promises robust obstruction-free sensing and vision for compact systems, including mobile robots, drones, and endoscopes.
title_zh: 去遮挡宽带超透镜
abstract_zh: 雨滴、栅栏或灰尘等障碍物会降低图像质量，尤其是在无法清洁的情况下。传统方法使用笨重的复合透镜阵列或计算修复，从而损害了紧凑性或保真度。超透镜承诺紧凑成像，但实现宽带和无障碍成像仍然具有挑战性，因为超透镜无法在宽带频谱上同时聚焦远处的场景和散焦附近的遮挡物。我们引入了一种去遮挡宽带超透镜，它可以抑制障碍物，同时通过学习的相位轮廓实现宽带成像。我们的方法通过多频带光谱滤波将每个颜色通道的光谱分为通带和阻带；超透镜通过通带聚焦来自远处物体的光，然后来自附近障碍物的光落入阻带并被拒绝。神经网络进一步提高了成像质量。与障碍物下的传统双曲元透镜相比，我们的系统将 PSNR 提高了 32.29%，并将目标检测和两个语义分割基准的性能分别提高了 13.54%、48.45% 和 20.35%。这为紧凑型系统（包括移动机器人、无人机和内窥镜）提供了强大的无障碍传感和视觉功能。

title: Dynamic helical poly[4]helicene nanoribbon
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The precise synthesis of helical graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) with a controlled handedness represents a significant advance toward chiral carbon materials. We now report the synthesis of a dynamic helical poly[4]helicene nanoribbon, a class of helical GNRs, entirely composed of configurationally labile [4]helicene subunits, which has been achieved through the quantitative intramolecular multifold cyclization of the nonhelical precursor polymer. The [4]helicene repeating units of the poly[4]helicene nanoribbon are mechanically coupled to each other, leading to correlated helicity inversion dynamics along the highly constrained ladder framework and thereby providing an equal mixture of an interconvertible long sequence of right (P)- and left (M)-handed helical [4]helicene subunits. Therefore, in an optically-active solvent, a fully (P)- or (M)-helical poly[4]helicene nanoribbon consisting of homochiral (P)- or (M)-[4]helicene subunits can be induced in a highly-cooperative manner, showing a right- or left-handed circularly polarized luminescence, respectively, which can be switched.
title_zh: 动态螺旋聚[4]螺旋烯纳米带
abstract_zh: 具有受控旋向性的螺旋石墨烯纳米带（GNR）的精确合成代表了手性碳材料的重大进步。我们现在报道了动态螺旋聚[4]螺旋烯纳米带的合成，这是一类螺旋GNR，完全由构型不稳定的[4]螺旋烯亚基组成，这是通过非螺旋前体聚合物的定量分子内多重环化实现的。聚[4]螺烯纳米带的[4]螺烯重复单元彼此机械耦合，导致沿高度约束的梯形框架相关的螺旋性反转动力学，从而提供可相互转换的右（P）手和左（M）手螺旋[4]螺烯亚基长序列的等量混合物。因此，在光学活性溶剂中，可以以高度协作的方式诱导由纯手性(P)-或(M)-[4]螺烯亚基组成的全(P)-或(M)-螺旋聚[4]螺烯纳米带，分别显示出可以切换的右旋或左旋圆偏振发光。

title: Giant bulk photovoltaic effect driven by interfacial symmetry breaking in MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 heterostructures
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures offer a versatile platform for engineering unconventional bulk photovoltaic (BPV) effect through interfacial symmetry breaking. However, the coexistence of multiple photophysical mechanisms, driven by structural complexity, spontaneous charge transfer, and strong interlayer coupling, often obscures the microscopic origin of the BPV response and hinders its rational optimization. Here, we demonstrate a pronounced BPV effect localized at the overlap region of a cross-bar MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 vdW heterostructure, where symmetry breaking induced by vertical stacking lifts the inversion center of MoS2. The orthogonal device geometry enables the independent probing of intralayer and interfacial photoresponse pathways, facilitating clear separation of competing mechanisms. Spontaneous interfacial charge transfer between MoS2 and Ta2NiSe5 further establishes a strong interlayer electronic coupling. By modulating the interlayer potential landscape through gate voltage and vertical electric fields, we achieve an optimized zero-bias photocurrent density of 247 A/cm2 and a BPV coefficient of 0.99 V−1. Supported by theoretical modeling, our results illustrate how minimalist device geometry can transform complex heterostructures into experimentally tractable platforms. This strategy paves the way for analyzing and optimizing interface-driven BPV effect, with implications for self-powered optoelectronics, broadband photodetection, and energy-harvesting nanodevices.
title_zh: MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 异质结构中界面对称性破缺驱动的巨体光伏效应
abstract_zh: 范德华 (vdW) 异质结构为通过界面对称性破坏来设计非常规体光伏 (BPV) 效应提供了一个多功能平台。然而，在结构复杂性、自发电荷转移和强层间耦合的驱动下，多种光物理机制的共存往往掩盖了BPV响应的微观起源，并阻碍了其合理优化。在这里，我们证明了位于横杆 MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 vdW 异质结构重叠区域的明显 BPV 效应，其中垂直堆叠引起的对称性破缺提升了 MoS2 的反转中心。正交装置几何形状能够独立探测层内和界面光响应路径，促进竞争机制的清晰分离。 MoS2 和 Ta2NiSe5 之间的自发界面电荷转移进一步建立了强大的层间电子耦合。通过栅极电压和垂直电场调节层间电势景观，我们实现了 247 A/cm2 的优化零偏置光电流密度和 0.99 V−1 的 BPV 系数。在理论模型的支持下，我们的结果说明了极简器件几何结构如何将复杂的异质结构转变为实验上易于处理的平台。该策略为分析和优化界面驱动的 BPV 效应铺平了道路，对自供电光电、宽带光电检测和能量收集纳米器件具有影响。

title: Myeloid cell replacement induces intercellular mitochondrial transfer and restores metabolism in a mouse model of mitochondrial disease
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Friedreich’s ataxia (FA) is a mitochondrial disease caused by frataxin deficiency that leads to progressive neurodegeneration and cardiomyopathy. Effective disease-modifying therapies remain limited. Here we show that myeloid cell replacement promotes neurological and cardiac recovery in FA mice through intercellular mitochondrial transfer. Donor-derived mitochondria are transferred from microglia and macrophages to central nervous system cells and cardiomyocytes, increasing oxidative phosphorylation and ATP synthesis gene expression and mitochondrial protein abundance. These molecular changes are accompanied by improved survival and growth in male and female mice and enhanced spontaneous locomotion, strength, coordination and cardiac and function in female mice. In cultured cells, mitochondrial transfer requires direct cell-cell contact and partially restores respiratory capacity in frataxin-deficient recipient cells, which exhibit enhanced mitochondrial uptake, suggesting disease-specific mechanisms that promote mitochondrial acquisition or retention. These findings identify mitochondrial transfer as a mechanism underlying the therapeutic effects of myeloid cell replacement and support hematopoietic transplantation for FA and other mitochondrial disorders.
title_zh: 骨髓细胞替代诱导细胞间线粒体转移并恢复线粒体疾病小鼠模型的代谢
abstract_zh: 弗里德赖希共济失调 (FA) 是一种由 frataxin 缺乏引起的线粒体疾病，可导致进行性神经变性和心肌病。有效的疾病缓解疗法仍然有限。在这里，我们表明骨髓细胞替代通过细胞间线粒体转移促进 FA 小鼠的神经和心脏恢复。供体来源的线粒体从小胶质细胞和巨噬细胞转移到中枢神经系统细胞和心肌细胞，增加氧化磷酸化和 ATP 合成基因表达以及线粒体蛋白丰度。这些分子变化伴随着雄性和雌性小鼠存活和生长的改善，以及雌性小鼠自发运动、力量、协调性以及心脏和功能的增强。在培养细胞中，线粒体转移需要直接的细胞与细胞接触，并部分恢复缺乏 frataxin 的受体细胞的呼吸能力，这些受体细胞表现出增强的线粒体摄取，表明促进线粒体获得或保留的疾病特异性机制。这些发现将线粒体转移确定为骨髓细胞替代治疗效果的潜在机制，并支持造血移植治疗 FA 和其他线粒体疾病。

title: Estimating genetic correlation jointly using individual-level and summary-level GWAS data
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: With increasing access to individual-level data from genome-wide association studies, it is now common for researchers to have individual-level data of some traits, whereas for other traits only publicly released summary statistics are available due to privacy and safety concerns. Current genetic-correlation methods require both traits to be in the same format. When one trait has individual-level data and the other has only summary statistics, researchers often convert individual-level data to summary statistics and then apply summary-based methods, which is inefficient and can lose information. Here we introduce GENJI, a method for estimating within-population or transethnic genetic correlation based on individual-level data for one trait and summary-level data for the other. Across extensive simulations and real data analyses, GENJI produces more reliable and efficient estimation than summary data-based methods. We further show that more accurate genetic correlation estimation can improve cross-population polygenic risk prediction.
title_zh: 使用个体水平和汇总水平 GWAS 数据联合估计遗传相关性
abstract_zh: 随着全基因组关联研究中个体水平数据的获取越来越多，研究人员现在通常拥有某些性状的个体水平数据，而对于其他性状，出于隐私和安全考虑，只能公开发布的汇总统计数据。当前的遗传相关方法要求两个性状具有相同的格式。当一个性状具有个体层面的数据而另一个性状只有汇总统计数据时，研究人员通常将个体层面的数据转换为汇总统计数据，然后应用基于汇总的方法，这种方法效率低下，并且可能会丢失信息。在这里，我们介绍 GENJI，一种基于一个性状的个体水平数据和另一个性状的汇总水平数据来估计群体内或跨种族遗传相关性的方法。通过广泛的模拟和真实数据分析，GENJI 比基于汇总数据的方法产生更可靠、更高效的估计。我们进一步表明，更准确的遗传相关性估计可以改善跨群体多基因风险预测。

title: Interface-shrunk regulated synthesis of asymmetric ultrafine mono-mesopore Nepenthes with tailored window
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Asymmetric ultrafine mono-mesopore architectures with ultrasmall size, an open window, and unique physicochemical properties offer great opportunities in energy storage, yet their synthesis remains challenging. Inspired by the fast, unidirectional capture ability of Nepenthes, we propose an interface-shrunk monomicelle assembly strategy to synthesize asymmetric ultrafine mono-mesopore nanoparticles (AUMNs) with an open window on hollow shells. These biomimetic nanoparticles (∼45 nm) possess a mono-mesopore cavity (∼40 nm) and an opening window (∼20 nm). Their structural parameters, including window size (15–28 nm), shell thickness (7–14 nm), and cavity size (38–59 nm), are precisely tunable. The resulting AUMNs exhibit a high surface area (1312 m² g⁻¹) and abundant pseudocapacitive sites. As cathodes in zinc-ion hybrid capacitors (ZIHCs), they show low charge-transfer impedance and deliver a maximum capacity of 210 mAh g⁻¹.
title_zh: 具有定制窗口的不对称超细单中孔猪笼草的界面收缩调控合成
abstract_zh: 具有超小尺寸、开放窗口和独特物理化学性质的不对称超细单介孔结构为能量存储提供了巨大的机会，但其合成仍然具有挑战性。受猪笼草快速、单向捕获能力的启发，我们提出了一种界面收缩的单胶束组装策略，以合成在空心壳上具有开窗的不对称超细单介孔纳米颗粒（AUMN）。这些仿生纳米颗粒（~45 nm）具有单介孔腔（~40 nm）和开口窗口（~20 nm）。它们的结构参数，包括窗口尺寸（15-28 nm）、壳厚度（7-14 nm）和腔尺寸（38-59 nm），都是精确可调的。由此产生的AUMN表现出高表面积（1312平方米g-1）和丰富的赝电容位点。作为锌离子混合电容器 (ZIHC) 的阴极，它们表现出较低的电荷转移阻抗，并提供 210 mAh g⁻1 的最大容量。

title: Spin state and orbital engineering of cuprous oxide for efficient nitrate reduction
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Electrocatalytic nitrate reduction provides a sustainable pathway for wastewater treatment and ammonia production, yet the complex multi‑electron transfer demands efficient catalysts to achieve both high selectivity and fast kinetics. Here we show that atomic substitution of magnetic transition metals (Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni) into cuprous oxide enables systematic tuning of catalytic performance. Density functional theory calculations combined with experiments identify that catalytic activity is governed by nitrate adsorption strength, ammonia desorption energy, and d–p orbital hybridization. Cobalt‑substituted cuprous oxide delivers a near‑unity Faradaic efficiency of 96.5% and an ammonia yield rate of 2.8 mM h−1 mgcat−1, showing favorable performance compared with the other metal‑doped counterparts. Mechanistic studies reveal that cobalt substitution alters the spin configuration at the active sites, which optimizes orbital hybridization and balances the adsorption and desorption of key intermediates. This work establishes a design principle linking atomic‑level spin and orbital engineering to catalytic performance, providing a framework for developing high‑performance nitrate reduction electrocatalysts.
title_zh: 用于高效还原硝酸盐的氧化亚铜的自旋态和轨道工程
abstract_zh: 电催化硝酸盐还原为废水处理和氨生产提供了可持续的途径，但复杂的多电子转移需要高效的催化剂来实现高选择性和快速动力学。在这里，我们表明，磁性过渡金属（Cr、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni）原子替换为氧化亚铜能够系统地调节催化性能。密度泛函理论计算与实验相结合，确定催化活性受硝酸盐吸附强度、氨解吸能和 d-p 轨道杂化的影响。钴取代的氧化亚铜具有接近 96.5% 的法拉第效率和 2.8 mM h−1 mgcat−1 的氨产率，与其他金属掺杂的对应物相比，显示出良好的性能。机理研究表明，钴取代改变了活性位点的自旋构型，从而优化了轨道杂化并平衡了关键中间体的吸附和解吸。这项工作建立了将原子级自旋和轨道工程与催化性能联系起来的设计原则，为开发高性能硝酸盐还原电催化剂提供了框架。

title: Unlocking intrinsic TADF in flexible crystalline covalent organic frameworks through nanopore confinement design
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) combine structural precision with synthetic versatility, yet their crystalline lattices intrinsically waste 75% of electro-generated excitons as non-emissive triplets. Thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) could harvest these triplets, but its realization in ordered frameworks has been thwarted by a molecular paradox: the conformational flexibility required to minimize the singlet-triplet energy gap (ΔEST) is fundamentally incompatible with the rigidity needed to suppress non-radiative decay in a crystalline lattice. Here we introduce a nanopore-confinement strategy that resolves this dichotomy and unlocks intrinsic TADF in flexible COFs. By embedding conformationally locked donor-acceptor motifs directly into the COF backbone, the spatial constraints of the crystalline nanopores force donor-acceptor pairs into conformations that minimize ΔEST to 0.014 eV, while the rigid framework simultaneously curtails vibrational losses. This approach transforms COFs from passive scaffolds into active platforms for exciton management without compromising crystallinity, film integrity, or processability, yielding free-standing films with high photoluminescence quantum yields and enabling solution-processed OLEDs with competitive performance among crystalline porous emitters. Our work provides an effective strategy for functionalizing porous frameworks through precise manipulation of excited-state dynamics, opening avenues for flexible electronics, photocatalysis, and beyond.
title_zh: 通过纳米孔限制设计解锁柔性晶体共价有机框架中的内在 TADF
abstract_zh: 共价有机框架 (COF) 将结构精度与合成多功能性结合在一起，但其晶格本质上会浪费 75% 的电产生激子作为非发射三重态。热激活延迟荧光（TADF）可以收获这些三重态，但它在有序框架中的实现受到了分子悖论的阻碍：最小化单重态-三重态能隙（ΔEST）所需的构象灵活性从根本上与抑制晶格中非辐射衰变所需的刚性不相容。在这里，我们引入了一种纳米孔限制策略，可以解决这种二分法并释放柔性 COF 中固有的 TADF。通过将构象锁定的供体-受体基序直接嵌入COF主链中，晶体纳米孔的空间限制迫使供体-受体对形成将ΔEST最小化至0.014 eV的构象，而刚性框架同时减少了振动损失。这种方法将 COF 从被动支架转变为用于激子管理的主动平台，而不影响结晶度、薄膜完整性或可加工性，产生具有高光致发光量子产率的独立薄膜，并使溶液加工的 OLED 在结晶多孔发射器中具有竞争性的性能。我们的工作提供了一种有效的策略，通过精确操纵激发态动力学来功能化多孔框架，为柔性电子、光催化等开辟途径。

title: Breaking the grain size limit of glass-crystallized transparent nanoceramics via multi-phase interface locking
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Nanoceramics from sintering routes are challenging to process due to difficulties in deagglomerating nanopowders, suppressing grain growth, and eliminating macroscopic defects. Glass crystallization offers new possibilities by first densifying materials to optical transparency in amorphous form and then fully crystallizing into ceramic form. However, refining the grain size within the nanocrystalline regime is again challenging, due to rapid grain growth under large crystallization driving force and nucleation-controlled kinetics. Here we tackle the problem by decomposing the homogeneous glass precursors into ternary phase composite ceramics, thus coupling the coarsening kinetics to slow cation diffusion required for phase partitioning and hetero-phase boundary motion required for grain growth. The design allows precise adjustment of the evolving microstructure and yields a fine grain size down to ~16 nm in fully crystallized ceramics. We demonstrate that the obtained nanoceramics can deliver high optical transparency, despite the different refractive indices of the cubic La(Al1/3Ti2/3)O3, Y2(Zr0.6Ti0.4)2O7 and transitional Al2O3 phases, and improved mechanical properties. Our work unlocks the hidden opportunities of designing and producing phase-complex nanoceramics in high-dimensional compositional space beyond the traditional phase-pure solubility constraint.
title_zh: 通过多相界面锁定打破玻璃晶透明纳米陶瓷的晶粒尺寸限制
abstract_zh: 由于难以解聚纳米粉末、抑制晶粒生长和消除宏观缺陷，烧结路线的纳米陶瓷的加工具有挑战性。玻璃结晶提供了新的可能性，首先将材料致密化至无定形形式的光学透明性，然后完全结晶成陶瓷形式。然而，由于大结晶驱动力和成核控制动力学下晶粒快速生长，细化纳米晶态内的晶粒尺寸再次具有挑战性。在这里，我们通过将均质玻璃前驱体分解成三元相复合陶瓷来解决这个问题，从而将粗化动力学与相分配所需的减慢阳离子扩散和晶粒生长所需的异相边界运动耦合起来。该设计可以精确调整不断发展的微观结构，并在完全结晶的陶瓷中产生细至约 16 nm 的晶粒尺寸。我们证明，尽管立方体 La(Al1/3Ti2/3)O3、Y2(Zr0.6Ti0.4)2O7 和过渡 Al2O3 相的折射率不同，所获得的纳米陶瓷仍具有高光学透明度，并改善了机械性能。我们的工作解锁了在高维组成空间中设计和生产复合相纳米陶瓷的隐藏机会，超越了传统的纯相溶解度约束。

title: Physical-economic-health coordination for hydrogen-electrified ship power systems: A triple-layer unified framework
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
title_zh: 氢电船舶电力系统的物理-经济-健康协调：三层统一框架

title: Unveiling centromeric retrotransposon dynamics through a high-quality rye genome assembly
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Rye (Secale cereale L.) is an important cereal crop known for its high yield potential and tolerance to biotic and abiotic stresses. However, its large, repeat-rich, and heterozygous genome has posed challenges for assembly compared to related species such as wheat and barley. Here, we present a high-quality, chromosome-scale genome assembly of the inbred line Lo7, generated using PacBio HiFi, Oxford Nanopore, Hi-C, and BioNano technologies with the TRITEX pipeline. The resulting Lo7_V3 assembly spans 6.76 Gb with a contig N50 of 128 Mb, correcting previous misorientations and fully assembling all seven centromeres. Repetitive clusters containing rye-specific satellite sequences (pSc200 and pSc250) are contiguously assembled. Their chromosomal positions are validated using FISH. Centromeric retrotransposon analysis reveals RLG_Abia and RLG_Abigail as abundant, recently active elements, unlike in wheat. Collectively, the Lo7_V3 genome assembly provides an improved genomic resource for future genomic research in rye and related cereal species.
title_zh: 通过高质量黑麦基因组组装揭示着丝粒逆转录转座子动力学
abstract_zh: 黑麦 (Secale Greeke L.) 是一种重要的谷类作物，以其高产潜力和对生物和非生物胁迫的耐受性而闻名。然而，与小麦和大麦等相关物种相比，其庞大、重复丰富且杂合的基因组给组装带来了挑战。在这里，我们展示了自交系 Lo7 的高质量染色体级基因组组装，该组装是使用 PacBio HiFi、Oxford Nanopore、Hi-C 和 BioNano 技术以及 TRITEX 管道生成的。所得的 Lo7_V3 组装跨度为 6.76 Gb，重叠群 N50 为 128 Mb，纠正了之前的错误方向并完全组装了所有七个着丝粒。包含黑麦特异性卫星序列（pSc200 和 pSc250）的重复簇被连续组装。使用 FISH 验证它们的染色体位置。着丝粒逆转录转座子分析表明，RLG_Abia 和 RLG_Abigail 是丰富的、最近活跃的元素，与小麦不同。总的来说，Lo7_V3 基因组组装为黑麦和相关谷物物种的未来基因组研究提供了改进的基因组资源。

title: In vivo labeling–based proteomic analysis of early follicle oocytes and cisplatin-induced alterations in mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: A systematic proteomic profile of oocytes from early-stage follicles, particularly primordial follicles, is critical to protect female reproductive capacity in the context of chemotherapy, yet progress has been hindered by the rarity of oocyte samples and technical challenges associated with oocyte isolation. In this study, we generated in vivo oocyte protein labeling APEX fluorescent mice. With these mice, we reconstructed the ovary in 3D, enabling precise quantification of follicles and identified 2772 proteins and 2878 gene transcripts in oocytes predominantly from primordial follicles. Proteomic shifts of short-time cisplatin treatment revealed that many altered proteins were involved in DNA damage repair and histone modification. Notably, simultaneous application of cisplatin and EZH2’s inhibitor, GSK126, relieved cisplatin-induced oocyte developmental defects. Our study provides a systematic proteomic characterization of oocytes predominantly from primordial follicles in female mice, and reveals dynamic proteome shifts in response to chemotherapeutic agents, laying the foundation for targeted fertility-preserving strategies.
title_zh: 基于体内标记的小鼠早期卵母细胞蛋白质组学分析和顺铂诱导的改变
abstract_zh: 来自早期卵泡（特别是原始卵泡）的卵母细胞的系统蛋白质组学特征对于在化疗背景下保护女性生殖能力至关重要，但卵母细胞样本的稀有性和与卵母细胞分离相关的技术挑战阻碍了进展。在这项研究中，我们生成了体内卵母细胞蛋白标记 APEX 荧光小鼠。利用这些小鼠，我们以 3D 方式重建了卵巢，从而能够精确量化卵泡，并在主要来自原始卵泡的卵母细胞中鉴定出 2772 个蛋白质和 2878 个基因转录本。短时间顺铂治疗的蛋白质组学变化表明，许多改变的蛋白质参与 DNA 损伤修复和组蛋白修饰。值得注意的是，同时应用顺铂和 EZH2 抑制剂 GSK126 可缓解顺铂诱导的卵母细胞发育缺陷。我们的研究提供了主要来自雌性小鼠原始卵泡的卵母细胞的系统蛋白质组学特征，并揭示了响应化疗药物的动态蛋白质组变化，为有针对性的生育力保存策略奠定了基础。

title: Redox cycling of viral RNA polymerase controls picornavirus replication
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Picornaviruses, including foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV), enterovirus 71 (EV71) and encephalomyocarditis virus (EMCV), are important pathogens that cause fever, herpes, and myocarditis in humans and animals. The interplay between picornaviruses and their hosts remains enigmatic. Here we perform porcine genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screens and identify methionine sulfoxide reductase B3 (MSRB3) as an essential factor for FMDV. MSRB3 deficiency inhibits FMDV replication. Mechanistically, MSRB3 eliminates methionine oxidation of FMDV 3D polymerase and stabilizes its expression. Further studies show that radical SAM domain-containing protein 1 (RSAD1) catalyzes methionine oxidation of FMDV 3D polymerase and promotes its aggregation and subsequent degradation through the autophagy-lysosome pathway. Importantly, RSAD1-MSRB3-mediated redox modification also affects the stability of 3D polymerases of EV71 and EMCV, and regulates their infectivity and pathogenesis both in vitro and in vivo. Collectively, this study corroborates that RSAD1-MSRB3-mediated redox cycling of 3D polymerase plays a conserved function in modulating picornavirus infection, providing insights into viral pathogenesis and broad-spectrum antiviral development.
title_zh: 病毒RNA聚合酶的氧化还原循环控制小核糖核酸病毒复制
abstract_zh: 小核糖核酸病毒，包括口蹄疫病毒（FMDV）、肠道病毒71型（EV71）和脑心肌炎病毒（EMCV），是引起人类和动物发烧、疱疹和心肌炎的重要病原体。小核糖核酸病毒与其宿主之间的相互作用仍然是个谜。在这里，我们进行了猪全基因组 CRISPR/Cas9 筛选，并确定甲硫氨酸亚砜还原酶 B3 (MSRB3) 是口蹄疫病毒的一个重要因子。 MSRB3 缺陷会抑制 FMDV 复制。从机制上讲，MSRB3 消除了 FMDV 3D 聚合酶的甲硫氨酸氧化并稳定其表达。进一步的研究表明，自由基 SAM 结构域蛋白 1 (RSAD1) 催化 FMDV 3D 聚合酶的甲硫氨酸氧化，并通过自噬-溶酶体途径促进其聚集和随后的降解。重要的是，RSAD1-MSRB3介导的氧化还原修饰还会影响EV71和EMCV 3D聚合酶的稳定性，并在体外和体内调节它们的感染性和发病机制。总的来说，这项研究证实了 RSAD1-MSRB3 介导的 3D 聚合酶氧化还原循环在调节小核糖核酸病毒感染中发挥着保守功能，为病毒发病机制和广谱抗病毒药物的开发提供了见解。

title: Genome-wide pQTL mapping in human skin identifies specific genetic regulators and mechanistic links to skin disorders
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding how genetic variation shapes tissue-specific protein expression is fundamental for uncovering disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets. However, the proteomic landscape and its underlying genetic regulation in skin, the largest human organ, remain largely uncharted. Here, we present a population-level skin proteomic dataset, quantifying 5,774 proteins across 248 individuals and revealing substantial inter-individual variation shaped by genetic and non-genetic factors. Genome-wide pQTL analysis identifies 1,765 significant variant–protein associations involving 36 proteins, with 62% unsupported by skin eQTL and 33% not replicated in non-skin pQTL. Integrating skin pQTL with ancestry-matched leprosy GWAS identifies 11 risk proteins through proteome-wide association study (PWAS), with four showing causal evidence from colocalization or Mendelian randomization analyses. Further integration with European GWASs for atopic dermatitis and psoriasis identifies known and novel disease-related proteins, demonstrating the cross-ancestry utility of skin pQTL. Together, this work establishes a valuable resource for skin proteogenomics and disease-gene discovery in dermatology.
title_zh: 人类皮肤全基因组 pQTL 作图确定了特定的遗传调节因子以及与皮肤疾病的机制联系
abstract_zh: 了解遗传变异如何影响组织特异性蛋白质表达对于揭示疾病机制和治疗靶点至关重要。然而，皮肤（最大的人体器官）的蛋白质组景观及其潜在的基因调控在很大程度上仍然未知。在这里，我们提出了一个群体水平的皮肤蛋白质组数据集，对 248 名个体的 5,774 种蛋白质进行了定量，并揭示了由遗传和非遗传因素形成的显着的个体间变异。全基因组 pQTL 分析识别出 1,765 个显着的变异蛋白关联，涉及 36 种蛋白质，其中 62% 不受皮肤 eQTL 支持，33% 未在非皮肤 pQTL 中复制。将皮肤 pQTL 与祖先匹配的麻风病 GWAS 相结合，通过全蛋白质组关联研究 (PWAS) 识别出 11 种风险蛋白，其中 4 种显示了来自共定位或孟德尔随机化分析的因果证据。与欧洲针对特应性皮炎和牛皮癣的 GWAS 的进一步整合鉴定出已知和新型疾病相关蛋白，证明了皮肤 pQTL 的跨祖先效用。总之，这项工作为皮肤病学中的皮肤蛋白质组学和疾病基因发现建立了宝贵的资源。

title: Microglia deploy TAM receptors to kill motor neurons in a mouse model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Activation of microglia is a prominent feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a neurodegenerative disease that leads to the death of motor neurons. A key component of this activation is elevated expression of the TAM receptor tyrosine kinases Axl and Mer (gene name Mertk). Here we show that germline and microglial-restricted inactivation of the Axl and Mertk genes in the SOD1G93A mouse model of ALS leads to an extension of lifespan, which is tied to the preservation of cholinergic motor neurons and neuromuscular synapses. Also elevated on SOD1G93A neuronal surfaces is the essential TAM co-ligand phosphatidylserine, a potent ‘eat-me’ signal through which apoptotic cells are engulfed by microglia. Correspondingly, we find that microglial lysosomes are filled with the remains of cholinergic neurons in the SOD1G93A spinal cord, whereas this accumulation is markedly reduced in the SOD1G93AAxl-/-Mertk-/- cord. Together, these results suggest that microglia phagocytically kill living neurons, and thereby hasten death in ALS.
title_zh: 小胶质细胞利用 TAM 受体杀死肌萎缩侧索硬化症小鼠模型中的运动神经元
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞的激活是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的一个显着特征，ALS 是一种导致运动神经元死亡的神经退行性疾病。这种激活的一个关键因素是 TAM 受体酪氨酸激酶 Axl 和 Mer（基因名称 Mertk）的表达升高。在这里，我们发现，在 ALS 的 SOD1G93A 小鼠模型中，Axl 和 Mertk 基因的种系和小胶质细胞限制性失活会导致寿命延长，这与胆碱能运动神经元和神经肌肉突触的保存有关。 SOD1G93A 神经元表面上的重要 TAM 辅助配体磷脂酰丝氨酸也升高，这是一种有效的“吃我”信号，凋亡细胞通过该信号被小胶质细胞吞噬。相应地，我们发现 SOD1G93A 脊髓中的小胶质细胞溶酶体充满了胆碱能神经元的残留物，而这种积累在 SOD1G93AAxl-/-Mertk-/- 脊髓中显着减少。总之，这些结果表明小胶质细胞吞噬性地杀死活神经元，从而加速 ALS 患者的死亡。

title: Phosphorylation of OTUB1 promotes autophagy initiation under starvation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Eukaryotes initiate autophagy in response to environmental challenges such as nutrient deprivation. However, the mechanisms governing autophagy initiation remain incompletely understood. Here, we demonstrated that OTUB1 phosphorylation plays a key role in starvation-induced autophagy initiation. Specifically, ERK phosphorylates OTUB1 at S118 during starvation. This phosphorylation enables competitive binding of ANXA2 to OTUB1, disrupting its interaction with TRIM29 and enhancing OTUB1 stability. Stabilized OTUB1 upregulated DEPTOR, thereby inhibiting mTOR and inducing autophagy. Furthermore, in vivo studies reveal that fasting-induced OTUB1-mTOR-autophagy axis counteracted Western diet-mediated mTOR activation by restoring ERK-dependent OTUB1 phosphorylation, ultimately ameliorating MASLD progression. Collectively, this study uncovers a phosphorylation-dependent regulatory mechanism controlling OTUB1’s function in nutrient deficiency-triggered autophagy initiation, providing cellular and molecular evidence supporting the therapeutic potential of fasting in alleviating MASLD.
title_zh: OTUB1 磷酸化促进饥饿条件下自噬的启动
abstract_zh: 真核生物启动自噬来应对营养匮乏等环境挑战。然而，控制自噬启动的机制仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们证明了 OTUB1 磷酸化在饥饿诱导的自噬启动中起着关键作用。具体来说，饥饿期间 ERK 在 S118 处磷酸化 OTUB1。这种磷酸化使 ANXA2 能够竞争性结合 OTUB1，破坏其与 TRIM29 的相互作用并增强 OTUB1 稳定性。稳定的 OTUB1 上调 DEPTOR，从而抑制 mTOR 并诱导自噬。此外，体内研究表明，禁食诱导的 OTUB1-mTOR 自噬轴通过恢复 ERK 依赖性 OTUB1 磷酸化来抵消西方饮食介导的 mTOR 激活，最终改善 MASLD 进展。总的来说，这项研究揭示了控制 OTUB1 在营养缺乏引发的自噬启动中的功能的磷酸化依赖性调节机制，提供了支持禁食在缓解 MASLD 方面的治疗潜力的细胞和分子证据。

title: Atmospheric turbulence sensing with structured terahertz beams containing orbital angular momentum
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Clear-air turbulence poses a persistent hazard to aviation, yet it evades conventional weather radar and remains difficult to detect. Existing optical sensing methods falter under severe turbulence and are extremely vulnerable to misalignment between airborne nodes. Here we introduce an atmospheric sensing scheme built on structured terahertz (THz) beams carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM). We derive and experimentally validate an analytical model that maps turbulence-induced OAM modal crosstalk to the refractive index structure constant of the atmosphere. Our simulations and experiments demonstrate that this THz-OAM approach remains robust under severe turbulence where optical systems saturate, and offers orders-of-magnitude greater misalignment resilience. Furthermore, this scheme also enables localization of the dominant turbulent clusters through understanding the interaction of diverging THz-OAM beams with the turbulent medium in the reciprocal propagation paths and simultaneously monitoring water vapor to identify turbulence precursors. This work establishes structured THz-OAM beams as a robust framework for remote atmospheric turbulence inference.
title_zh: 使用包含轨道角动量的结构化太赫兹光束进行大气湍流传感
abstract_zh: 晴空湍流对航空构成持续的危害，但它却能避开传统的气象雷达，并且仍然难以检测到。现有的光学传感方法在严重的湍流下会变得不稳定，并且极易受到机载节点之间未对准的影响。在这里，我们介绍一种基于携带轨道角动量（OAM）的结构化太赫兹（THz）光束的大气传感方案。我们推导并通过实验验证了一个分析模型，该模型将湍流引起的 OAM 模态串扰映射到大气的折射率结构常数。我们的模拟和实验表明，这种 THz-OAM 方法在光学系统饱和的严重湍流下仍然保持鲁棒性，并提供了几个数量级的更大的失准弹性。此外，该方案还通过了解发散的 THz-OAM 光束与相互传播路径中的湍流介质的相互作用，并同时监测水蒸气以识别湍流前兆，实现了主要湍流簇的定位。这项工作建立了结构化太赫兹-OAM 光束作为远程大气湍流推断的稳健框架。

title: High-entropy engineering of spinel catalysts for nonradical catalytic ozonation with improved resistance to humidity and sulfur poisoning
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Conventional catalytic ozonation of electron-rich sulfur-containing pollutants shows limited efficiency due to nonselective oxidation of hydroxyl radicals (•OH) and sulfate-induced deactivation of active metal sites. Here, we synthesized a high-entropy spinel, (CuNiMnCo)Fe2O4, featuring sublattice-resolved electronic reconstruction that enables selective ozone activation and suppresses sulfur poisoning. The catalyst achieves 99% removal of methyl mercaptan (CH3SH), significantly outperforming 51% of CoFe2O4. Spectroscopic analyses and density functional theory calculations reveal that high-entropy doping induces lattice distortion and local coordination disorder, which strengthen A–O–B covalency and inter-site electronic communication. This structural perturbation further drives a sublattice-resolved electronic reconstruction, enriching Co/Mn sites while depleting Fe/Cu/Ni sites. This electronic differentiation promotes cooperative dual-end activation of O3 on Fe–Co/Mn motifs and preferential CH3SH adsorption on Cu/Ni sites. Orbital modulation of Co t2g and Fe eg states near the Fermi level balances interfacial charge transfer, favoring formation of a surface-bound *O3 species over conventional O–O bond cleavage. The resulting spatially separated activation and oxidation sites enable CH3SH mineralization via an electron transfer process while suppressing •OH generation and minimizing sulfate accumulation. This spatially differentiated reaction environment ensures durable performance under humid conditions. These findings establish sublattice-engineered electronic asymmetry as a strategy for selective catalytic ozonation.
title_zh: 用于非自由基催化臭氧化的尖晶石催化剂的高熵工程，提高了对湿度和硫中毒的抵抗力
abstract_zh: 由于羟基自由基 (•OH) 的非选择性氧化和硫酸盐诱导的活性金属位点失活，富电子含硫污染物的传统催化臭氧化效率有限。在这里，我们合成了一种高熵尖晶石 (CuNiMnCo)Fe2O4，其具有亚晶格分辨电子重建功能，能够选择性激活臭氧并抑制硫中毒。该催化剂实现了 99% 的甲硫醇 (CH3SH) 去除率，明显优于 CoFe2O4 的 51%。光谱分析和密度泛函理论计算表明，高熵掺杂会引起晶格畸变和局域配位紊乱，从而增强A-O-B共价性和位点间电子通信。这种结构扰动进一步驱动亚晶格分辨电子重构，富集 Co/Mn 位点，同时耗尽 Fe/Cu/Ni 位点。这种电子分化促进了 Fe-Co/Mn 基序上 O3 的协同双端激活以及 Cu/Ni 位点上 CH3SH 的优先吸附。 Co t2g 和 Feeg 状态在费米能级附近的轨道调制平衡了界面电荷转移，与传统的 O-O 键断裂相比，有利于表面结合 *O3 物种的形成。由此产生的空间分离的活化和氧化位点通过电子转移过程实现 CH3SH 矿化，同时抑制·OH 生成并最大限度地减少硫酸盐积累。这种空间差异化的反应环境确保了在潮湿条件下的持久性能。这些发现建立了亚晶格工程电子不对称性

title: Delivering building demand flexibility for grid-interactive operation: from perception and cognition to decision, execution, and verification
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: As both buildings and power systems undergo rapid decarbonization, demand flexibility (DF) in buildings has emerged as a key enabler for renewable energy integration, grid reliability, energy resilience, and efficient and low carbon operation. By dynamically adjusting building energy use in response to grid requirements, DF can help reduce building operational costs, respond to renewable variability, reduce peak demand, alleviate network congestion, and enhance overall system stability. Consequently, significant research efforts have examined building DF from multiple perspectives, including flexibility definitions, resources, characterization, assessment, optimization, and application scenarios. However, the effective delivery of DF in buildings requires an integrated, end-to-end approach spanning perception, cognition, decision, execution, and verification, which remains a critical gap in the existing literature. This review addresses this gap by proposing a layered architecture that integrates these stages into a coherent framework and provides insights from existing studies in this field. It synthesizes enabling methods, clarifies cross-layer interactions, and examines how data, models, control strategies, implementation mechanisms, and evaluation approaches collectively support DF delivery. Critical cross-layer challenges are identified, and future research priorities for robust and trustworthy DF delivery are outlined. This work establishes a conceptual foundation for advancing interoperable, grid-responsive, and practically deployable DF solutions in buildings, supporting both building decarbonization and more efficient, resilient grid operation
title_zh: 为网格交互操作提供建筑需求灵活性：从感知和认知到决策、执行和验证
abstract_zh: 随着建筑和电力系统快速脱碳，建筑的需求灵活性（DF）已成为可再生能源整合、电网可靠性、能源弹性以及高效低碳运营的关键推动因素。通过根据电网要求动态调整建筑能源使用，DF 可以帮助降低建筑运营成本、应对可再生能源的变化、减少峰值需求、缓解网络拥塞并增强整体系统稳定性。因此，大量的研究工作从多个角度审视了构建 DF，包括灵活性定义、资源、表征、评估、优化和应用场景。然而，在建筑物中有效交付 DF 需要一种涵盖感知、认知、决策、执行和验证的集成的端到端方法，这仍然是现有文献中的一个关键差距。本综述通过提出一种分层架构来解决这一差距，该架构将这些阶段集成到一个连贯的框架中，并提供了该领域现有研究的见解。它综合了支持方法，阐明了跨层交互，并检查了数据、模型、控制策略、实施机制和评估方法如何共同支持 DF 交付。确定了关键的跨层挑战，并概述了稳健且值得信赖的 DF 交付的未来研究重点。这项工作为在建筑物中推进可互操作、网格响应和实际可部署的 DF 解决方案奠定了概念基础，支持

title: Influence of linear, mixed-integer linear, piecewise-linear, and nonlinear thermal power flow models on district heating network design
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Optimization enables cost-effective district heating network design, but scalability constraints limit its applicability to large urban districts. Although many mixed-integer linear programming models rely on linearized thermal power flow models, no study has systematically investigated how regression model choices affect computational scalability and network design quality. Existing benchmarks compare entire optimization frameworks without isolating the impact of the underlying thermal flow model, since the chosen regression directly determines the achievable district size and the design reliability. Thus, this paper systematically compares six regression models for pipe investment costs and heat losses. Piecewise-linear regressions achieve the highest accuracy for investment costs, while logarithmic models achieve the highest accuracy for heat losses. Seven linear, mixed-integer linear, and nonlinear programming formulations based on these regressions are benchmarked across 56 real-world districts with up to 10,000 heat sinks, spanning forced and economic designs, single and multiple design periods, and single and multiple heat sources. A novel hybrid thermal power flow model is introduced, and a nonlinear power flow model incorporating economic connection decisions for heat sinks is implemented. Results reveal that purely linear models offer the shortest solving times but usually yield inferior network designs. Piecewise-linear models achieve the best objective values yet suffer from limited scalability for districts. Affine and hybrid models deliver near-optimal solutions with significantly improved scalability, while constant models sacrifice minimal optimality for substantial gains in solvable district size. For multi-period and economic optimizations, only linear formulations achieve optimal designs for large districts with more than 2250 heat sinks, whereas hybrid and constant models best balance solution quality and computational efficiency for medium-scale systems.
title_zh: 线性、混合整数线性、分段线性和非线性热潮流模型对区域供热管网设计的影响
abstract_zh: 优化可以实现具有成本效益的区域供热网络设计，但可扩展性限制限制了其在大城市地区的适用性。尽管许多混合整数线性规划模型依赖于线性热潮流模型，但没有研究系统地研究回归模型选择如何影响计算可扩展性和网络设计质量。现有的基准比较整个优化框架，而没有隔离底层热流模型的影响，因为所选的回归直接决定了可实现的区域大小和设计可靠性。因此，本文系统地比较了管道投资成本和热损失的六种回归模型。分段线性回归可实现最高精度的投资成本，而对数模型可实现最高精度的热损失。基于这些回归的 7 个线性、混合整数线性和非线性规划公式在 56 个现实世界区域（拥有多达 10,000 个散热器）进行了基准测试，涵盖强制设计和经济设计、单个和多个设计周期以及单个和多个热源。引入了一种新颖的混合热功率流模型，并实现了包含散热器经济连接决策的非线性功率流模型。结果表明，纯线性模型提供最短的求解时间，但通常会产生较差的网络设计。分段线性模型实现了最佳目标值，但区域可扩展性有限。仿射和混合模型提供接近最优的解决方案

title: CD36-mediated lipid-accumulation in reactive microglia contributes to retinal degeneration via the NLRP3-IL-1β pathway in mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Microglia are central regulators of retinal immune homeostasis, yet their pathogenic states in retinal degeneration remain less well understood. Here we identified a distinct subset of lipid-accumulated reactive microglia (aLARM), using scRNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics in NaIO3-induced retinal degeneration mice, predominantly localized to the outer retina. aLARM were conserved across mouse models and patients and uniquely marked by high CD36 expression. Microglia-specific CD36 deletion abolished aLARM-mediated inflammation and degeneration, whereas subretinal transplantation of CD36+ aLARM exacerbated retinal structural destruction and functional impairment. Mechanistically, CD36+ aLARM activated NLRP3 inflammasome and produced IL-1β, engaging IL-1R1 on microglia/macrophages and pericytes/SMCs to amplify a feed-forward inflammatory circuit. Therapeutic CD36 blockade with the neutralizing antibody FA6-152 reduced aLARM formation and protected against neurodegeneration. Together, our findings highlight CD36+ aLARM as a targetable pathogenic microglial population linking neuroinflammation to retinal degeneration, providing a potential foundation for microglia-based precision therapies.
title_zh: CD36 介导的反应性小胶质细胞中的脂质积累通过 NLRP3-IL-1β 途径导致小鼠视网膜变性
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞是视网膜免疫稳态的核心调节因子，但其在视网膜变性中的致病状态仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用 scRNA 测序和空间转录组学在 NaIO3 诱导的视网膜变性小鼠中鉴定了脂质累积反应性小胶质细胞 (aLARM) 的一个独特子集，主要位于外视网膜。 aLARM 在小鼠模型和患者中是保守的，并且以高 CD36 表达为独特标志。小胶质细胞特异性 CD36 缺失消除了 aLARM 介导的炎症和变性，而 CD36+ aLARM 的视网膜下移植加剧了视网膜结构破坏和功能损伤。从机制上讲，CD36+ aLARM 激活 NLRP3 炎症小体并产生 IL-1β，与小胶质细胞/巨噬细胞和周细胞/SMC 上的 IL-1R1 结合，从而放大前馈炎症回路。使用中和抗体 FA6-152 进行治疗性 CD36 阻断可减少 aLARM 形成并防止神经变性。总之，我们的研究结果强调了 CD36+ aLARM 作为一种可靶向的致病性小胶质细胞群体，将神经炎症与视网膜变性联系起来，为基于小胶质细胞的精准治疗提供了潜在的基础。

title: Depletion of davemaoite in Earth’s ambient lower mantle
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The mineralogy of the Earth’s lower mantle is fundamental to understanding the planet’s formation, composition, evolution, and dynamics. However, uncertainties in the elastic properties and phase transitions of CaSiO₃ davemaoite—the third most abundant phase in a pyrolitic lower mantle—have hindered quantitative links between seismic observations and lower-mantle mineralogy. Here we combine Brillouin spectroscopy with resistively heated diamond anvil cell experiments to measure the sound velocities of CaSiO₃ davemaoite up to 80 GPa and 973 K. We show that the tetragonal–cubic phase transition occurs below 900 K throughout the entire lower mantle. Fitting the thermoelastic properties of cubic davemaoite reveals substantially reduced shear-wave velocities at deep lower-mantle conditions. Because of these intrinsically slow velocities, increasing bridgmanite abundance alone cannot reconcile seismic observations for a normal lower mantle containing even small amount of davemaoite. Our results therefore suggest that davemaoite is depleted in the ambient lower mantle but concentrated within LLSVPs, likely as a consequence of late-stage crystallization during magma-ocean differentiation.
title_zh: 地球周围下地幔中达维茂石的消耗
abstract_zh: 地球下地幔的矿物学对于了解地球的形成、组成、演化和动力学至关重要。然而，CaSiO₃ davemaoite（热解下地幔中第三丰富的相）的弹性性质和相变的不确定性阻碍了地震观测和下地幔矿物学之间的定量联系。在这里，我们将布里渊光谱与电阻加热金刚石砧室实验相结合，测量了 CaSiO₃ 达维茂石的声速高达 80 GPa 和 973 K。我们表明，在整个下地幔中，四方-立方相变发生在 900 K 以下。拟合立方达维茂石的热弹性特性揭示了在深部下地幔条件下剪切波速度大大降低。由于这些本质上缓慢的速度，仅增加桥锰矿丰度并不能与含有少量达维茂石的正常下地幔的地震观测相一致。因此，我们的结果表明，davemaoite 在周围的下地幔中耗尽，但集中在 LLSVP 内，这可能是岩浆-海洋分化过程中晚期结晶的结果。

title: Focal mechanism variations reveal mechanical controls on segmentation at oceanic transform faults
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Oceanic transform faults (OTFs) exhibit concurrent slip behaviors, with creep and characteristic earthquakes on localized patches. At the Gofar transform fault on the East Pacific Rise, magnitude 5.5+ earthquakes are bounded by creeping segments that act as persistent rupture barriers, yet the physical controls on this segmentation remain unclear. Here, from one year of ocean bottom seismometer data, we develop a focal mechanism catalog of 2323 earthquakes on the westernmost Gofar transform fault. This catalog enables robust statistical analyses of along-strike variations in faulting type and mechanical properties. Pure strike-slip earthquakes comprise ~31% of events; oblique earthquakes are pervasive; pure reverse and normal events also exist. Faulting types correlate with seismicity-inferred fault segmentation, with reverse and oblique-reverse events clustering in rupture barriers. Coulomb failure modeling shows that the pattern is diagnostic of elevated pore-fluid pressure and mechanical weakness within the barriers. The 2008 M6 mainshock increased focal mechanism diversity across the fault, indicating widespread activation of secondary structures through the seismic cycle. Comparisons with the Blanco and Chain transform faults suggest diverse faulting and along-strike mechanism clustering may be common OTF features, implying that local mechanical properties govern segmentation.
title_zh: 震源机制变化揭示了海洋转换断层分段的机械控制
abstract_zh: 海洋转换断层 (OTF) 表现出并发的滑动行为，并在局部斑块上出现蠕变和特征地震。在东太平洋隆起的戈法尔转换断层处，5.5 级以上地震的边界是作为持续破裂屏障的蠕动段，但对该段的物理控制仍不清楚。在这里，我们根据一年的海底地震仪数据，开发了最西端戈法尔转换断层 2323 次地震的震源机制目录。该目录可以对断层类型和机械特性的沿走向变化进行可靠的统计分析。纯走滑地震占事件的 31%；斜向地震普遍存在；纯逆向事件和正向事件也存在。断层类型与地震活动推断的断层分段相关，反向和倾斜反向事件聚集在破裂屏障中。库仑失效模型表明，该模式可以诊断屏障内孔隙流体压力升高和机械弱点。 2008 年 M6 主震增加了整个断层震源机制的多样性，表明地震周期中次级结构的广泛激活。与布兰科和链转换断层的比较表明，不同的断层和沿走向机制集群可能是常见的 OTF 特征，这意味着局部力学特性控制分段。

title: Quantifying the role of nitrogen in achieving global Sustainable Development Goals
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Achieving the 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) requires balancing well-being with environmental protection, yet the role of nitrogen across these goals remains poorly understood. Here, we show how dietary nitrogen intake and nitrogen release to air and water are associated with SDG progress across 166 countries from 2000 to 2022. Higher per-capita nitrogen intake is positively associated with social and economic SDGs, whereas nitrogen release is negatively associated with environmental goals. Economic development is linked to improved SDG performance but also to greater dietary nitrogen demand and nitrogen losses, while warming is associated with pressure on food systems and nitrogen management. Nitrogen-related factors account for 38% of the variation in SDG scores, compared with 34% for climatic conditions and 28% for socio-economic factors. These findings identify nitrogen management as a cross-cutting component of sustainable development and support strategies that align food security, pollution control and climate adaptation across development contexts.
title_zh: 量化氮在实现全球可持续发展目标中的作用
abstract_zh: 实现 2030 年可持续发展目标 (SDG) 需要平衡福祉与环境保护，但氮在这些目标中的作用仍知之甚少。在这里，我们展示了 2000 年至 2022 年 166 个国家的膳食氮摄入量以及向空气和水中的氮释放如何与可持续发展目标进展相关。较高的人均氮摄入量与社会和经济可持续发展目标呈正相关，而氮释放与环境目标呈负相关。经济发展与可持续发展目标绩效的提高有关，但也与膳食氮需求和氮损失的增加有关，而气候变暖则与粮食系统和氮管理的压力有关。氮相关因素占 SDG 得分变化的 38%，而气候条件和社会经济因素分别占 34% 和 28%。这些发现将氮管理确定为可持续发展的一个跨领域组成部分，并支持在不同发展背景下协调粮食安全、污染控制和气候适应的战略。

title: Ryugu and Bennu preserve primordial isotopic heterogeneity absent from the meteorite record
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ivuna-type (CI) carbonaceous chondrites are commonly used as proxies for the composition of the planet-forming disk because their chemical abundances resemble those of the solar photosphere. However, their isotopic uniformity may reflect pervasive alteration and isotopic averaging rather than preservation of the earliest Solar System reservoirs. Here we show that samples returned from the asteroids Ryugu and Bennu preserve isotopic heterogeneity in major planet-building elements, including magnesium, silicon, and iron, that is absent from CI chondrites and unresolved in other meteorites. These signatures reveal isotopically distinct components that are absent from, or homogenized in, known CI chondrites. We infer that Bennu and Ryugu retain a record of primordial isotopic diversity that was not completely homogenized during disk and parent-body processing. Thus, returned asteroid samples provide access to previously unsampled Solar System material that preserves early isotopic components not fully represented in the meteorite record.
title_zh: Ryugu 和 Bennu 保留了陨石记录中缺失的原始同位素异质性
abstract_zh: 伊武纳型（CI）碳质球粒陨石通常用作行星形成盘成分的代表，因为它们的化学丰度与太阳光球层的化学丰度相似。然而，它们的同位素均匀性可能反映了普遍的蚀变和同位素平均，而不是最早太阳系储层的保存。在这里，我们展示了从小行星 Ryugu 和 Bennu 返回的样本保留了主要行星构建元素的同位素异质性，包括镁、硅和铁，这是 CI 球粒陨石中不存在的，并且在其他陨石中也未得到解决。这些特征揭示了已知 CI 球粒陨石中不存在或均匀化的同位素不同成分。我们推断，本努和龙宫保留了原始同位素多样性的记录，这些记录在盘和母体处理过程中并未完全均质化。因此，返回的小行星样本可以获取以前未采样的太阳系材料，这些材料保留了陨石记录中未完全代表的早期同位素成分。

title: DUSP4 promotes anti-tumor CD8+ T cell function and boosts CAR-T cell efficacy in mouse colorectal cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The activation and function of CD8+ T cells, which are central for anti-tumor immunity, are tightly regulated by extracellular and intracellular signaling pathways. Dual-specificity phosphatases (DUSP), including DUSP4, dephosphorylate serine/threonine and tyrosine residues of proteins to modulate cellular signaling. Here, we investigate the role of DUSP4 in cancer immunity. Patients with colorectal cancers (CRC) with lower DUSP4 expression across the CRC tissue exhibit shorter survival compared to those with higher DUSP4 expression. By contrast, in AOM/DSS-induced male mouse CRC models, global DUSP4 deficiency enhances tumorigenesis and compromises CD8+ T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity. Mechanistically, DUSP4 knockout increases ERK2-mediated expression of the T cell activation regulator Klf2, thereby suppressing KLF2-mediated cytotoxic programs. In a CD19+ CRC xenograft mouse model, CRISPRa-mediated DUSP4 activation promotes anti-CD19 CAR-T cell proliferation and anti-tumor cytotoxicity. Thus, our data show that DUSP4 supports CD8+ T cell cytotoxic functions and suggest that DUSP4 may be a promising therapeutic target for enhancing anti-tumor immunity.
title_zh: DUSP4 促进抗肿瘤 CD8+ T 细胞功能并增强 CAR-T 细胞在小鼠结直肠癌中的功效
abstract_zh: CD8+ T 细胞的激活和功能是抗肿瘤免疫的核心，受到细胞外和细胞内信号通路的严格调控。双特异性磷酸酶 (DUSP)，包括 DUSP4，使蛋白质的丝氨酸/苏氨酸和酪氨酸残基去磷酸化，以调节细胞信号传导。在这里，我们研究了 DUSP4 在癌症免疫中的作用。与 DUSP4 表达较高的患者相比，CRC 组织中 DUSP4 表达较低的结直肠癌 (CRC) 患者的生存期较短。相比之下，在 AOM/DSS 诱导的雄性小鼠 CRC 模型中，整体 DUSP4 缺陷会增强肿瘤发生并损害 CD8+ T 细胞介导的抗肿瘤免疫。从机制上讲，DUSP4 敲除增加了 ERK2 介导的 T 细胞活化调节因子 Klf2 的表达，从而抑制 KLF2 介导的细胞毒性程序。在 CD19+ CRC 异种移植小鼠模型中，CRISPRa 介导的 DUSP4 激活可促进抗 CD19 CAR-T 细胞增殖和抗肿瘤细胞毒性。因此，我们的数据表明 DUSP4 支持 CD8+ T 细胞的细胞毒功能，并表明 DUSP4 可能是增强抗肿瘤免疫的有前途的治疗靶点。

title: Pervasive tropical-forced millennial monsoon variability over the past 3.5 million years
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Earth’s climate has experienced abrupt millennial-scale climate variability (MCV) at least since the early Pleistocene, yet their evolution and drivers remain elusive. A 3.5-million-year decadal-to-centennial-resolved lake sediment sequence from the monsoonal Tibetan Plateau reveals a stepped evolution of MCV that differs in detail from that of North Atlantic records. Lithological and pollen changes show precursor millennial events during the interval ~ 3.5-2.7 million years ago (Ma), with the onset of multiple events at ~ 2.8 Ma. From ~ 2.7 Ma, MCV became a permanent feature of glacial periods, intensifying after ~ 1.5 Ma and extending over both glacial and interglacial periods. The embedded astronomical frequencies of MCV and their persistent linkage with precession indicate a tropical insolation origin, driven by changes in the latitudinal temperature gradient and propagated to the Tibetan Plateau via monsoonal circulation. These findings highlight that both tropical forcing and high-latitude ice-dynamic mechanisms should be considered as “dual engines” of MCV.
title_zh: 过去 350 万年热带强制千年季风的普遍变化
abstract_zh: 至少自更新世早期以来，地球气候经历了突然的千禧年规模的气候变率（MCV），但其演变和驱动因素仍然难以捉摸。来自季风青藏高原的 350 万年十年至百年分辨率的湖泊沉积物序列揭示了 MCV 的阶梯式演化，其细节与北大西洋的记录不同。岩性和花粉变化显示了大约 3.5-270 万年前 (Ma) 期间的前兆事件，多个事件在大约 2.8 Ma 开始。从约 2.7 Ma 开始，MCV 成为冰期的永久特征，在约 1.5 Ma 后增强，并延伸到冰期和间冰期。 MCV 的嵌入天文频率及其与进动的持续联系表明热带日照起源，由纬度温度梯度变化驱动并通过季风环流传播到青藏高原。这些发现强调，热带强迫和高纬度冰动力机制应被视为 MCV 的“双引擎”。

title: Macrophage trained immunity requires a mitochondrial glutamine-restriction checkpoint for antitumor protection in mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Trained immunity enables innate immune cells to acquire memory-like responses, offering a strategy to enhance antitumor immunity. However, the metabolic‒epigenetic mechanisms underlying this process remain poorly defined. Here, we show that lipopolysaccharide-induced macrophage training is encoded by a mitochondrial metabolic checkpoint. Integrated transcriptomic, metabolomic, and epigenomic profiling reveals that TLR4-NF-κB signaling represses SLC1A5_var, a mitochondrial glutamine transporter, limiting glutaminolysis and reducing α-ketoglutarate availability. This metabolic restriction limits removal of the activating histone mark histone H3 lysine 4 trimethylation by KDM5B, thereby maintaining inflammatory gene accessibility. Functionally, pharmacological inhibition or myeloid-specific knockdown of SLC1A5_var potentiates macrophage training and improves tumor control in murine cancer models, whereas enforced SLC1A5_var expression or α-ketoglutarate supplementation abrogates these effects. These findings define an SLC1A5_var-α-ketoglutarate-KDM5B metabolic-epigenetic axis that programs macrophage trained immunity and illustrate how targeted metabolic restriction can be leveraged to enhance innate immune responses against cancer.
title_zh: 巨噬细胞训练的免疫力需要线粒体谷氨酰胺限制检查点来提供小鼠抗肿瘤保护
abstract_zh: 经过训练的免疫力使先天免疫细胞能够获得类似记忆的反应，从而提供了增强抗肿瘤免疫力的策略。然而，这一过程背后的代谢表观遗传机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明脂多糖诱导的巨噬细胞训练是由线粒体代谢检查点编码的。综合转录组学、代谢组学和表观基因组分析表明，TLR4-NF-κB 信号传导抑制 SLC1A5_var（一种线粒体谷氨酰胺转运蛋白），限制谷氨酰胺分解并减少 α-酮戊二酸的可用性。这种代谢限制限制了 KDM5B 对组蛋白 H3 赖氨酸 4 三甲基化的激活组蛋白标记的去除，从而维持了炎症基因的可及性。从功能上讲，SLC1A5_var 的药理抑制或骨髓特异性敲除可增强巨噬细胞训练并改善小鼠癌症模型中的肿瘤控制，而强制 SLC1A5_var 表达或补充 α-酮戊二酸可消除这些作用。这些发现定义了 SLC1A5_var-α-酮戊二酸-KDM5B 代谢表观遗传轴，该轴可对巨噬细胞训练的免疫进行编程，并说明如何利用有针对性的代谢限制来增强针对癌症的先天免疫反应。

title: A redox-regulated RCC1-like protein controls catalase activity in Arabidopsis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) regulate plant growth and stress responses. Catalases play a central role in detoxifying hydrogen peroxide, predominantly within peroxisomes, yet key aspects of catalase regulation remain incompletely understood. Using affinity purification of the UV-B photoreceptor UVR8 coupled with mass spectrometry, we identified CATALASE-INTERACTING RCC1-LIKE 1 (CAIR1), which interacts with all three Arabidopsis catalases and their chaperone NO CATALASE ACTIVITY 1. Loss of CAIR1 reduces catalase activity and causes oxidative stress sensitivity, impaired root growth, and alkaline sensitivity, resembling cat2 and nca1 mutants. CAIR1 promotes peroxisomal import and proper localization of CAT2, preventing CAT2 aggregation and maintaining its activity. CAIR1 undergoes reversible redox-dependent oligomerization that enhances catalase binding, whereas mutation of Cys-356 and Cys-545 compromises this interaction and fails to rescue the oxidative stress sensitivity of cair1 mutants. UV-B weakens CAIR1-catalase interactions and suppresses catalase activity, linking light signalling with redox homeostasis. These findings identify CAIR1 as a redox-responsive regulator of catalase localization and activity.
title_zh: 拟南芥中氧化还原调节的 RCC1 样蛋白控制过氧化氢酶活性
abstract_zh: 活性氧（ROS）调节植物生长和应激反应。过氧化氢酶在过氧化氢解毒中发挥着核心作用，主要在过氧化物酶体内，但过氧化氢酶调节的关键方面仍不完全清楚。利用 UV-B 光感受器 UVR8 的亲和纯化与质谱联用，我们鉴定了过氧化氢酶相互作用 RCC1-LIKE 1 (CAIR1)，它与所有三种拟南芥过氧化氢酶及其分子伴侣 NO CATALASE ACTIVITY 1 相互作用。CAIR1 的缺失会降低过氧化氢酶活性，并导致氧化应激敏感性、根系生长受损和碱性敏感性，类似于 cat2 和 nca1 突变体。 CAIR1 促进过氧化物酶体输入和 CAT2 的正确定位，防止 CAT2 聚集并维持其活性。 CAIR1 经历可逆的氧化还原依赖性寡聚化，增强过氧化氢酶结合，而 Cys-356 和 Cys-545 的突变会损害这种相互作用，并且无法挽救 cair1 突变体的氧化应激敏感性。 UV-B 削弱 CAIR1-过氧化氢酶相互作用并抑制过氧化氢酶活性，将光信号传导与氧化还原稳态联系起来。这些发现将 CAIR1 确定为过氧化氢酶定位和活性的氧化还原响应调节剂。

title: Automated synthetic cell-based screening for designed proteins with emergent functions
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Designing minimal biological systems with emergent functions such as spatiotemporal self-organization is a central goal of bottom-up synthetic biology. While computational optimization and design show promise in accelerating functional protein engineering through Design-Build-Test-Learn cycles, screening libraries for complex functions remains a major challenge. Conventional screens typically lack the spatiotemporal resolution and cell-like confinement required in bottom-up synthetic biology. Here, we present PUREdrop, an automated microfluidic platform that encapsulates and expresses protein libraries in thousands of picoliter-sized synthetic cells per construct. PUREdrop distributes these across predefined wells of a 96-well plate for time-lapse imaging, enabling parallel quantification of expression kinetics and emergent functions. To demonstrate the platform’s potential, we first screen computationally re-designed variants of the bacterial cell division protein FtsZ, and identify variants with altered bundling phenotypes and distinct kinetics. We then extend our screening procedure to general protein modulators of FtsZ and identify a combination that anchors filaments to the interface, producing a ring-like phenotype. PUREdrop bridges computational protein engineering and synthetic cell research, elevating the rational engineering of complex biological function to the next level.
title_zh: 基于细胞的自动合成筛选具有新兴功能的设计蛋白质
abstract_zh: 设计具有时空自组织等新兴功能的最小生物系统是自下而上合成生物学的中心目标。虽然计算优化和设计有望通过设计-构建-测试-学习循环加速功能性蛋白质工程，但筛选复杂功能的库仍然是一项重大挑战。传统的屏幕通常缺乏自下而上的合成生物学所需的时空分辨率和细胞样限制。在这里，我们推出了 PUREdrop，这是一种自动化微流体平台，它在每个构建体的数千个皮升大小的合成细胞中封装和表达蛋白质库。 PUREdrop 将这些分布在 96 孔板的预定义孔中以进行延时成像，从而能够并行量化表达动力学和紧急功能。为了证明该平台的潜力，我们首先筛选经过计算重新设计的细菌细胞分裂蛋白 FtsZ 的变体，并识别具有改变的捆绑表型和不同动力学的变体。然后，我们将筛选程序扩展到 FtsZ 的一般蛋白质调节剂，并鉴定出一种将细丝锚定到界面的组合，产生环状表型。 PUREdrop 连接了计算蛋白质工程和合成细胞研究，将复杂生物功能的合理工程提升到了一个新的水平。

title: Mechanistic basis of LolDF-mediated lipoprotein transport in Acinetobacter
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Lipoprotein trafficking is essential for Gram-negative bacteria to maintain the outer membrane, a permeability barrier critical for survival and antibiotic resistance. While most bacteria employ the canonical LolCDE transporter, Acinetobacter utilizes a noncanonical LolDF system whose mechanism has remained unclear. Here we determine cryo-EM structures of Acinetobacter baylyi LolDF in substrate-bound, AMP-PNP-bound, and LolA-bound states. LolDF forms a symmetric homodimer with a central cavity that accommodates three acyl chains at the membrane level, suggesting lateral extraction of lipoproteins directly from the inner membrane. AMP-PNP-driven conformational changes induce a coordinated symmetric constriction of the cavity that promotes substrate expulsion, distinct from the asymmetric mechanism observed in LolCDE. Functional studies further identify key door-bar residues required for transport and reveal that charged residues at the +3 position function as an inner membrane retention signal. Together, these findings reveal a mechanistically distinct lipoprotein trafficking system and provide a framework for targeting multidrug-resistant Gram-negative pathogens.
title_zh: 不动杆菌中 LolDF 介导的脂蛋白转运的机制基础
abstract_zh: 脂蛋白运输对于革兰氏阴性细菌维持外膜至关重要，外膜是生存和抗生素耐药性至关重要的渗透性屏障。虽然大多数细菌使用经典的 LolCDE 转运蛋白，但不动杆菌使用非经典的 LolDF 系统，其机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们确定了贝氏不动杆菌 LolDF 在底物结合、AMP-PNP 结合和 LolA 结合状态下的冷冻电镜结构。 LolDF 形成对称的同二聚体，其中央空腔可在膜水平容纳三个酰基链，表明直接从内膜横向提取脂蛋白。 AMP-PNP 驱动的构象变化会引起空腔的协调对称收缩，从而促进底物排出，这与 LolCDE 中观察到的不对称机制不同。功能研究进一步确定了运输所需的关键门杆残基，并揭示了 +3 位的带电残基充当内膜保留信号。总之，这些发现揭示了一种机制上不同的脂蛋白运输系统，并为针对多重耐药革兰氏阴性病原体提供了框架。

title: Bidirectional associations between loneliness and physical multimorbidity and the mediating role of social inactivity
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Physical multimorbidity and loneliness are increasingly recognised as public health concerns, but the nature of their potential relationships remains unclear. Here we report bidirectional associations between physical multimorbidity and loneliness in middle-aged and older adults and the mediating role of social inactivity. Longitudinal data from adults aged ≥45 years are analysed across 19 countries from five prospective cohorts: US Health and Retirement Study; English Longitudinal Study on Ageing; Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe; China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study; and Korean Longitudinal Study of Aging. Cox regression models suggest longitudinal associations between physical multimorbidity and loneliness in both directions (from physical multimorbidity to loneliness: adjusted hazard ratio (HR) = 1.25, 95% confidence interval (CI) = 1.20 to 1.30; from loneliness to physical multimorbidity: adjusted HR = 1.10, 95% CI = 1.05 to 1.17). Random-intercept cross-lagged panel models confirm significant association between T1 physical multimorbidity and T3 loneliness, with T2 social inactivity serving as a mediator. These findings suggest that physical multimorbidity and loneliness may create a vicious cycle where each condition exacerbates the other, with social inactivity mediating the direction from physical multimorbidity and loneliness.
title_zh: 孤独与身体多病之间的双向关联以及社交不活动的中介作用
abstract_zh: 身体多病和孤独越来越被认为是公共卫生问题，但它们潜在关系的性质仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了中老年人身体多病与孤独感之间的双向关联以及社交不活动的中介作用。对来自 19 个国家 5 个前瞻性队列的 45 岁以上成年人的纵向数据进行了分析：美国健康与退休研究；英国老龄化纵向研究；欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查；中国健康与养老追踪研究；和韩国老龄化纵向研究。 Cox回归模型表明身体多病和孤独感之间存在双向纵向关联（从身体多病到孤独：调整后的风险比（HR）= 1.25，95％置信区间（CI）= 1.20至1.30；从孤独到身体多病：调整后的HR = 1.10，95％CI = 1.05至1.17）。随机截取交叉滞后面板模型证实了 T1 身体多发病与 T3 孤独感之间存在显着关联，而 T2 社交不活动充当中介。这些发现表明，身体多病症和孤独感可能会造成恶性循环，其中每种情况都会加剧另一种情况，而社交不活动会调节身体多病症和孤独感的方向。
