title: Defect passivation and optical management of triple-junction solar cells
source: Nature
abstract: Perovskite/perovskite/silicon-based triple-junction solar cells are a promising low-cost route to surpass the Shockley–Queisser efficiency limit of single-junction photovoltaics, but their performance is constrained by non-radiative losses in wide-bandgap perovskites and sub-optimal light management across the multilayer stack1-3. Here, we introduce a passivating molecule, 4F-POEABr, which strongly suppresses surface-defect-mediated recombination of WBG perovskite films. The ammonium attached and electron-deficient structure of 4F-POEABr provides combined chemical and field-effect passivation, enabling a quasi-Fermi-level splitting of 1.53 eV and an open-circuit voltage of 1.413 V in the WBG sub-cell. In parallel, systematic interference management is used to optimize the current density of the current-limited middle sub-cell, yielding a gain of 0.5 mA cm⁻2 via a tailored tin oxide/indium zinc oxide bilayer structure. As a result, the triple-junction devices achieve certified steady-state power conversion efficiencies of 32.22% for a 1.046 cm2 aperture area and 26.97% for a 15.62 cm2 aperture area, with negligible hysteresis. Robust interconnection layers and engineered perovskite interfaces further enhance operational stability and reduce device-to-device variation. This work demonstrates a synergistic strategy for pushing perovskite/silicon triple-junction solar cells toward their theoretical efficiency limits, enabling scalable, high-performance photovoltaic technologies.
title_zh: 三结太阳能电池的缺陷钝化和光学管理
abstract_zh: 钙钛矿/钙钛矿/硅基三结太阳能电池是超越单结光伏电池肖克利-奎瑟效率极限的一种有前途的低成本途径，但其性能受到宽带隙钙钛矿的非辐射损耗和多层堆叠中次优光管理的限制1-3。在这里，我们引入了一种钝化分子 4F-POEABr，它可以强烈抑制 WBG 钙钛矿薄膜的表面缺陷介导的重组。 4F-POEABr 的铵附着和缺电子结构提供化学钝化和场效应钝化相结合，从而在 WBG 子电池中实现 1.53 eV 的准费米能级分裂和 1.413 V 的开路电压。同时，系统干扰管理用于优化限流中间子电池的电流密度，通过定制的氧化锡/氧化铟锌双层结构产生 0.5 mA cm-2 的增益。因此，三结器件在 1.046 cm2 孔径面积下实现了 32.22% 的经认证稳态功率转换效率，在 15.62 cm2 孔径面积下实现了 26.97% 的认证稳态功率转换效率，且磁滞可以忽略不计。强大的互连层和工程钙钛矿接口进一步增强了运行稳定性并减少了设备间的差异。这项工作展示了一种协同策略，可将钙钛矿/硅三结太阳能电池推向理论效率极限，从而实现可扩展的高性能光伏技术。

title: Economic and behavioural policy coupling has divergent effects on electric vehicle adoption at individual and system scales
source: Nature Energy
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Policy mixes are key to accelerating low-carbon transitions. Yet, how combined policies impact electric vehicle (EV) adoption decisions and scale up to system-level diffusion remains unclear. Here we combine individual-level and system-level analyses to investigate how a carbon tax and information intervention, implemented individually and in combination, impact individual decision-making and system-wide EV diffusion. Across four countries (Mexico, South Africa, the USA and the UK;
                    N
                     = 1,589), we assessed attention towards EV information in EV choice experiments and integrated decision outcome data into a behavioural agent-based diffusion model (ABM). The policies competed for attention but had additive effects on individual EV adoption choices. When scaled through ABM, these behavioural effects produced sub- or superadditive diffusion outcomes depending on the diffusion stage and national context. Moreover, we endogenously coupled the ABM with policy support data. Our findings illustrate that combining policies can boost policy support relative to a tax alone, translating into sustained diffusion trajectories under different policy review scenarios.
title_zh: 经济和行为政策耦合对个人和系统规模的电动汽车采用产生不同的影响
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    政策组合是加速低碳转型的关键。然而，综合政策如何影响电动汽车 (EV) 的采用决策并扩大到系统级扩散仍不清楚。在这里，我们结合个人层面和系统层面的分析来研究碳税和信息干预（单独和组合实施）如何影响个人决策和全系统电动汽车扩散。跨越四个国家（墨西哥、南非、美国和英国；
                    氮
                     = 1,589），我们评估了 EV 选择实验中对 EV 信息的关注，并将决策结果数据集成到基于行为主体的扩散模型（ABM）中。这些政策争夺注意力，但对个人电动汽车采用选择产生附加影响。当通过 ABM 进行扩展时，这些行为效应会根据扩散阶段和国家背景产生次加性或超加性扩散结果。此外，我们将 ABM 与政策支持数据内生耦合。我们的研究结果表明，相对于单独的税收，组合政策可以增强政策支持，并在不同的政策审查情景下转化为持续的扩散轨迹。

title: B/Pd-Catalyzed Asymmetric Propargylic Substitution for Vicinal Quaternary/Tertiary Stereocenters
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract All-carbon quaternary stereogenic centers are pivotal motifs in bioactive molecules, yet their enantioselective construction in acyclic systems remains a formidable challenge due to severe steric hindrance and conformational flexibility. Although the alkynyl group is a versatile synthetic handle for diverse functionalizations, the catalytic asymmetric synthesis of alkynyl-substituted all-carbon quaternary centers is significantly underdeveloped. Herein, we report an unprecedented asymmetric propargylic substitution of tertiary propargylic carbonates with α-hydroxy ketones, enabled by a synergistic B/Pd dual-catalytic system. Unlike traditional Pd-catalyzed pathways that typically favor allene formation, this protocol uniquely preserves the alkyne moiety to deliver alkynyl-substituted all-carbon quaternary stereocenters bearing a vicinal tertiary stereocenter with excellent diastereo- and enantiocontrol. Notably, the catalytic system effectively overcomes the inherent steric congestion of coupling two bulky partners and achieves the precise discrimination between two sterically and electronically similar alkyl groups (e.g., methyl vs ethyl) on the propargylic carbon. Chiral phosphoramidite-palladium catalysts play a critical role in creating a differentiated chiral environment to achieve exceptional levels of enantioselectivity.
title_zh: B/Pd 催化的邻位四元/三元立构中心的不对称炔丙取代
abstract_zh: 摘要 全碳四元立构中心是生物活性分子中的关键基序，但由于严重的空间位阻和构象灵活性，它们在无环系统中的对映选择性构建仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。尽管炔基是用于多种官能化的通用合成手柄，但炔基取代的全碳四元中心的催化不对称合成明显不发达。在此，我们报告了通过协同 B/Pd 双催化系统实现了叔炔丙碳酸酯与 α-羟基酮的前所未有的不对称炔丙基取代。与通常有利于丙二烯形成的传统钯催化途径不同，该方案独特地保留了炔部分，以提供炔基取代的全碳四元立构中心，该中心带有邻位三级立构中心，具有出色的非对映和对映控制。值得注意的是，该催化系统有效地克服了耦合两个大体积伙伴所固有的空间拥塞，并实现了炔丙碳上两个空间和电子相似的烷基（例如甲基与乙基）之间的精确区分。手性亚磷酰胺-钯催化剂在创造差异化的手性环境以实现卓越水平的对映选择性方面发挥着关键作用。

title: Interface engineering towards high-efficiency perovskite/CIGS tandem solar cells
source: Nature Energy
abstract: The efficiency of perovskite/Cu(In,Ga)Se2 (CIGS) tandem solar cells has been limited by interfacial challenges. Now, a dual-interface engineering strategy enables conformal perovskite coverage on textured CIGS bottom-cell surfaces while increasing carrier extraction at the electron‑ and hole‑transport interfaces. This strategy enables monolithic perovskite/CIGS tandems with a power conversion efficiency of >30% and good stability.
title_zh: 高效钙钛矿/CIGS串联太阳能电池的界面工程
abstract_zh: 钙钛矿/Cu(In,Ga)Se2 (CIGS)串联太阳能电池的效率受到界面问题的限制。现在，双界面工程策略可以在纹理化的 CIGS 底部电池表面上实现保形钙钛矿覆盖，同时增加电子和空穴传输界面的载流子提取。这种策略使得单片钙钛矿/CIGS串联具有>30%的功率转换效率和良好的稳定性。

title: Microbial superoxide production drives biogenic nitrogen dioxide formation in soils
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) is a critical atmospheric pollutant and ozone precursor, yet biogenic soil sources remain poorly constrained. Current models assume soil NO2 flux is exclusively depositional. Here we demonstrate that soils can produce NO2 through microbial superoxide (O2ˉ) production. Using controlled factorial slurry experiments, native microbial communities produced approximately 10 times more NO2 than sterile controls following nitric oxide (NO) exposure. Stimulating superoxide production with NADH increased NO2 formation 15- to 26-fold, while inhibiting NADH oxidase reduced production toward baseline levels. Superoxide dismutase decreased NO2 production by 46-71%, and O2ˉ concentration explained 60% of variation in NO2 production rates. Addition of peroxynitrite to soil increased headspace NO2, confirming this intermediate as the mechanistic link. These findings reveal a pathway linking carbon and nitrogen cycling where heterotrophic decomposers facilitate biogenic NO-to-NO2 conversion via superoxide chemistry, potentially explaining discrepancies between satellite observations and modelled soil NOx emissions.
title_zh: 微生物超氧化物的产生驱动土壤中生物二氧化氮的形成
abstract_zh: 二氧化氮 (NO2) 是一种重要的大气污染物和臭氧前体，但生物土壤源仍然很少受到限制。目前的模型假设土壤二氧化氮通量完全是沉积的。在这里，我们证明土壤可以通过微生物超氧化物 (O2ˉ) 的产生来产生 NO2。通过受控阶乘浆料实验，原生微生物群落在接触一氧化氮 (NO) 后产生的 NO2 比无菌对照多约 10 倍。用 NADH 刺激超氧化物的产生可使 NO2 的形成增加 15 至 26 倍，而抑制 NADH 氧化酶则可将产生量降低至基线水平。超氧化物歧化酶使 NO2 产量减少 46-71%，O2ˉ 浓度解释了 NO2 产量变化的 60%。向土壤中添加过氧亚硝酸盐会增加顶空 NO2 的含量，从而证实了该中间体是机械联系。这些发现揭示了一条连接碳和氮循环的途径，其中异养分解者通过超氧化物化学促进生物一氧化氮转化为二氧化氮，这可能解释了卫星观测和模拟土壤氮氧化物排放之间的差异。

title: Decarbonizing the EU cement industry under technology and policy uncertainty
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cement production is a major source of CO2 emissions. In the European Union, the Emissions Trading System is the cornerstone instrument to incentivize industry decarbonization, including cement. However, major uncertainties prevail regarding allowance prices, carbon-capture investment costs, and the availability of CO2 pipelines and storage sites. These uncertainties affect real-world investment decisions, but are not yet well represented in models. Here, we develop a real options valuation model to assess how 179 cement plants across Europe respond to these uncertainties. Our results show that uncertainty perception strongly influences the timing and geography of investments. High confidence in favorable investment determinants could lead to widespread deployment of carbon capture and storage and biomass use, turning the cement industry into a carbon sink with 0.6 gigatons CO₂ removed between 2025 and 2050 in total. Low confidence, however, could lead many cement producers to delay action, resulting in cumulated emissions of 0.8 gigatons CO₂ over the same time frame. Biomass availability, financing conditions, and plant location further shape investment behavior, underscoring the need for credible energy and climate policy.
title_zh: 技术和政策不确定性下欧盟水泥行业脱碳
abstract_zh: 水泥生产是二氧化碳排放的主要来源。在欧盟，排放交易体系是激励包括水泥在内的行业脱碳的基石工具。然而，在配额价格、碳捕获投资成本以及二氧化碳管道和封存地点的可用性方面仍存在重大不确定性。这些不确定性影响现实世界的投资决策，但尚未在模型中得到很好的体现。在这里，我们开发了一个实物期权估值模型来评估欧洲 179 家水泥厂如何应对这些不确定性。我们的结果表明，不确定性感知强烈影响投资的时机和地域。对有利投资决定因素的高度信心可能会导致碳捕获和储存以及生物质利用的广泛部署，从而将水泥行业转变为碳汇，在 2025 年至 2050 年间总共消除 0.6 十亿吨二氧化碳。然而，信心不足可能会导致许多水泥生产商推迟行动，导致同一时间段内累计排放 0.8 十亿吨二氧化碳。生物质的可用性、融资条件和工厂位置进一步影响投资行为，凸显了对可靠能源和气候政策的需求。

title: Long-term decline in above-ground carbon sinks in Brazilian tropical and subtropical forests
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Recent evidence indicates that Brazilian forests are shifting from persistent carbon sinks to emerging carbon sources, with important implications for the global climate. To investigate this trend, we analyse long-term census data from 49 forest sites spanning southeast and southern Brazil, including tropical and subtropical forests. We examine above-ground carbon dynamics and its relationship with tree diversity and functional traits that are tightly linked with species’ carbon processing and storage capacities. Our findings reveal a long-term trend of taxonomic, functional and phylogenetic homogenisation and a decline in the forests’ above-ground carbon sink. Specifically, homogeneous forests have lower carbon losses, whilst forests with more conservative species are associated with greater carbon gains and lower carbon losses. Overall, our study establishes a baseline to understand and predict the above-ground carbon sink in the face of ongoing climate change in this region.
title_zh: 巴西热带和亚热带森林地上碳汇长期下降
abstract_zh: 最近的证据表明，巴西森林正在从持久性碳汇转向新兴碳源，对全球气候产生重要影响。为了调查这一趋势，我们分析了巴西东南部和南部 49 个森林点（包括热带和亚热带森林）的长期人口普查数据。我们研究了地上碳动态及其与树木多样性和功能性状的关系，这些多样性和功能性状与物种的碳处理和储存能力密切相关。我们的研究结果揭示了分类、功能和系统发育同质化的长期趋势以及森林地上碳汇的下降。具体来说，同质的森林具有较低的碳损失，而具有更保守物种的森林则具有更大的碳增益和较低的碳损失。总体而言，我们的研究建立了一个基线，以了解和预测该地区面临持续气候变化时的地上碳汇。

title: Net-negative carbon valorization in wastewater treatment via sequential thermochemical-electrochemical coupling
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Wastewater treatment plants simultaneously emit greenhouse gases and rely on external carbon sources, presenting both a challenge and an opportunity for carbon circularity. We develop a comprehensive life-cycle assessment of 32 Waste-to-Chemical pathways that integrate thermochemical and electrochemical conversions in sequential or parallel architectures to convert CH4 and CO2 into reusable carbon sources for in-plant utilization. Sequential thermochemical-electrochemical coupling consistently delivers the strongest climate benefit, with formate identified as the optimal product, reducing emissions up to ~35% reduction relative to direct-emission baselines. We further validate this pathway experimentally using commercially available Pd/Al2O3 catalysts for CH4 thermochemical oxidation and Bi2O3 catalysts for CO2 electroreduction in a porous solid electrolyte reactor. Residual heat generated during CH4 oxidation enhances downstream CO2 electroreduction, enabling 97.2 ± 1.2% Faradaic efficiency toward separation-free formate at 150 mA cm−2 and 45 °C. These results validate that commercially relevant catalysts and thermally coupled operation can deliver experimentally validated performance aligned with system-level projections. This framework establishes a scalable strategy for embedding carbon circularity into wastewater infrastructure and transforming wastewater treatment plants into distributed platforms for low-carbon chemical production.
title_zh: 通过顺序热化学-电化学耦合实现废水处理中的净负碳增值
abstract_zh: 废水处理厂同时排放温室气体并依赖外部碳源，这对碳循环既是挑战也是机遇。我们对 32 条废物转化为化学品的途径进行了全面的生命周期评估，这些途径将热化学和电化学转化集成在顺序或并行架构中，将 CH4 和 CO2 转化为可重复使用的碳源，供厂内利用。顺序热化学-电化学耦合始终提供最强的气候效益，甲酸盐被认为是最佳产品，相对于直接排放基线，排放量减少高达约 35%。我们使用市售的 Pd/Al2O3 催化剂（用于 CH4 热化学氧化）和 Bi2O3 催化剂（用于 CO2 电还原）在多孔固体电解质反应器中进一步通过实验验证了该途径。 CH4 氧化过程中产生的余热增强了下游 CO2 电还原，在 150 mA cm−2 和 45 °C 下实现无分离甲酸盐的法拉第效率为 97.2 ± 1.2%。这些结果验证了商业相关的催化剂和热耦合操作可以提供与系统级预测一致的经过实验验证的性能。该框架建立了一个可扩展的战略，将碳循环嵌入废水基础设施中，并将废水处理厂转变为低碳化学品生产的分布式平台。

title: Facilitating megacity electricity decarbonization via grid-interactive demand-side resource management
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: City power systems face intensified mismatches between generation and dynamic demand under rising zero-carbon energy penetration levels. Although demand-side resource management offers mismatch mitigation potential by regulating load patterns, its city-level capability remains unclear. This study develops a community-to-grid framework to assess how demand-side resources could mitigate generation-demand mismatches at the megacity scale. A case study is performed in Shenzhen, China, covering 4,549 community units with energy profiles and rooftop photovoltaics of 479,259 buildings, and travel-charge profiles of 1,080,000 private plug-in electric vehicles. Under an assumed 80% zero-carbon electricity penetration level, the proposed framework could reduce weekly power supply deficits by 54.5%, or 266.2 gigawatt-hours, corresponding to an estimated reduction of 83.6 kilotonnes of carbon dioxide. Different governing paradigms may affect grid infrastructure upgrade paths: prioritizing administrative equity supports temporally consistent planning, whereas prioritizing mismatch-mitigation efficiency promotes spatially clustered retrofitting. This study may inform city-specific demand-side resource excavation under national electricity decarbonization planning.
title_zh: 通过电网互动需求侧资源管理促进特大城市电力脱碳
abstract_zh: 在零碳能源渗透水平不断提高的情况下，城市电力系统面临发电与动态需求之间加剧的不匹配。尽管需求方资源管理通过调节负荷模式提供了缓解不匹配的潜力，但其城市级能力仍不清楚。本研究开发了一个社区到电网的框架，以评估需求方资源如何缓解特大城市规模的发电与需求不匹配的问题。我们在中国深圳进行了一项案例研究，涵盖了 4,549 个社区单位，包括 479,259 座建筑物的能源概况和屋顶光伏发电，以及 1,080,000 辆私人插电式电动汽车的出行充电概况。在假设 80% 的零碳电力渗透水平下，拟议的框架可以将每周的电力供应赤字减少 54.5%，即 266.2 吉瓦时，相当于估计减少 83.6 千吨二氧化碳。不同的治理范式可能会影响电网基础设施升级路径：优先考虑管理公平支持时间上一致的规划，而优先考虑错配缓解效率则促进空间集群改造。这项研究可以为国家电力脱碳规划下特定城市的需求侧资源挖掘提供信息。

title: A protein–foldamer supramolecular synthon for self-assembled hybrid architectures
source: Nature Chemistry
abstract:
Abstract
                  Constructing artificial assemblies that combine proteins and synthetic ligands has been hampered by the lack of protein–ligand interfaces that are sufficiently large and organized to enable precise structural control. Here ribosome display selection is used to identify a protein that binds a helical aromatic foldamer both tightly and selectively through a sizeable surface area. We used this complex as a supramolecular synthon to create well-defined hybrid foldamer–protein architectures. Examples include foldamers that bind two proteins and hold them at a precise distance, proteins that bind two foldamers and crystals in which proteins and foldamers are connected in cyclic or infinite arrays. The modularity of aromatic foldamers brings a further dimension to protein-based assemblies.
title_zh: 用于自组装混合结构的蛋白质折叠超分子合成子
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  由于缺乏足够大且有组织的蛋白质-配体界面以实现精确的结构控制，构建结合蛋白质和合成配体的人工组装体一直受到阻碍。这里，核糖体展示选择用于识别通过相当大的表面积紧密且选择性地结合螺旋芳香折叠体的蛋白质。我们使用这种复合物作为超分子合成子来创建明确的混合折叠体-蛋白质结构。例子包括结合两个蛋白质并将它们保持在精确距离的折叠体、结合两个折叠体的蛋白质以及其中蛋白质和折叠体以循环或无限阵列连接的晶体。芳香折叠体的模块化为基于蛋白质的组装带来了进一步的维度。

title: A zero-degradation elastocaloric cooling device using fatigue-resistant refrigerant
source: Joule
abstract: A fatigue-resistant shape memory alloy was integrated into a carefully engineered elastocaloric device with high mechanical reliability. The device delivered 400 watts of cooling power and a 41 Kelvin temperature span over one million operation cycles, highlighting a promising route toward durable solid-state cooling.
title_zh: 一种使用抗疲劳制冷剂的零退化弹热冷却装置
abstract_zh: 抗疲劳形状记忆合金被集成到精心设计的弹性热量装置中，具有高机械可靠性。该设备可提供 400 瓦的冷却功率和 41 开尔文的温度跨度，运行次数超过一百万次，凸显了实现持久固态冷却的一条有前途的途径。

title: An Artificial Molecular Transducer Driven by Molecular Recognition
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Nature’s biological machines employ signaling molecules to regulate complex functions, but replicating these functions in artificial systems remains challenging. Here, we report an artificial molecular transducer whose operation is driven by the molecular recognition of exogenous signaling molecules. The transducer lacks an effective binding cavity in its as-prepared form. Treatment with appropriate signaling molecules then induces conformational changes that create an accessible cavity suitable for guest recognition. Using anthracene as a photoresponsive signaling molecule enables control over guest binding and release. This allows the transducer to mediate the transport of representative small molecules across a centimeter-thick aqueous layer in both down-gradient and up-gradient modes, and to promote a transport-enabled bioorthogonal reaction.
title_zh: 分子识别驱动的人工分子传感器
abstract_zh: 摘要 自然界的生物机器利用信号分子来调节复杂的功能，但在人工系统中复制这些功能仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了一种人工分子传感器，其操作是由外源信号分子的分子识别驱动的。换能器在其制备形式中缺乏有效的结合腔。然后用适当的信号分子处理诱导构象变化，从而创建适合客人识别的可进入空腔。使用蒽作为光响应信号分子可以控制客体结合和释放。这使得传感器能够以向下梯度和向上梯度模式介导代表性小分子穿过厘米厚的水层的传输，并促进支持传输的生物正交反应。

title: Shortwave-Infrared (SWIR) Tetrabenzannulated Silicon-Rhodamine
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract In vivo imaging is the key to the success of transformative biomedical technologies. Currently, robust dyes absorbing and emitting in the shortwave infrared (SWIR) spectral region, i.e., 1000 nm and beyond, as well as a standard protocol to evaluate their performance in in vivo imaging, are sought after. Here, we report the rational design of the tetrabenzannulated silicon-rhodamine dye (ESi7), following the three-step guideline of benzannulation for long wavelength, steric shielding for stability, and deep rigidification for brightness and its convergent synthesis. Compared to its carbon-bridged predecessor (EC7), the highlights of ESi7 are its increased ring strain, reduced vibrational freedom, and improved fluorescence lifetime. ESi7 exhibits a remarkable fluorescence quantum yield of 0.19% in CH2Cl2, the highest for a small-molecule fluorophore absorbing/emitting at 1176/1275 nm to the best of our knowledge. Endowed by its long spectral wavelength, robust photo/chemo-stability, and high fluorescence brightness, in vivo mouse imaging with ESi7 set up a “PEAK” standard, an acronym for “Penetration depth, Exposure time, Acquisition duration, and Contrast”.
title_zh: 短波红外 (SWIR) 四苯并硅罗丹明
abstract_zh: 摘要 体内成像是变革性生物医学技术成功的关键。目前，人们寻求在短波红外 (SWIR) 光谱区域（即 1000 nm 及以上）吸收和发射的强大染料，以及评估其体内成像性能的标准方案。在这里，我们报告了四苯环化硅罗丹明染料（ESi7）的合理设计，遵循长波长的苯环化、稳定性的空间屏蔽和亮度的深度刚性化的三步指南及其聚合合成。与其碳桥前身 (EC7) 相比，ESi7 的亮点在于其环应变增加、振动自由度降低以及荧光寿命延长。 ESi7 在 CH2Cl2 中表现出 0.19% 的显着荧光量子产率，据我们所知，这是小分子荧光团在 1176/1275 nm 处吸收/发射的最高荧光量子产率。凭借其长光谱波长、强大的光/化学稳定性和高荧光亮度，ESi7 的体内小鼠成像建立了“PEAK”标准，即“穿透深度、曝光时间、采集持续时间和对比度”的缩写。

title: Iterative Enoyl Reduction by a FabV-Family Enzyme Expands the Chemical Landscape of Discrete Polyketide Synthases
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Polyketides are a structurally diverse class of natural products with immense therapeutic potential. However, the biosynthetic output of discrete polyketide synthases (PKSs) has been constrained by a fundamental functional limitation: unlike modular Type I systems, discrete PKS systems typically lack integrated enoyl reductase (ER) activity. This constraint restricts their chemical repertoire primarily to unsaturated polyenes or aromatic scaffolds. Here, we characterize PbrC16, a FabV-family ER from a manumycin-type biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) in Peterkaempfera bronchialis. This enzyme represents the first experimentally validated ER capable of functioning within discrete PKS architectures. In vitro biochemical reconstitution demonstrates that PbrC16 along with its homologue ScFabV catalyze iterative enoyl reductions in both β-ketoacyl–acyl carrier protein synthase III (KAS III)-dependent and highly reducing (HR) Type II PKS contexts, enabling the complete saturation of long-chain polyketide intermediates. Structural and computational analyses reveal the molecular basis for its exceptional substrate promiscuity and versatile acyl carrier protein (ACP) recognition. These findings resolve a long-standing “reductive gap” in discrete PKS biology and provide a “plug-and-play” module for the rational engineering of saturated polyketide scaffolds.
title_zh: FabV 系列酶的迭代烯酰还原扩展了离散聚酮化合物合成酶的化学景观
abstract_zh: 摘要 聚酮化合物是一类结构多样的天然产物，具有巨大的治疗潜力。然而，离散聚酮合酶 (PKS) 的生物合成输出受到基本功能限制的限制：与模块化 I 型系统不同，离散 PKS 系统通常缺乏集成的烯酰还原酶 (ER) 活性。这种限制将它们的化学成分主要限制在不饱和多烯或芳香族支架上。在这里，我们表征了 PbrC16，它是来自 Peterkaempfera bronchialis 中手霉素型生物合成基因簇 (BGC) 的 FabV 家族 ER。该酶代表了第一个经过实验验证的能够在离散 PKS 架构中发挥作用的 ER。体外生化重构表明，PbrC16 及其同源物 ScFabV 在 β-酮酰基-酰基载体蛋白合酶 III (KAS III) 依赖性和高度还原 (HR) II 型 PKS 环境中催化迭代烯酰还原，从而实现长链聚酮化合物中间体的完全饱和。结构和计算分析揭示了其特殊的底物混杂性和多功能酰基载体蛋白（ACP）识别的分子基础。这些发现解决了离散 PKS 生物学中长期存在的“还原差距”，并为饱和聚酮化合物支架的合理工程提供了“即插即用”模块。

title: Diffusionless mechanisms produce diffusion-like electrochemistry in battery particles
source: Nature Energy
abstract: Overpotentials at low frequencies in Li-ion battery active particles have long been attributed to solid diffusion. Now, electrolyte penetration in battery agglomerate particles is shown to make interior surfaces electrochemically active, but with a transmission-line configuration. This mechanism for accessing battery capacity produces diffusion-like electrochemistry, even without diffusion involved.
title_zh: 无扩散机制在电池颗粒中产生类似扩散的电化学
abstract_zh: 长期以来，锂离子电池活性颗粒的低频过电势一直被归因于固体扩散。现在，电解质渗透到电池团聚颗粒中已被证明可以使内表面具有电化学活性，但具有传输线配置。即使不涉及扩散，这种获取电池容量的机制也会产生类似扩散的电化学。

title: Rechargeable Aluminum-Organic Batteries with Electro-Oligomers
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Rechargeable Al-organic batteries using an Al metal anode and organic cathode are promising next-generation energy storage devices with high safety, but with limitations such as large polarization, sloping charge–discharge curves with low voltages, and fast capacity decay. Here, we demonstrate high-performance Al-organic batteries based on amorphous electro-oligomers derived from a new molecule, 1,4-bis(3,7-di(9H-carbazol-9-yl)-10H-phenothiazin-10-yl)benzene (named “MILES-1”). MILES-1 underwent in situ electro-oligomerization into redox-active oligomers with distinct electronic structures on conductive carbon during battery cycling via terminal carbazole groups. In our low-cost and nonflammable ternary ionic liquid electrolyte, MILES-1 electro-oligomers, consisting of approximately seven monomers with phenothiazine motifs, enabled well-defined charge–discharge curves and an unprecedentedly high discharge voltage of up to 2.04 V. With a high N and S atoms-to-aryl ratio of 4:5 in the phenylene bis(phenothiazine) motif, the Al/MILES-1 battery delivered a high capacity of 137 mAh g–1 with a CE of 99.3% at 200 mA g–1. Al/MILES-1 batteries presented low self-discharge, excellent rate performance, and cyclability, and they can operate over a wide temperature range from −20 to 60 °C. Our large Al/MILES-1 pouch cell, with a high mass loading of 25.8 mg cm–2 delivered a reversible capacity of 0.8 Ah and an areal capacity of 2.5 mAh cm–2. The combined low cost, high safety, high mass loading, wide temperature range, improved energy density, and superior cyclability highlight the potential of Al-organic batteries as future energy-storage systems.
title_zh: 含电低聚物的可充电铝有机电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 使用铝金属阳极和有机阴极的可充电铝有机电池是有前途的下一代储能器件，具有高安全性，但存在极化大、低电压充放电曲线倾斜和容量衰减快等局限性。在这里，我们展示了基于源自新分子 1,4-双(3,7-二(9H-咔唑-9-基)-10H-吩噻嗪-10-基)苯（名为“MILES-1”）的非晶电低聚物的高性能有机铝电池。 MILES-1 在电池循环过程中通过末端咔唑基团进行原位电齐聚，形成在导电碳上具有独特电子结构的氧化还原活性低聚物。在我们的低成本且不易燃的三元离子液体电解质中，MILES-1 电低聚物由大约 7 个具有吩噻嗪基序的单体组成，可实现明确的充放电曲线和高达 2.04 V 的前所未有的高放电电压。亚苯基双（吩噻嗪）基序中 N 和 S 原子与芳基的比例高达 4:5，Al/MILES-1 电池可提供高容量137 mAh g–1，200 mA g–1 时的 CE 为 99.3%。 Al/MILES-1电池具有低自放电、优异的倍率性能和循环性能，并且可以在-20至60°C的宽温度范围内工作。我们的大型 Al/MILES-1 软包电池具有 25.8 mg cm-2 的高质量负载，可提供 0.8 Ah 的可逆容量和 2.5 mAh cm-2 的面积容量。集低成本、高安全性、高质量负载、宽温度范围、提高的能量密度和卓越的循环性能为一体

title: Decoupling the Impact of Surface Functionalization over Pt at the Cathode on Kinetics and Mass Transport in PEMFCs
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) are critical for clean energy conversion, yet their performance is often constrained by the Pt–ionomer interface at the cathode. The sulfonate groups in Nafion, the most widely used ionomer, poison Pt active sites and form a dense layer that impedes oxygen transport. Here, we present an interface-specific molecular modulation strategy using 7-ethyltheophylline (ETP) to address both limitations. An “ETP-first” preparation method ensures preferential ETP adsorption on Pt before ionomer addition, enabling controlled surface functionalization. We demonstrate that ETP competitively displaces poisoning sulfonate groups while intrinsically activating Pt sites. Crucially, we uncover a decoupling between reaction kinetics and mass transport: peak mass activity (0.33 A mgPt–1, ∼50% enhancement) occurs at low ETP loadings (0.15%), whereas pressure-independent oxygen transport resistance (RNP) decreases monotonically with increasing ETP loading up to 1.0%. This divergence leads to distinct optima for H2–O2 versus H2–air performance─the former primarily governed by kinetics, the latter by kinetics at high voltages and by mass transport at high current densities. These findings reveal that molecular modifiers can independently tune kinetics and transport at the Pt–ionomer interface, offering a new dimension for PEMFC optimization beyond conventional catalyst design.
title_zh: 解耦阴极 Pt 表面功能化对 PEMFC 动力学和传质的影响
abstract_zh: 摘要 质子交换膜燃料电池 (PEMFC) 对于清洁能源转换至关重要，但其性能往往受到阴极 Pt-离聚物界面的限制。 Nafion（最广泛使用的离聚物）中的磺酸基会毒害 Pt 活性位点，并形成阻碍氧传输的致密层。在这里，我们提出了一种使用 7-乙基茶碱 (ETP) 的界面特异性分子调制策略来解决这两个限制。 “ETP优先”的制备方法确保在添加离聚物之前ETP优先吸附在Pt上，从而实现受控的表面功能化。我们证明 ETP 竞争性地取代中毒的磺酸盐基团，同时内在地激活 Pt 位点。至关重要的是，我们发现了反应动力学和质量传递之间的脱钩：峰值质量活性（0.33 A mgPt-1，~50%增强）发生在低ETP负载（0.15%）时，而与压力无关的氧传递阻力（RNP）随着ETP负载增加至1.0%而单调下降。这种差异导致了 H2-O2 与 H2-空气性能的明显优化——前者主要由动力学控制，后者由高电压下的动力学和高电流密度下的质量传输控制。这些发现表明，分子改性剂可以独立调节 Pt-离聚物界面的动力学和传输，为 PEMFC 优化提供超越传统催化剂设计的新维度。

title: Correction to “Co-Translational Incorporation of ( R )- and ( S )-β2-Hydroxy Acids In Vitro : A Structural and Biochemical Study on the E. coli Ribosome”
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
title_zh: 对“(R)-和(S)-β2-羟基酸体外共翻译掺入：大肠杆菌核糖体的结构和生化研究”的更正

title: Sequence-Directed Hierarchy of Supramolecular Peptide Bilayers and Heme Cofactor Insertion
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Peptide-based materials have enormous potential for applications including therapeutics, sensing, catalysis, and flexible electronics. Recent material discovery screenings through peptide sequence space have identified a class of amphiphilic heme-containing peptides that self-assemble at the nanoscale while efficiently sequestering heme as a prerequisite for electron transfer. However, the assemblies are remarkably sensitive to changes in peptide sequence, even at the single-residue level, impacting heme uptake, aggregate characteristics, and stability. In a combined experimental and molecular simulation study, we examine the interplay between hydrophobicity and charge–charge repulsion on the heme uptake performance and physicochemical characteristics of the assemblies of representative peptides, ExL4–xL5HL6 for x = 2, 3, 4. We find that membrane permeability and compressibility are beneficial for heme uptake, while striking a balance with the overall stability of the assembly. This work highlights the sensitivity of material performance within peptide design space while providing insight into the compromise that must be struck between competing characteristics.
title_zh: 超分子肽双层的序列定向层次结构和血红素辅因子插入
abstract_zh: 摘要 肽基材料在治疗、传感、催化和柔性电子学等领域具有巨大的应用潜力。最近通过肽序列空间进行的材料发现筛选已经鉴定出一类含有两亲性血红素的肽，它们在纳米尺度上自组装，同时有效地隔离血红素作为电子转移的先决条件。然而，组装体对肽序列的变化非常敏感，即使是在单个残基水平上，也会影响血红素的吸收、聚集特性和稳定性。在实验和分子模拟相结合的研究中，我们研究了疏水性和电荷-电荷排斥之间的相互作用对代表性肽组装体的血红素摄取性能和理化特性的影响，ExL4–xL5HL6（x = 2,3,4）。我们发现膜渗透性和可压缩性有利于血红素摄取，同时与组装体的整体稳定性取得平衡。这项工作强调了肽设计空间内材料性能的敏感性，同时提供了对竞争特性之间必须达成的妥协的见解。

title: Mid-infrared vision sensor based on Suspended Perovskite Oxides Down to Nanometer Scale
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Intelligent mid-infrared (MIR) imaging integrates in-sensor preprocessing of thermal information, thereby reducing data redundancy and improving target-recognition robustness under low-visibility conditions. However, unlike in the visible regime, photoconductive programmability in the MIR typically relies on narrow-bandgap materials, which inherently limit stable and reconfigurable operation. Here, we report a programmable photothermoelectric (PTE) detector based on a suspended nanometer-thick SrTiO3 membrane. Dimensional scaling of the thermoelectric channel enhances sensitivity and enables a response time of ∼10 μs, over 104 times faster than bulk SrTiO3. Through dual-gate electrostatic modulation of the Seebeck profile, the device exhibits bidirectionally tunable photothermoelectric responsivity up to 50 V W−1 and supports 40 experimentally observed programmable response states. By leveraging a 3 × 3 programmable device array with device-to-device consistent gate-programmable photoresponse and reproducible polarity switching, a recognition accuracy of 83% is achieved under visually degraded conditions. Furthermore, the programmable array enables attention-guided thermal image weighting by enhancing target thermal signatures while suppressing background interference. These results demonstrate the dimensional scaling of perovskite oxides as an effective route toward adaptive, low-power machine vision and neuromorphic infrared electronics.
title_zh: 基于纳米级悬浮钙钛矿氧化物的中红外视觉传感器
abstract_zh: 智能中红外 (MIR) 成像集成了热信息的传感器内预处理，从而减少了数据冗余并提高了低能见度条件下目标识别的鲁棒性。然而，与可见光区域不同，MIR 中的光电导可编程性通常依赖于窄带隙材料，这本质上限制了稳定和可重构操作。在这里，我们报告了一种基于悬浮纳米厚 SrTiO3 膜的可编程光热电 (PTE) 探测器。热电通道的尺寸缩放提高了灵敏度，并使响应时间达到约 10 μs，比块状 SrTiO3 快 104 倍以上。通过塞贝克分布的双栅极静电调制，该器件表现出高达 50 V W−1 的双向可调光热电响应度，并支持 40 个实验观察到的可编程响应状态。通过利用具有器件间一致的门可编程光响应和可重复极性切换的 3 × 3 可编程器件阵列，在视觉退化的条件下可实现 83% 的识别准确度。此外，可编程阵列通过增强目标热特征同时抑制背景干扰来实现注意力引导热图像加权。这些结果表明，钙钛矿氧化物的尺寸缩放是实现自适应、低功耗机器视觉和神经形态红外电子学的有效途径。

title: Vapor-Phase Synthesis of Ti2CCl2 MXene
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The vapor-phase synthesis can produce 2D transition metal carbides and nitrides (MXenes) from abundant precursors, bypassing MAX phase synthesis. However, little progress was made after the initial report by Talapin’s group on the chemical vapor deposition of MXenes on titanium foil, as the growth mechanisms remained poorly understood. Here, a scalable vapor-phase synthesis of high-quality Ti2CCl2 MXene from Ti, TiCl4, and CH4 is demonstrated, and the key features of the growth mechanism are elucidated. Increasing the Ti surface area while confining the reaction volume enables vapor-phase formation of Ti2CCl2 on quartz substrates. Supersaturation of TiCl2 increases gas-phase collision frequency, promoting nucleation and subsequent growth of 2D MXene flakes. The as-synthesized lamellae self-organize into spherulites with diverse morphologies, forming a porous nanocrystal network consistent with the gas-to-solid process. The continuous lateral growth into larger flakes is observed as synthesis time increases, suggesting the feasibility of wafer-scale synthesis. This study provides a practical synthesis route for Ti2CCl2 MXenes, accelerating MXene research and applications in quantum technology, optics, and electronics, where 2D crystals with low defect density are required.
title_zh: Ti2CCl2 MXene 的气相合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 气相合成可以绕过 MAX 相合成，从丰富的前驱体中生产二维过渡金属碳化物和氮化物 (MXene)。然而，在 Talapin 小组首次报告钛箔上 MXene 的化学气相沉积之后，进展甚微，因为人们对生长机制仍知之甚少。在这里，展示了从 Ti、TiCl4 和 CH4 中气相合成高质量 Ti2CCl2 MXene 的方法，并阐明了生长机制的关键特征。增加 Ti 表面积，同时限制反应体积，可以在石英基底上气相形成 Ti2CCl2。 TiCl2 的过饱和增加了气相碰撞频率，促进了 2D MXene 薄片的成核和随后的生长。合成的片层自组织成具有不同形态的球晶，形成与气固过程一致的多孔纳米晶体网络。随着合成时间的增加，观察到连续横向生长成更大的薄片，这表明晶圆级合成的可行性。这项研究为 Ti2CCl2 MXene 提供了一条实用的合成路线，加速了 MXene 在量子技术、光学和电子学中的研究和应用，这些领域需要低缺陷密度的二维晶体。

title: The Catalytic Asymmetric Alkylation of Olefins with Alcohol Derivatives
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Both olefins and arenes are abundant and versatile feedstock chemicals. Although the electrophilic alkylation of arenes constitutes an advanced technology, the corresponding alkylation of olefins is rather undeveloped. Here, we report an asymmetric catalytic benzylation and allylation of unactivated olefins with acetates as electrophiles. The reaction is catalyzed by a single imidodiphosphorimidate organocatalyst operating as a silylium Lewis acid. Mechanistic experiments support an enantioconvergent SN1 mechanism featuring stereoablative ion pair formation, resulting in a dynamic kinetic resolution. The enantioenriched hydrocarbon products are readily derivatized to odorants and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs in one or two steps. The developed method provides a metal-free alternative to cornerstone Tsuji–Trost-type allylations proceeding though π-allyl metal complexes.
title_zh: 醇衍生物催化烯烃不对称烷基化
abstract_zh: 摘要 烯烃和芳烃都是丰富且用途广泛的化学原料。尽管芳烃的亲电烷基化是一项先进技术，但相应的烯烃烷基化却相当不发达。在这里，我们报道了未活化烯烃与乙酸酯作为亲电子试剂的不对称催化苄基化和烯丙基化。该反应由单一亚氨基二磷酸亚胺酯有机催化剂催化，作为硅鎓路易斯酸。机理实验支持以立体烧蚀离子对形成为特征的对映会聚 SN1 机制，从而实现动态动力学分辨率。对映体富集的烃产品很容易通过一两个步骤衍生为气味剂和非甾体抗炎药。所开发的方法为通过π-烯丙基金属配合物进行的Tsuji-Trost型烯丙基化提供了一种无金属替代方案。

title: A Cu Single-Atom Catalyst as an Intrinsic Hydrogen Atom Transfer Mediator for Electrooxidation of C(sp3)–H Bonds
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Electrochemical activation of C(sp3)–H bonds is an attractive and sustainable strategy for the synthesis of oxygenated chemicals, yet existing methods often suffer from high overpotentials and reliance on external hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) reagents. Here we report a Cu single-atom catalyst (Cu1/NC) that functions as both an electrocatalyst and an intrinsic HAT mediator, thereby establishing a catalyst-embedded HAT paradigm that eliminates the need for external HAT reagents. Under applied potential, Cu–N4 sites dynamically generate reactive Cu–O species in situ, which selectively abstract hydrogen atoms from hydrocarbons, thereby lowering the activation barrier and enhancing reaction selectivity. The system shows excellent catalytic performance across a wide substrate scope, achieving a Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 57.2%. Mechanistic studies combining isotopic labeling, radical trapping, electron paramagnetic resonance, in situ ATR-SEIRAS spectra, in situ Raman spectroscopy, and density functional theory calculations identify Cu–OH species as the key HAT-active intermediate and reveal that water-assisted deprotonation governs the rate-determining step. Notably, this catalyst exhibits both excellent stability and broad applicability. It enables continuous electrooxidation in a flow reactor at a current density of 50 mA·cm–2, achieving a turnover frequency (TOF) as high as 713 h–1. This work establishes a catalyst-embedded HAT paradigm for electrochemical C–H activation and provides a general framework for sustainable and selective oxidation of hydrocarbons.
title_zh: Cu 单原子催化剂作为 C(sp3)–H 键电氧化的本征氢原子转移介体
abstract_zh: 摘要 C(sp3)-H 键的电化学活化对于含氧化合物的合成来说是一种有吸引力且可持续的策略，但现有方法常常存在高过电势和对外部氢原子转移 (HAT) 试剂的依赖。在这里，我们报告了一种铜单原子催化剂（Cu1/NC），它既可作为电催化剂，又可作为内在的 HAT 介体，从而建立了一种催化剂嵌入的 HAT 范例，无需外部 HAT 试剂。在施加电势下，Cu-N4位点动态地原位生成反应性Cu-O物质，选择性地从碳氢化合物中提取氢原子，从而降低活化势垒并提高反应选择性。该系统在广泛的底物范围内表现出优异的催化性能，法拉第效率 (FE) 达到 57.2%。结合同位素标记、自由基捕获、电子顺磁共振、原位 ATR-SEIRAS 光谱、原位拉曼光谱和密度泛函理论计算的机理研究确定了 Cu-OH 物质是关键的 HAT 活性中间体，并揭示了水辅助去质子化控制了速率决定步骤。值得注意的是，该催化剂表现出优异的稳定性和广泛的适用性。它能够在电流密度为 50 mA·cm–2 的流动反应器中进行连续电氧化，实现高达 713 h–1 的周转频率 (TOF)。这项工作建立了一种用于电化学 C-H 活化的催化剂嵌入式 HAT 范例，并为碳氢化合物的可持续选择性氧化提供了通用框架。

title: Rapid consumption of H2 in the deep subsurface
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Subsurface natural hydrogen is an emerging clean energy resource, but its origins, loss mechanisms, and cycling timescales, particularly at greater depths, remain poorly constrained. Here, we report large disequilibrium in the clumped isotopes of H2 (2H2H) and hydrogen isotope fractionation between water and H2, measured in gas samples (containing 0.10–1.59% H2) collected from deep (3000–7,000 m) wells in the central Sichuan Basin. Because molecular hydrogen can equilibrate isotopes rapidly in the presence of water, such large disequilibrium indicates active kinetically controlled production and/or consumption. Analyses of geological and chemical evidence demonstrate that isotopic disequilibrium is driven by consumption by chemical reactions in host rocks coupled with partial hydrogen exchange with co-existing water. The results imply that measured compositions do not preserve the information on original sources and processes. More broadly, the dynamic cycling of hydrogen renders sediment-hosted deep gas reservoirs unfavorable for long-term or large-scale accumulation of natural hydrogen.
title_zh: 地下深处氢气的快速消耗
abstract_zh: 地下天然氢是一种新兴的清洁能源，但其来源、损失机制和循环时间尺度，特别是在更深的深度，仍然受到很少的限制。在这里，我们报告了从四川盆地中部深井（3000-7,000 m）收集的气体样品（含 0.10-1.59% H2）中测量到的 H2 簇同位素（2H2H）以及水和 H2 之间的氢同位素分馏存在很大的不平衡。由于分子氢可以在水存在下快速平衡同位素，因此如此大的不平衡表明活跃的动力学控制的生产和/或消耗。对地质和化学证据的分析表明，同位素不平衡是由主岩中化学反应的消耗以及与共存水的部分氢交换所驱动的。结果表明，测量的成分没有保留原始来源和过程的信息。更广泛地说，氢的动态循环使得沉积物深层气藏不利于长期或大规模积累天然氢。

title: Hydration layer mediates near-frictionless sieving of monovalent ions
source: Nature Nanotechnology
abstract: Achieving simultaneous high selectivity and permeability for monovalent cation separation remains challenging due to energy-intensive dehydration requirements in current rigid nanopores. Here we develop a hydration-layer-mediated sieving strategy by anchoring hydrated ions at the pore rim of a covalent organic framework monolayer to form dynamic angstrom-scale hydrapores. Ion transport is regulated via attraction and repulsion between bound and migrating ions, arising from the merging and squeezing of hydration layers, enabling precise discrimination without full dehydration. Under a concentration gradient (∆C = 1 M), the membrane exhibits selectivity of 148 for K+/Li+ and 42 for Na+/Li+ with a K+ permeance of 2 × 104 mol m-2 h-1, three orders of magnitude higher than those of state-of-the-art membranes. A low activation energy of 5.5 kcal mol-1 indicates near-frictionless transport, offering a new paradigm for monovalent cation separation.
title_zh: 水合层介导单价离子近乎无摩擦的筛分
abstract_zh: 由于当前刚性纳米孔中的能量密集型脱水要求，同时实现单价阳离子分离的高选择性和渗透性仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一种水化层介导的筛分策略，通过将水合离子锚定在共价有机框架单层的孔边缘，形成动态埃级水合孔。离子传输通过结合离子和迁移离子之间的吸引力和排斥力来调节，这种吸引力和排斥力是由水化层的合并和挤压产生的，从而能够在不完全脱水的情况下进行精确区分。在浓度梯度（ΔC = 1 M）下，该膜对K+/Li+的选择性为148，对Na+/Li+的选择性为42，K+渗透率为2 × 104 mol m-2 h-1，比最先进的膜高三个数量级。 5.5kcalmol-1 的低活化能表明近乎无摩擦的运输，为单价阳离子分离提供了新的范例。

title: Harnessing Regiodivergence and Enantioselectivity in Hydroamidation of Methylenecyclopropanes by Ligand Control
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Hydroamination/hydroamidation has been recognized as a highly important reaction for delivering complex amines. Hydroamination of aliphatic olefins may occur with ipso- and remote selectivity. Yet, controlling or even reversing the regioisomeric outcomes of the hydroamination of aliphatic olefins constitutes a challenging task. In particular, remote and asymmetric hydroamination of olefins catalyzed by base metals has remained largely underexplored. Reported herein is the Ni-catalyzed, ligand-dependent, and regiodivergent hydroamidation of methylenecyclopropanes (MCPs) with dioxazolones as the amidating reagent. In the case of a substituted bipy ligand, the reaction gives a linear, achiral N-homoallyl amide. In contrast, the employment of a chiral bisoxazoline ligand affords a branched allylic amide in high regio- and enantioselectivity, which occurs via a chain-walking-derived nickel allyl species. Mechanistic studies have been conducted to rationalize the regio- and enantioselectivity. The ring scission of MCP is mediated by a Ni(II) hydride, and the subsequent associative chain walking is enantio-determining in the case of the branch-selective hydroamidation.
title_zh: 通过配体控制在亚甲基环丙烷加氢酰胺化中利用区域发散和对映选择性
abstract_zh: 摘要 加氢胺化/加氢酰胺化已被认为是传递复杂胺的非常重要的反应。脂肪族烯烃的加氢胺化可以以自身和远程选择性发生。然而，控制甚至逆转脂肪族烯烃加氢胺化的区域异构结果是一项具有挑战性的任务。特别是，由贱金属催化的烯烃的远程和不对称加氢胺化在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。本文报道了以二恶唑酮作为酰胺化试剂对亚甲基环丙烷 (MCP) 进行镍催化、配体依赖性和区域发散的加氢酰胺化反应。在取代的二吡基配体的情况下，反应生成直链、非手性的N-高烯丙基酰胺。相比之下，手性双恶唑啉配体的使用提供了具有高区域和对映选择性的支链烯丙酰胺，这是通过链行走衍生的镍烯丙基物种发生的。已经进行了机理研究以合理化区域选择性和对映选择性。 MCP 的断环是由 Ni(II) 氢化物介导的，在支链选择性加氢酰胺化的情况下，随后的缔合链行走是对映体决定的。

title: Direct HAT: a complementary paradigm for activating α-silyl alcohols in enantioconvergent radical-relay coupling
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: The direct HAT activation of alcohols for alkoxy radical generation is impeded by high O–H bond strengths, and prevailing photochemical methods are limited by substrate redox potentials or metal-dependent activation requirements. Herein, we introduce a complementary paradigm leveraging the β-silicon effect in α-silyl alcohols to weaken the O–H bond, enabling its redox-neutral, photoinduced homolysis via thioxanthone. Subsequently, the generated alkoxy radicals undergo facile Brook rearrangement to produce carbon radicals, which are intercepted by a nickel catalyst in enantioconvergent cross-couplings with acyl chlorides and aryl bromides. This protocol provides diverse chiral acylons and alcohols with high enantioselectivity. It tolerates substrates that are inert under classical SET/PCET conditions and establishes direct HAT as a versatile platform for alkoxy radical chemistry of α-silyl alcohols.
title_zh: 直接 HAT：在对映体自由基中继偶联中激活 α-硅醇的补充范例
abstract_zh: 高 O-H 键强度阻碍了醇的直接 HAT 活化以产生烷氧基自由基，并且流行的光化学方法受到底物氧化还原电位或金属依赖性活化要求的限制。在此，我们引入了一种补充范例，利用 α-硅醇中的 β-硅效应来削弱 O-H 键，使其能够通过噻吨酮实现氧化还原中性、光诱导均裂。随后，生成的烷氧基自由基发生容易的布鲁克重排，产生碳自由基，碳自由基在与酰氯和芳基溴的对映交叉偶联中被镍催化剂拦截。该方案提供了具有高对映选择性的多种手性无酰基和醇。它可以耐受经典 SET/PCET 条件下惰性的底物，并将直接 HAT 建立为 α-硅醇烷氧基自由基化学的多功能平台。

title: A Review of Ammonia (NH3) Adsorption in Porous Solids
source: Chemical Reviews: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Ammonia (NH3) plays a crucial role in the agricultural sector as a fertilizer and is a dense hydrogen carrier that offers a potential renewable and carbon-free energy source. These significant advantages necessitate the development of efficient NH3 synthesis and separation systems. Conventionally, the Haber–Bosch (HB) process involves synthesis at high temperature (>673 K, 100–200 bar) and separation of NH3 from the equilibrium-limited reaction mixture through condensation at low temperatures. Among various alternative NH3 separation techniques, adsorption approaches in porous solids have been investigated as a potentially more energy-efficient method. However, identifying the optimal porous materials for reversible NH3 separation with high NH3 capacity remains challenging. This review discusses the potential of porous solid adsorbents, such as zeolites, metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), covalent organic frameworks (COFs), hydrogen-bonded organic frameworks (HOFs), porous organic polymers (POPs), carbons, and their composite materials with NH3 absorbents like ionic liquids and metal halides, for NH3 separation and other potential uses like storage and sensing. The review also discusses active sites for adsorption, and adsorbent structural and mechanical properties. It also emphasizes NH3 selectivity over N2 and H2, highlighting the solid sorbent’s reversibility, stability, and regeneration conditions. Future directions for NH3 adsorption research are highlighted.
title_zh: 多孔固体中氨 (NH3) 吸附的研究进展
abstract_zh: 摘要 氨 (NH3) 作为肥料在农业领域发挥着至关重要的作用，并且是一种致密的氢载体，可提供潜在的可再生和无碳能源。这些显着的优势需要开发高效的 NH3 合成和分离系统。传统上，哈伯-博世 (HB) 工艺涉及高温（>673 K，100-200 bar）合成，并通过低温冷凝从平衡限制反应混合物中分离 NH3。在各种替代的 NH3 分离技术中，多孔固体吸附方法已被研究为一种潜在的更节能的方法。然而，确定具有高 NH3 容量的可逆 NH3 分离的最佳多孔材料仍然具有挑战性。本综述讨论了多孔固体吸附剂（例如沸石、金属有机骨架（MOF）、共价有机骨架（COF）、氢键有机骨架（HOF）、多孔有机聚合物（POP）、碳及其与离子液体和金属卤化物等NH3吸收剂的复合材料）在NH3分离和存储和传感等其他潜在用途中的潜力。该综述还讨论了吸附活性位点以及吸附剂结构和机械性能。它还强调 NH3 相对于 N2 和 H2 的选择性，强调固体吸附剂的可逆性、稳定性和再生条件。强调了 NH3 吸附研究的未来方向。

title: Nanofiber Core-Spun Yarn with a Bioinspired Neuron-like Conductive Network for High-Sensitivity Wearable Sensing
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Wearable e-textiles require yarn-level sensors that are simultaneously conductive, deformable, durable, and weavable. Many existing yarns that depended on multicoating or high filler loading often suffer from compromised flexibility and signal stability under repeated deformation. Herein, inspired by neurons, we develop a nanofiber core-spun yarn (PCP-NHY) featuring a bioinspired neuron-like conductive network through a stepwise interfacial engineering process, including electrospinning of PAN nanofibers, ultrasonic impregnation of CNTs, and in situ polymerization of pyrrole. In this conductive network, the granular PPy distributed on the PAN nanofiber network acts as neuronal somas, interconnected by CNTs that serve as axons, thus enabling efficient charge transport at low filler content while preserving mechanical flexibility. After helical wrapping onto a spandex core, the resulting elastic sensing yarn demonstrates high-performance strain-sensing capabilities, characterized by a high gauge factor of 5.73, a rapid response time (∼70 ms), and stable outputs over 5000 cycles at 40% strain. It supports real-time detection of both subtle and large-scale human motions, including facial microexpressions, Morse-code inputs, and multijoint movements. Meanwhile, two-dimensional textiles incorporating PCP-NHY yarns also exhibit outstanding sensing performance. This neuron-inspired material-structure design may provide an effective strategy to convert conventional yarns into robust, intelligent textile systems for advanced wearable sensing.
title_zh: 具有仿生神经元导电网络的纳米纤维包芯纱，用于高灵敏度可穿戴传感
abstract_zh: 摘要 可穿戴电子纺织品需要同时具有导电性、可变形、耐用和可编织的纱线水平传感器。许多现有的依赖于多层涂层或高填料含量的纱线在反复变形下常常会受到柔韧性和信号稳定性的影响。在此，受神经元的启发，我们通过逐步的界面工程过程，包括静电纺丝PAN纳米纤维、超声波浸渍碳纳米管和吡咯原位聚合，开发了一种具有仿生神经元导电网络的纳米纤维包芯纱（PCP-NHY）。在该导电网络中，分布在 PAN 纳米纤维网络上的颗粒状 PPy 充当神经元胞体，通过充当轴突的 CNT 互连，从而在低填料含量下实现有效的电荷传输，同时保持机械灵活性。在螺旋缠绕到氨纶芯上后，所得的弹性传感纱线表现出高性能的应变传感能力，其特点是5.73的高规格系数、快速的响应时间（~70毫秒）以及在40%应变下超过5000个循环的稳定输出。它支持实时检测细微和大规模的人体运动，包括面部微表情、摩尔斯电码输入和多关节运动。同时，采用PCP-NHY纱线的二维纺织品也表现出出色的传感性能。这种受神经元启发的材料结构设计可以提供一种有效的策略，将传统纱线转化为强大的智能纺织系统，以实现先进的可穿戴传感。

title: Stabilization of All-Slot-Die-Coated Perovskite Solar Cells by MXene Nanospheres Unleashes Thousand-Hour Operational Lifetimes
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Halide perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have emerged as highly promising photovoltaic technologies. However, their commercialization is impeded by rapid degradation at interfaces due to intrinsic defects and corrosive decomposition products. Here, we demonstrate the use of spherical Ti3C2Tx MXene nanoparticles synthesized by femtosecond laser ablation as stabilizing additives for all-slot-die-coated PSCs. Unlike conventional MXene flakes, these nanoparticles exhibit improved colloidal stability, uniform dispersion, and facile integration into thin-film layers. Incorporation of MXene nanoparticles into electron transport layers notably enhances charge carrier dynamics, yielding an increased power conversion efficiency from 17.4 to 18.2%. Moreover, operational stability under continuous illumination extends from 400 h to over 1700 h owing to MXene nanoparticles. Structural and photophysical analyses suggest that MXene nanoparticles mitigate interfacial degradation by passivating ionic defects and improving energy-level alignment. This scalable nanoparticle-based strategy offers a versatile pathway toward stable, efficient, and commercially viable perovskite photovoltaics and opens new prospects for MXenes in advanced optoelectronic applications.
title_zh: MXene 纳米球对全槽模涂层钙钛矿太阳能电池的稳定性可实现数千小时的运行寿命
abstract_zh: 摘要 卤化物钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）已成为极具前景的光伏技术。然而，由于固有缺陷和腐蚀性分解产物，它们的商业化受到界面快速降解的阻碍。在这里，我们演示了使用通过飞秒激光烧蚀合成的球形 Ti3C2Tx MXene 纳米颗粒作为全槽模涂层 PSC 的稳定添加剂。与传统的 MXene 薄片不同，这些纳米颗粒表现出更好的胶体稳定性、均匀的分散性以及易于集成到薄膜层中。将 MXene 纳米粒子纳入电子传输层可显着增强电荷载流子动力学，使功率转换效率从 17.4% 提高至 18.2%。此外，由于 MXene 纳米粒子，连续照明下的运行稳定性从 400 小时延长至 1700 小时以上。结构和光物理分析表明，MXene 纳米粒子通过钝化离子缺陷和改善能级排列来减轻界面降解。这种基于纳米粒子的可扩展策略为稳定、高效和商业上可行的钙钛矿光伏发电提供了一条通用途径，并为 MXene 在先进光电应用中开辟了新的前景。

title: Self-Healing Composites with Heterogeneous Interfaces and Electromagnetic Synergy for Electromagnetic Wave Absorption
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The usage of electronics has led to the issue of electromagnetic wave pollution, and the demand for materials that can absorb electromagnetic waves is increasing. The longevity of materials may be impacted by damage caused during use. Here, a composite strategy with efficient electromagnetic wave absorption and self-healing through induction heating is proposed. Ni/PUF/PU@ER (NPPE), Cu/Ni/PUF/PU@ER (CNPPE), and Ni/PANI/PU@ER (NPAPE) microcapsules with magnetic and conductive characteristics were prepared by interface polymerization, in situ polymerization, and electroless plating methods. Their superior mechanical and thermal durability guarantee the long-term stability of the healing agent. The minimum reflection loss of the composite with NPAPE is –54.62 dB at 1.85 mm, and the effective absorption bandwidth (EAB) is 3.95 GHz. Additionally, the EAB reaches 4.32 GHz at 1.93 mm, surpassing the RLmin and EAB values of the majority of similar materials. Due to the exceptional electromagnetic synergy of NPAPE, the composite exhibits the most outstanding induction heating performance. The material reaches 68.3 °C within 10 min, which is higher than the temperatures of the other two materials. Furthermore, the crack area of the composite significantly reduces, demonstrating excellent quick self-healing characteristics for damage. This novel strategy is conducive to promoting the development of the circular economy and can introduce a worthwhile research direction into the field of electromagnetic wave absorption.
title_zh: 具有异质界面和电磁协同作用的自修复复合材料用于电磁波吸收
abstract_zh: 摘要 电子产品的使用导致电磁波污染问题，对吸收电磁波材料的需求日益增加。材料的寿命可能会因使用过程中造成的损坏而受到影响。在这里，提出了一种通过感应加热实现高效电磁波吸收和自愈的复合策略。采用界面聚合、原位聚合和化学镀方法制备了具有磁性和导电特性的Ni/PUF/PU@ER（NPPE）、Cu/Ni/PUF/PU@ER（CNPPE）和Ni/PANI/PU@ER（NPAPE）微胶囊。其卓越的机械和热耐久性保证了愈合剂的长期​​稳定性。具有 NPAPE 的复合材料在 1.85 mm 处的最小反射损耗为 –54.62 dB，有效吸收带宽 (EAB) 为 3.95 GHz。此外，EAB 在 1.93 mm 处达到 4.32 GHz，超过了大多数类似材料的 RLmin 和 EAB 值。由于 NPAPE 卓越的电磁协同作用，该复合材料表现出最出色的感应加热性能。该材料在10分钟内达到68.3℃，高于其他两种材料的温度。此外，复合材料的裂纹面积显着减少，表现出优异的损伤快速自愈特性。这一新颖的策略有利于促进循环经济的发展，并可为电磁波吸收领域引入一个有价值的研究方向。

title: Engineering Carbon Nanotube Networks in MOF-Derived Fe@NC Composites for Lightweight and Broadband Electromagnetic Wave Absorption
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The in situ growth of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) on metal–organic framework (MOF)-derived carbon matrices offers a promising route for lightweight and high-performance electromagnetic wave (EMW) absorbers. However, achieving controllable CNT growth while maintaining balanced dielectric properties and impedance matching remains a major challenge. Herein, Fe-citrate is introduced as an integrated precursor that simultaneously functions as a Fe source, chelating ligand, and carbon feedstock, controlling in situ growth of CNTs without external carbon sources. During pyrolysis, in situ-formed Fe nanoparticles catalyze the formation of high-aspect-ratio CNT networks on N-doped carbon (NC) derived from zeolitic imidazolate framework-L (ZIF-L), a Zn-based MOF. By regulating the Fe-citrate content, the density and morphology of CNTs can be precisely tailored, thereby tuning the dielectric response and impedance matching characteristics of the resulting Fe@NC-CNT composites. Benefiting from the optimized balance between conductive attenuation and impedance matching, the Fe@NC-CNT composites achieve a minimum reflection loss of –60.4 dB at 12.5 wt % and a maximum effective absorption bandwidth of 7.6 GHz at 10 wt %. This work establishes a versatile strategy for engineering CNT networks in MOF-derived materials and provides insights into the structure–electromagnetic property relationship governing broadband microwave absorption.
title_zh: MOF 衍生的 Fe@NC 复合材料中的工程碳纳米管网络用于轻质和宽带电磁波吸收
abstract_zh: 摘要：在金属有机骨架（MOF）衍生的碳基质上原位生长碳纳米管（CNT）为轻质高性能电磁波（EMW）吸收器提供了一条有前途的途径。然而，在保持平衡的介电性能和阻抗匹配的同时实现可控的碳纳米管生长仍然是一个重大挑战。在此，引入柠檬酸铁作为集成前体，同时充当铁源、螯合配体和碳原料，无需外部碳源即可控制碳纳米管的原位生长。在热解过程中，原位形成的 Fe 纳米粒子催化在源自沸石咪唑酯骨架-L (ZIF-L)（一种锌基 MOF）的 N 掺杂碳 (NC) 上形成高纵横比 CNT 网络。通过调节柠檬酸铁含量，可以精确定制碳纳米管的密度和形态，从而调节所得 Fe@NC-CNT 复合材料的介电响应和阻抗匹配特性。得益于传导衰减和阻抗匹配之间的优化平衡，Fe@NC-CNT 复合材料在 12.5 wt% 时实现了 –60.4 dB 的最小反射损耗，在 10 wt% 时实现了 7.6 GHz 的最大有效吸收带宽。这项工作建立了一种在 MOF 衍生材料中设计 CNT 网络的通用策略，并提供了对控制宽带微波吸收的结构-电磁特性关系的见解。

title: OH-Rich Interfacial Nanoarchitectonics for the Reconciliation of Structural Stability and Functional Accessibility in Curcumin Nanotherapeutics
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Curcumin offers significant therapeutic potential but is hindered by poor aqueous stability and limited cellular accessibility. Here, we present a curcumin nanotherapeutic platform featuring OH-rich, silanol-rich porous silica nanointerfaces (CU@silica NPs) that successfully decouple structural stabilization from molecular mobility. By employing poly(allylamine hydrochloride) (PAH)-assisted assembly and rapid tetramethyl orthosilicate (TMOS) hydrolysis, we engineered a mesostructured silica shell with a high density of surface silanol groups, creating diffusion pathways that preserve curcumin mobility while protecting it from degradation. This permeable nanointerface enables lipid-triggered fluorescence activation, allowing activation-responsive monitoring of drug delivery. The OH-rich silica interface further ensures exceptional redispersibility and functional preservation even after repeated powderization cycles, a critical requirement for long-term storage and transport. Supported by molecular dynamics simulations and in vitro evaluations, CU@silica NPs demonstrate accelerated cellular uptake and a five-fold improvement in anticancer efficacy compared with CU NPs. These findings establish silica nano-interface engineering as a robust strategy for developing storage-stable, stimuli-responsive, and image-guided nanomedicines for hydrophobic drugs.
title_zh: 富含 OH 的界面纳米结构用于协调姜黄素纳米疗法的结构稳定性和功能可及性
abstract_zh: 摘要 姜黄素具有显着的治疗潜力，但由于水溶液稳定性差和细胞可及性有限而受到阻碍。在这里，我们提出了一个姜黄素纳米治疗平台，具有富含 OH、富含硅烷醇的多孔二氧化硅纳米界面 (CU@silica NPs)，可成功地将结构稳定性与分子流动性分离。通过采用聚（盐酸烯丙胺）（PAH）辅助组装和快速原硅酸四甲酯（TMOS）水解，我们设计了具有高密度表面硅烷醇基团的介观结构二氧化硅壳，创建了扩散途径，可保持姜黄素的流动性，同时防止其降解。这种可渗透的纳米界面能够实现脂质触发的荧光激活，从而允许对药物输送进行激活响应监测。即使在重复的粉末化循环之后，富含 OH 的二氧化硅界面也能进一步确保出色的再分散性和功能保存，这是长期储存和运输的关键要求。在分子动力学模拟和体外评估的支持下，CU@silica NPs 表现出加速的细胞摄取，与 CU NPs 相比，抗癌功效提高了五倍。这些发现将二氧化硅纳米界面工程确立为开发储存稳定、刺激响应和图像引导的疏水性药物纳米药物的稳健策略。

title: Expanding the Living Polymerization Toolkit: Mechanistic Insights and Optimization of Vinyl-Addition Polymerization of Norbornenes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The living vinyl-addition polymerization of norbornenes is a robust method for accessing high-molecular-weight, solvent-processable materials with a chemically inert backbone and varied block copolymer architectures. However, the extent of its livingness and the underlying mechanisms of the loss of molecular weight control remain underexplored and unoptimized. In this work, we provide a functional guide to achieving improved molecular weight control through the systematic exploration of vinyl-addition polymerization by a tri-tert-butylphosphine-ligated cationic palladium initiator. We developed a time-delay chain extension experimental protocol to quantify the livingness of a given polymerization and enable identification of how the catalyst counteranion, trace impurities, and polymerization conditions impact the reactivity of the propagating chain end. Reagents that can both halt propagation and remove the polymer from the palladium chain end were identified through complementary studies of polymer quenching protocols. Ultimately, we establish a series of guidelines for achieving highly living vinyl-addition polymerizations of norbornene monomers and apply them to the synthesis of a nonablock copolymer on the benchtop, expanding the toolkit of living methodologies for the synthetic polymer chemist while providing an experimental framework for the optimization of living polymerizations.
title_zh: 扩展活性聚合工具包：降冰片烯乙烯基加成聚合的机理见解和优化
abstract_zh: 摘要 降冰片烯的活性乙烯基加成聚合是获得具有化学惰性主链和各种嵌段共聚物结构的高分子量、可溶剂加工材料的可靠方法。然而，其活性程度和分子量控制丧失的潜在机制仍未得到充分探索和优化。在这项工作中，我们通过系统地探索三叔丁基膦配位的阳离子钯引发剂的乙烯基加成聚合，提供了实现改进分子量控制的功能指南。我们开发了一种延时扩链实验方案，以量化给定聚合的活性，并能够确定催化剂抗衡阴离子、微量杂质和聚合条件如何影响增长链末端的反应性。通过对聚合物淬灭方案的补充研究，确定了既可以停止传播又可以从钯链末端去除聚合物的试剂。最终，我们建立了一系列用于实现降冰片烯单体的高活性乙烯基加成聚合的指南，并将其应用于在台式九嵌段共聚物的合成中，扩展了合成聚合物化学家的活性方法工具包，同时为活性聚合的优化提供了实验框架。

title: Salt-Resistant Self-Floating Composite Hydrogel Foam Evaporator Enabled by Donnan Effect for Efficient Solar Interfacial Evaporation and Water Purification
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Solar interfacial evaporation is a promising approach for desalination and wastewater treatment, yet practical evaporators remain challenged by limited water transport, interfacial heat loss, and salt deposition in high-salinity brines. Herein, a self-floating, salt-resistant composite hydrogel foam evaporator, PTF@PGAS-Foam, was developed by integrating an electrospun tannic acid–Fe3+ photothermal membrane with a polyelectrolyte double-network hydrogel foam. The upper photothermal membrane enables strong solar absorption and thermal localization, while the lower foam layer provides buoyancy, low thermal conductivity, and continuous three-dimensional water-transport pathways. Fixed sulfonate groups in the hydrogel induce the Donnan effect, suppressing salt-ion migration toward the evaporation interface and alleviating salt crystallization during continuous evaporation. Under 1 sun irradiation, PTF@PGAS-Foam achieved an evaporation rate of 2.61 kg·m–2·h–1 and an efficiency of 92% in a 20 wt % NaCl solution, with stable performance during continuous and cyclic tests. The evaporator also adsorbed heavy metal ions, including Pb2+ and Cd2+, and cationic dyes. In outdoor scaled-up tests, a 15 cm diameter evaporator produced 20.35 kg·m–2 of water per day. This multifunctional evaporator integrates solar absorption, heat localization, self-floating behavior, salt resistance, and adsorption, showing potential for solar desalination and wastewater purification.
title_zh: 利用唐南效应实现高效太阳能界面蒸发和水净化的耐盐自浮式复合水凝胶泡沫蒸发器
abstract_zh: 摘要 太阳能界面蒸发是一种有前景的海水淡化和废水处理方法，但实用的蒸发器仍然面临着有限的水传输、界面热损失和高盐度盐水中盐沉积的挑战。本文通过将电纺单宁酸-Fe3+光热膜与聚电解质双网络水凝胶泡沫相结合，开发了一种自浮式耐盐复合水凝胶泡沫蒸发器PTF@PGAS-Foam。上层光热膜具有较强的太阳能吸收和热定位能力，而下层泡沫层则提供浮力、低导热率和连续的三维水传输路径。水凝胶中的固定磺酸基团会产生唐南效应，抑制盐离子向蒸发界面迁移，并减轻连续蒸发过程中盐的结晶。在1个太阳照射下，PTF@PGAS-Foam在20 wt% NaCl溶液中的蒸发速率为2.61 kg·m–2·h–1，效率为92%，在连续和循环测试中表现稳定。蒸发器还吸附重金属离子，包括Pb2+和Cd2+，以及阳离子染料。在室外放大试验中，直径为 15 cm 的蒸发器每天产生 20.35 kg·m–2 的水。这种多功能蒸发器集太阳能吸收、热定位、自漂浮、抗盐和吸附于一体，显示出太阳能海水淡化和废水净化的潜力。

title: Near Infrared-Programmed In Situ Mechanical Reconfiguration of Adhesive Hydrogels for Pressure Distribution Recognition
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Light driven soft actuators often struggle to integrate robust mechanical toughness, dynamic spatial tunability, and reliable on demand adhesion within a single material system. Here, we present a near infrared (NIR) light responsive hydrogel featuring dynamic noncovalent networks that enable the rapid and reversible reconfiguration of mechanical properties. The structural network integrates PVA chains to provide initial mechanical resilience and environmental durability, while the thermal responsive boronic ester bonds act as crosslinking junctions to ensure fast transition to a soft elastic state. This integrated architecture achieves a rare balance between high initial stiffness and on demand dynamic actuation, overcoming the long-standing trade off in responsive soft matters. Furthermore, the localized photothermal cleavage of the dynamic bonds exposes functional groups, which significantly enhances the interfacial adhesion to diverse surfaces, reaching approximately 48 kPa on aluminum. The localized photothermal reduction in mechanical stiffness endows the hydrogel with precise spatial control, enabling the design of untethered bionic actuators and interactive sensors. Beyond mechanical actuation, the hydrogel serves as a highly sensitive wearable electronic device, achieving precise human motion detection and Morse code communication. Furthermore, the integration of a 4 × 4 spatial pressure sensor array provides reliable tactile feedback for robotic manipulation tasks. This work highlights a versatile design strategy for programmable hydrogels, paving opportunities for smart interfaces, advanced human machine interaction, and adaptive soft robotic systems.
title_zh: 用于压力分布识别的粘合水凝胶的近红外编程原位机械重构
abstract_zh: 摘要 光驱动的软执行器通常很难将强大的机械韧性、动态空间可调性和可靠的按需粘附力集成到单一材料系统中。在这里，我们提出了一种近红外（NIR）光响应水凝胶，具有动态非共价网络，能够快速且可逆地重新配置机械性能。该结构网络集成了PVA链，以提供初始机械弹性和环境耐久性，而热响应硼酸酯键充当交联连接点，以确保快速转变为软弹性状态。这种集成架构在高初始刚度和按需动态驱动之间实现了罕见的平衡，克服了响应软物质方面长期存在的权衡。此外，动态键的局部光热裂解暴露了官能团，这显着增强了对不同表面的界面粘附力，在铝上达到约 48 kPa。机械刚度的局部光热降低赋予水凝胶精确的空间控制，从而能够设计不受束缚的仿生执行器和交互式传感器。除了机械驱动之外，水凝胶还可以作为一种高灵敏度的可穿戴电子设备，实现精确的人体运动检测和莫尔斯电码通信。此外，4 × 4 空间压力传感器阵列的集成为机器人操作任务提供了可靠的触觉反馈。这项工作突出了可编程水凝胶的多功能设计策略，为可编程水凝胶铺平了机会

title: Alignment-Controlled Circularly Polarized Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence in Chiral Nematic Liquid Crystals
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Despite significant advances, simultaneously achieving a high emission dissymmetry factor (glum) and high luminescence efficiency remains a major challenge in the field of circularly polarized luminescent (CPL) materials. Here, we report a dual strategy that combines liquid crystal doping with naphthalimide-based thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) emitters and controlled surface alignment to amplify CPL in chiral nematic liquid crystal (N*LC) systems. Two emitters were investigated: 1, bearing a conventional octyl chain, and 2, functionalized with cyanobiphenyl mesogenic units to enhance compatibility with the nematic host. Both compounds show TADF behavior within the LC matrix. Controlled homogeneous and homeotropic alignment of the N* phase enabled the systematic investigation of boundary-induced effects on CPL performance. Homogeneous alignment proved particularly effective, delivering high glum values of up to 0.14 even at low dopant loading (0.5 wt%), maintaining stable chiroptical responses over 30 days. These findings highlight macroscopic LC alignment as a critical, yet underexplored, parameter governing CPL performance and establish practical design principles for next-generation CP-TADF/LC materials targeting photonic and display device applications.
title_zh: 手性向列液晶中排列控制的圆偏振热激活延迟荧光
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管取得了重大进展，但同时实现高发射不对称因子（glum）和高发光效率仍然是圆偏振发光（CPL）材料领域的主要挑战。在这里，我们报告了一种双重策略，将液晶掺杂与基于萘二甲酰亚胺的热激活延迟荧光（TADF）发射器和受控表面对准相结合，以放大手性向列液晶（N * LC）系统中的CPL。研究了两种发射体：1，带有传统的辛基链；2，用氰基联苯介晶单元进行功能化，以增强与向列主体的相容性。两种化合物在 LC 基质中均表现出 TADF 行为。 N* 相的受控均匀和垂直排列使得能够系统地研究边界引起的对 CPL 性能的影响。事实证明，均匀排列特别有效，即使在低掺杂剂负载量（0.5 wt%）下也能提供高达 0.14 的高 Glum 值，在 30 天内保持稳定的手性光学响应。这些发现强调了宏观液晶对准是控制 CPL 性能的一个关键但尚未充分探索的参数，并为针对光子和显示设备应用的下一代 CP-TADF/LC 材料建立了实用的设计原则。

title: Free-Standing N-Doped Nanoporous Graphene/Polypropylene Separator for Robust Lithium Metal Anodes Compatible with High-Loading and High-Voltage Cathodes
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract This study aims to transform the traditional polypropylene (PP) separator from a passive physical barrier into a “functional interfacial layer” to guide lithium deposition. A free-standing nitrogen-doped nanoporous nanotubular graphene (NG) network-based thin film is used to modify the separator (PP@NG) in a binder-free manner. Its open nanoporous/tubular structure and nitrogen-dopants endow the film with excellent electrolyte wettability and electrical/thermal conductivity. Moreover, the nanoporous channel guides the uniform Li+ flux through the film and subsequent deposition. Accordingly, the PP@NG can reduce the lithium nucleation overpotential from 38.0 to 17.7 mV and increase the tLi+ to 0.62. The symmetric Li|PP@NG|Li achieves a better rate performance and stable cycling for 800 h. The Li|PP@NG|LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 full cell shows a capacity retention of 64.8% after 900 cycles at 1.0 C. Even combined with a high cathode mass loading of 6.1 mAh·cm–2 or near 5.0 V high-voltage cathode, clearly enhanced performance can still be achieved.
title_zh: 用于与高负载和高压阴极兼容的坚固锂金属阳极的独立式氮掺杂纳米多孔石墨烯/聚丙烯隔膜
abstract_zh: 摘要：本研究旨在将传统的聚丙烯（PP）隔膜从被动物理屏障转变为引导锂沉积的“功能界面层”。使用一种独立的氮掺杂纳米孔纳米管石墨烯（NG）网络薄膜以无粘合剂的方式对隔膜（PP@NG）进行改性。其开放的纳米孔/管状结构和氮掺杂剂赋予薄膜优异的电解质润湿性和导电性/导热性。此外，纳米多孔通道引导均匀的Li+通量穿过薄膜和随后的沉积。因此，PP@NG可以将锂成核过电势从38.0 mV降低至17.7 mV，并将tLi+提高至0.62。对称的Li|PP@NG|Li实现了更好的倍率性能和800小时的稳定循环。 Li|PP@NG|LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2全电池在1.0 C下循环900次后容量保持率为64.8%。即使与6.1 mAh·cm–2的高阴极质量负载或接近5.0 V的高压阴极相结合，仍然可以实现明显增强的性能。

title: Local Chemistry-Guided Molecular Beam Epitaxy Growth of SnSe on MgO via Combined ReaxFF Modeling and Machine Learning
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Subtle variations in local growth chemistry can fundamentally alter the morphology of layered chalcogenide thin films, yet the atomic-scale mechanisms underlying this sensitivity remain poorly understood. Here, we combine molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) experiments, reactive molecular dynamics simulations, and machine learning analysis to establish a chemistry–structure relationship for SnSe thin film growth on MgO. Experimentally, we show that modifying the Sn/Se flux ratio and deposition sequence promotes a transition between three-dimensional island formation and laterally coalesced smooth films, accompanied by pronounced changes in surface roughness. Reactive molecular dynamics simulations reveal that this transition originates from an intrinsic chemical asymmetry between Sn and Se that alters adatom surface diffusion and aggregation behavior during growth. Se-rich environments stabilize surface passivation and promote lateral growth, whereas Sn-rich conditions favor vertical aggregation through rapid Sn clustering. To assess morphology trends without imposing physical assumptions, we apply an unsupervised machine learning framework to images rendered from the simulation snapshots. The resulting low-dimensional representation of the surface morphologies captures morphology trends consistent with those observed experimentally and those in simulations, providing a complementary data-driven interpretation of the chemistry–morphology relationship. Because nanoscale roughness strongly influences carrier scattering, phonon transport, and domain stability in SnSe-based electronic and energy devices, these results provide a chemistry-guided framework for morphology control in layered chalcogenide thin films.
title_zh: 通过结合 ReaxFF 建模和机器学习在 MgO 上局部化学引导分子束外延生长 SnSe
abstract_zh: 摘要 局部生长化学的细微变化可以从根本上改变层状硫族化物薄膜的形态，但这种敏感性背后的原子尺度机制仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们结合分子束外延 (MBE) 实验、反应分子动力学模拟和机器学习分析，建立了 MgO 上 SnSe 薄膜生长的化学结构关系。实验表明，改变 Sn/Se 通量比和沉积顺序可以促进三维岛形成和横向聚结光滑薄膜之间的转变，并伴随表面粗糙度的显着变化。反应分子动力学模拟表明，这种转变源于 Sn 和 Se 之间固有的化学不对称性，它改变了吸附原子在生长过程中的表面扩散和聚集行为。富硒环境稳定表面钝化并促进横向生长，而富锡条件则通过快速锡聚集有利于垂直聚集。为了在不强加物理假设的情况下评估形态趋势，我们将无监督的机器学习框架应用于从模拟快照渲染的图像。由此产生的表面形态的低维表示捕获了与实验和模拟中观察到的形态趋势一致的形态趋势，为化学形态关系提供了补充的数据驱动解释。因为纳米级粗糙度强烈影响 SnSe 基电子中的载流子散射、声子传输和域稳定性。

title: Post-Printing Manipulation of Material Mechanical Properties via Synergistic Engineering of Dynamic Polymer Network and Phase Separation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The coupling of 3D printing process constraints and material molecular design makes it difficult to simultaneously achieve sophisticated structural fidelity and desirable mechanical performance. Topological reconfiguration of dynamic covalent polymer networks imparts materials with the capability to modulate their properties as needed post fabrication. However, prior studies had only achieved a limited modulation range because material properties depend solely on the polymer network structure. Herein, we introduce phase separation into a 3D printable dynamic covalent polymer network to enable significant mechanical property modulation in geometrically complex 3D objects. Specifically, the printing resin precursor comprises a crosslinker functionalized with dynamic hindered urea bonds and non-photocurable polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether. A rigid construct is first obtained via photopolymerization-induced phase separation during printing. Subsequent activation of dynamic bond exchange reactions enables simultaneous tailoring of both the network topology and phase morphology, realizing broad-range mechanical tunability with a modulus spanning three orders of magnitude from 0.47 GPa to 0.5 MPa. This remarkable on-demand rigid-to-soft transition allows 100 μm printing resolution to be readily achieved, overcoming the limitations of 3D printing in fabricating soft functional materials with high structural fidelity.
title_zh: 通过动态聚合物网络和相分离的协同工程对材料机械性能进行打印后操控
abstract_zh: 摘要 3D 打印工艺约束和材料分子设计的耦合使得难以同时实现复杂的结构保真度和理想的机械性能。动态共价聚合物网络的拓扑重构使材料能够根据制造后的需要调节其性能。然而，先前的研究仅实现了有限的调制范围，因为材料性能仅取决于聚合物网络结构。在此，我们将相分离引入到可 3D 打印动态共价聚合物网络中，以实现几何复杂 3D 物体的显着机械性能调节。具体地，印刷树脂前体包含用动态受阻脲键官能化的交联剂和不可光固化的聚乙二醇单甲醚。首先通过打印过程中光聚合诱导的相分离获得刚性结构。随后激活动态键交换反应，可以同时调整网络拓扑和相形态，实现广泛的机械可调性，模量跨越 0.47 GPa 至 0.5 MPa 三个数量级。这种非凡的按需刚性到软质过渡可以轻松实现 100 μm 的打印分辨率，克服了 3D 打印在制造具有高结构保真度的软功能材料方面的局限性。

title: Nacre-Mimetic Multifunctional Aramid Dielectric Paper Enabled by Percolated 3D Boron Nitride Networks and Interfacial Engineering
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The widespread adoption of aramid dielectric paper as core insulation in advanced motor systems is undermined by its intrinsically low thermal conductivity (λ), which promotes localized hotspot formation and precipitates insulation failure under severe thermoelectrical coupling stresses. However, current mainstream solutions face a restrictive trade-off between λ and other essential properties, presenting a persistent challenge for the design of thermoconductive aramid papers. Herein, we report a multifunctional aramid composite dielectric paper constructed from one-dimensional (1D) aramid nanofibers (ANFs) as the structural scaffold, synergistically integrated with hydroxyl-functionalized 1D boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs) and 2D boron nitride nanosheets (BNNSs) as thermally conductive fillers. The composite paper features a hierarchically ordered self-assembled architecture that establishes an unobstructed 3D phonon transport network, wherein BNNTs serve as spatial bridges interconnecting isolated BNNSs. This structural synergy, coupled with robust interfacial bonding between ANFs and BNNTs as well as BNNSs, concurrently elevates the in-plane λ to 15.71 W·m–1·K–1 and the tensile strength to 283.36 MPa for the composite paper, representing 9.64-fold and 1.32-fold improvements over pristine ANF paper, respectively. Moreover, the nacre-inspired microstructure endows the composite paper with an ultrahigh breakdown strength of 349.06 kV/mm, wherein the abundant deep traps at the ANF-filler interfaces critically suppress charge carrier migration and prevent premature electrical breakdown. These multidimensional blocks design strategy offers a promising avenue for multifunctional dielectric materials tailored to the insulation systems of next-generation electrical and power equipment.
title_zh: 由渗透 3D 氮化硼网络和界面工程实现的仿珍珠母多功能芳纶介电纸
abstract_zh: 摘要 芳纶介电纸作为先进电机系统中核心绝缘材料的广泛采用，因其固有的低热导率 (λ) 而受到破坏，在严重的热电耦合应力下，会促进局部热点的形成并导致绝缘故障。然而，当前的主流解决方案面临着λ和其他基本特性之间的限制性权衡，这对导热芳纶纸的设计提出了持续的挑战。在此，我们报道了一种多功能芳纶复合介电纸，由一维（1D）芳纶纳米纤维（ANF）作为结构支架，与羟基功能化的一维氮化硼纳米管（BNNT）和二维氮化硼纳米片（BNNS）作为导热填料协同集成。该复合纸具有分层有序的自组装架构，可建立无障碍的 3D 声子传输网络，其中 BNNT 作为互连孤立的 BNNS 的空间桥梁。这种结构协同作用，加上 ANF 和 BNNT 以及 BNNS 之间强大的界面结合，同时将复合纸的面内 λ 提高到 15.71 W·m–1·K–1，拉伸强度提高到 283.36 MPa，分别比原始 ANF 纸提高了 9.64 倍和 1.32 倍。此外，受珍珠母启发的微结构赋予复合纸349.06 kV/mm的超高击穿强度，其中ANF-填料界面处丰富的深陷阱能够严重抑制载流子迁移并防止过早放电。
