title: Flexible 3D-Printed Piezoelectric and Bioinstructive Platforms for Skeletal Muscle Development and Organization
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Volumetric muscle loss (VML) is a devastating injury in which extensive skeletal muscle loss overwhelms endogenous healing. Despite their therapeutic efficacy, acellular constructs fail to provide a comprehensive set of bioactive cues required for muscle development. Notably, very few constructs provide bioelectrical cues necessary for muscle development. To address that need, this study aimed to develop a myogenic platform that provides a comprehensive set of bioactive cues, including bioelectrical cues that can be delivered wirelessly, to promote skeletal muscle development. To achieve this, we engineered a microchanneled, piezoelectric, 3D-printed platform based on a unique interpenetrating hydrogel network of gelatin methacrylate and poly(acrylic acid) that incorporates barium titanate nanoparticles. Rheological studies showed stable gel-like viscoelasticity and shear-thinning behavior of the hydrogels, indicating their suitability for extrusion-3D printing. Physicochemical characterization demonstrated the platform’s structural fidelity, precise microchannel definition, pronounced flexibility, and self-adhesiveness. While the platform’s stiffness was comparable to that of skeletal muscle, it also generated a surface potential of ∼90 mV when deformed by ultrasound (US), highlighting its piezoelectric nature and ability to harness electromechanically triggered bioelectrical cues. FE-SEM and immunofluorescence analyses revealed that microchannels and US-induced piezoelectricity from the platform can synergistically help form dense, compact, and aligned myotubes. Notably, we demonstrate that the US-induced piezoelectric platforms can promote early-stage myotube development, enhance myogenic progression, and help form mature, elongated, thick myotubes over time. Finally, we observe that the piezoelectric platforms exhibit increased FAK and MAPK activation in adherent cells over time, suggesting that these pathways can contribute to transducing electromechanical cues that promote myotube maturation. Overall, this is the first-of-its-kind comprehensive study to engineer a platform that delivers a comprehensive set of bioactive cues, specifically wirelessly delivered bioelectrical cues, resulting in a spatiotemporally bioinstructive microenvironment for skeletal muscle development. We believe this unique platform could be a promising regenerative therapy for VML.
title_zh: 用于骨骼肌发育和组织的灵活 3D 打印压电和生物指导平台
abstract_zh: 摘要 体积肌肉损失（VML）是一种毁灭性损伤，其中广泛的骨骼肌损失压倒了内源性愈合。尽管具有治疗功效，但无细胞结构无法提供肌肉发育所需的一套全面的生物活性线索。值得注意的是，很少有结构提供肌肉发育所需的生物电信号。为了满足这一需求，本研究旨在开发一个生肌平台，提供一套全面的生物活性线索，包括可以无线传递的生物电线索，以促进骨骼肌发育。为了实现这一目标，我们设计了一个微通道压电 3D 打印平台，该平台基于甲基丙烯酸明胶和聚丙烯酸的独特互穿水凝胶网络，并结合了钛酸钡纳米颗粒。流变学研究表明，水凝胶具有稳定的凝胶状粘弹性和剪切稀化行为，表明它们适合挤出 3D 打印。物理化学表征证明了该平台的结构保真度、精确的微通道定义、显着的灵活性和自粘性。虽然该平台的刚度与骨骼肌的刚度相当，但在超声波（美国）变形时，它还会产生 ~90 mV 的表面电势，突出了其压电性质和利用机电触发生物电线索的能力。 FE-SEM 和免疫荧光分析表明，微通道和来自平台的超声诱导压电可以协同帮助形成致密、紧凑和对齐的肌管。

title: Interfacial Chemistry of Storage-Induced Degradation in High-Nickel Cathodes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Interfacial instability in electrochemical systems remains a fundamental challenge, particularly in high-nickel layered oxides where reactive surfaces drive parasitic chemistry even under near-equilibrium conditions. Here, we elucidate the chemical origins of storage-induced degradation in LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 cathodes, showing that electrolyte decomposition and interfacial Ni dissolution are correlated processes that govern capacity loss during storage. Building on this mechanistic insight, we develop a data-driven framework for engineering cathode–electrolyte interphases (CEIs) by integrating density functional theory with machine-learning interatomic potentials. This approach enables rapid evaluation of molecular descriptors for a diverse set of electrolyte additives. Unsupervised clustering highlights lithium bis(oxalato)borate (LiBOB) and lithium trifluoromethanesulfinate as effective CEI-forming additives. Experimental validation confirms that incorporating 0.05 M LiBOB significantly stabilizes the interface, improving capacity retention from 82% to 95.5% after 28 days of storage at 60 °C, with consistent behavior in a pouch cell. Furthermore, interfacial stability is assessed using distribution-of-relaxation-time analysis, providing a practical descriptor for evaluating CEI evolution. This work establishes a generalizable, data-driven strategy for understanding and controlling interfacial reactivity in metastable electrochemical systems.
title_zh: 高镍阴极存储诱导降解的界面化学
abstract_zh: 摘要电化学系统中的界面不稳定性仍然是一个基本挑战，特别是在高镍层状氧化物中，即使在接近平衡的条件下，活性表面也会驱动寄生化学。在这里，我们阐明了 LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 正极存储引起的降解的化学起源，表明电解质分解和界面 Ni 溶解是控制存储过程中容量损失的相关过程。基于这种机制洞察，我们通过将密度泛函理论与机器学习原子间势相结合，开发了一个用于工程阴极电解质界面（CEIs）的数据驱动框架。这种方法能够快速评估多种电解质添加剂的分子描述符。无监督聚类强调双草酸硼酸锂 (LiBOB) 和三氟甲亚磺酸锂是有效的 CEI 形成添加剂。实验验证证实，加入 0.05 M LiBOB 可以显着稳定界面，在 60 °C 储存 28 天后容量保留率从 82% 提高到 95.5%，并且在软包电池中表现一致。此外，使用弛豫时间分布分析评估界面稳定性，为评估 CEI 演化提供实用的描述符。这项工作建立了一种可推广的、数据驱动的策略，用于理解和控制亚稳态电化学系统中的界面反应性。

title: A Site-Specific Organometallic Approach for Installing Tyrosine Phosphorylation Mimics to Decipher the Role of Phosphorylation in α-Synuclein Aggregation and Seeding
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Several studies have identified phosphorylation of α-synuclein (aSyn) at multiple tyrosine residues (Y39, Y125, Y133, and Y136) within Lewy bodies (LB), which are the pathological hallmarks of Parkinson’s disease (PD). However, understanding the specific role of phosphorylation at each site, or how multiple phosphorylation sites interact, has been challenging. Herein, we present an efficient method that leverages an organometallic Pd-complex to site-specifically attach phosphomimetic groups via Cys-arylation, closely mimicking natural phosphorylation. Using this approach, we successfully incorporated native-like tyrosine phosphorylation mimics into cysteine-containing proteins like synthetic transcription factor Max and recombinant aSyn, in good yields. To demonstrate the method’s versatility, we created a focused library of mono-, di-, and triphosphorylated aSyn analogues. This development enabled, for the first time, the investigation of the effect of site-specific phosphorylation at multiple C-terminal tyrosine residues on aSyn fibrillization and aggregation. Our results show that monophosphorylation at any of the C-terminal sites has little effect on aggregation, while di- and triphosphorylation slows down the process, extending the lag phase compared to wild-type aSyn. Additionally, phosphorylation at Y39 reduces the seeding activity of aSyn fibrils by almost 2–4-fold in both mammalian and neuronal models of synuclein pathology. Overall, our strategy provides a rapid, selective, and scalable way to introduce aromatic PTMs, producing homogeneous protein libraries essential for mechanistic studies, biomarker development, and exploring the therapeutic potential of targeting aSyn-phosphorylation for PD and related disorders.
title_zh: 一种用于安装酪氨酸磷酸化模拟物的位点特异性有机金属方法，以破译磷酸化在 α-突触核蛋白聚集和播种中的作用
abstract_zh: 摘要 多项研究已经确定路易体 (LB) 内多个酪氨酸残基（Y39、Y125、Y133 和 Y136）上的 α-突触核蛋白 (aSyn) 磷酸化，这是帕金森病 (PD) 的病理标志。然而，了解每个位点磷酸化的具体作用，或者多个磷酸化位点如何相互作用，一直具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种有效的方法，利用有机金属钯复合物通过半胱氨酸芳基化位点特异性地附着拟磷基团，非常模仿天然磷酸化。使用这种方法，我们成功地将类似天然的酪氨酸磷酸化模拟物整合到含有半胱氨酸的蛋白质中，例如合成转录因子 Max 和重组 aSyn，且产量良好。为了证明该方法的多功能性，我们创建了一个单磷酸化、二磷酸化和三磷酸化 aSyn 类似物的重点库。这一进展首次使得研究多个 C 末端酪氨酸残基的位点特异性磷酸化对 aSyn 原纤维化和聚集的影响成为可能。我们的结果表明，任何 C 端位点的单磷酸化对聚集的影响很小，而二磷酸化和三磷酸化则减慢了这一过程，与野生型 aSyn 相比延长了滞后期。此外，在突触核蛋白病理学的哺乳动物和神经元模型中，Y39 的磷酸化使 aSyn 原纤维的播种活性降低了近 2-4 倍。总体而言，我们的策略提供了一种快速、选择性和可扩展的方法来引入芳香族 PTM，产生均质蛋白质文库

title: Isothermal Capture and Release of Carbon Dioxide with a Porous Molecular Hexaamine
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The decarbonization of fossil fuel combustion streams and air is imperative to achieve negative carbon emissions and requires discovery of new materials that exhibit high CO2 capacities, long-term stability, and minimal energy input for the release of pure CO2. Numerous candidate sorbents have been reported, but none meet all of these requirements simultaneously. Our strategy for creating a material that does is centered on designing a crystalline molecular polyamine that retains porosity throughout CO2 absorption and desorption while achieving a high CO2 uptake capacity, thereby enabling meaningful CO2 capture and release under mild conditions. Here, we show that porous crystals of 2,3,6,7,14,15-hexakis(aminomethyl)triptycene (C20H8(CH2NH2)6, TriptH) capture CO2 from flue gas or air to form a porous ammonium carbamate network solid. The reversibility of the transformation is monitored in situ using powder X-ray diffraction, diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy, and solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy. Breakthrough analyses reveal that TriptH achieves a high CO2 capacity of 5.3 mmol/g under humid conditions, long-term oxidative and thermal stability through the course of 660 absorption–desorption cycles, and an unprecedented ability to capture CO2 from humid, low-concentration streams and release it with little or no temperature change and vacuum pressures as high as 100 mbar.
title_zh: 多孔分子六胺等温捕获和释放二氧化碳
abstract_zh: 摘要 化石燃料燃烧流和空气的脱碳对于实现负碳排放至关重要，并且需要发现具有高 CO2 容量、长期稳定性和释放纯 CO2 的最小能量输入的新材料。已经报道了许多候选吸附剂，但没有一种吸附剂能够同时满足所有这些要求。我们创造这种材料的策略集中于设计一种结晶分子多胺，该多胺在整个二氧化碳吸收和解吸过程中保持孔隙率，同时实现高二氧化碳吸收能力，从而在温和条件下实现有意义的二氧化碳捕获和释放。在这里，我们表明，2,3,6,7,14,15-六（氨甲基）三蝶烯（C20H8(CH2NH2)6, TriptH）的多孔晶体捕获烟气或空气中的CO2，形成多孔氨基甲酸铵网络固体。使用粉末 X 射线衍射、漫反射红外傅里叶变换光谱和固态核磁共振光谱原位监测转变的可逆性。突破性分析表明，TriptH 在潮湿条件下实现了 5.3 mmol/g 的高 CO2 容量，在 660 个吸收-解吸循环过程中具有长期的氧化和热稳定性，以及前所未有的从潮湿、低浓度流中捕获 CO2 并在温度变化很小或没有变化以及高达 100 mbar 的真空压力下释放 CO2 的能力。

title: Phased fuel transitions for decarbonizing the Asia–Europe Green Shipping Corridor
source: Nature Sustainability
abstract: International shipping stands at a pivotal juncture in its decarbonization efforts, yet a comprehensive assessment of viable fuel transition pathways remains scarce. Here we develop a dynamic life cycle assessment framework integrated with system dynamics to evaluate 13 alternative marine fuels (for example, ammonia, methanol, hydrogen and soybean-based biodiesel) for the Asia–Europe Green Shipping Corridor through 2050. The framework incorporates climate impacts, environmental sustainability, energy efficiency and economic feasibility. Under three scenarios (Business as Usual, Most Economical and Maximum Carbon Reduction), this study accounts for key dynamic parameters, including technology learning curves. Results indicate a phased transition: soybean-based biodiesel offers a near-term solution, while electrofuels dominate after 2040. The International Maritime Organization’s Net-Zero Framework progressively narrows regional cost–emission gaps, whereas the European Union’s FuelEU Maritime regulation introduces a cost premium of up to 7.6%. These results indicate that policy design and regulatory stringency substantially shape fuel transition trajectories for maritime decarbonization. Shipping remains almost entirely reliant on fossil fuels, and identifying viable fuel transition pathways under evolving regulations is a key challenge. A study now evaluates 13 alternative marine fuels for the Asia–Europe corridor, revealing phased transitions shaped by policy design and timing.
title_zh: 亚欧绿色航运走廊脱碳分阶段燃料转型
abstract_zh: 国际航运正处于脱碳努力的关键时刻，但对可行燃料转型途径的全面评估仍然很少。在这里，我们开发了一个与系统动力学相结合的动态生命周期评估框架，以评估到2050年亚欧绿色航运走廊的13种替代海洋燃料（例如氨、甲醇、氢气和大豆基生物柴油）。该框架涵盖了气候影响、环境可持续性、能源效率和经济可行性。在三种情景（一切照常、最经济和最大限度碳减排）下，本研究考虑了关键动态参数，包括技术学习曲线。结果表明，这是一个阶段性转变：大豆生物柴油提供了短期解决方案，而电燃料在 2040 年之后将占据主导地位。国际海事组织的净零框架逐步缩小区域成本与排放差距，而欧盟的 FuelEU 海事法规则引入了高达 7.6% 的成本溢价。这些结果表明，政策设计和监管严格程度在很大程度上影响了海上脱碳的燃料转型轨迹。航运业仍然几乎完全依赖化石燃料，在不断变化的法规下确定可行的燃料过渡途径是一个关键挑战。目前，一项研究评估了亚欧走廊的 13 种替代海洋燃料，揭示了由政策设计和时机决定的分阶段过渡。

title: Phased fuel transition for low-carbon shipping
source: Nature Sustainability
abstract: Along the Asia–Europe shipping corridor, biofuels offer the strongest near-term option, potentially cutting greenhouse gas emissions by 31–47%, while electrofuels become more competitive after 2040 under the International Maritime Organization Net-Zero Framework. Policymakers could therefore adopt a phased strategy that prioritizes biofuels now and prepares infrastructure for electrofuels after 2040, to avoid locking shipping into transitional fossil fuels. Prioritize sustainable biofuels for near-term cuts in greenhouse gas emissions. Expand renewable electricity supply to unlock the full climate benefits of electrofuels. Align regional carbon intensity targets with local electricity mixes. Anchor regulatory design in the IMO Net-Zero Framework for long-term investment stability. Prioritize sustainable biofuels for near-term cuts in greenhouse gas emissions. Expand renewable electricity supply to unlock the full climate benefits of electrofuels. Align regional carbon intensity targets with local electricity mixes. Anchor regulatory design in the IMO Net-Zero Framework for long-term investment stability.
title_zh: 低碳航运的分阶段燃料转型
abstract_zh: 在亚欧航运走廊沿线，生物燃料提供了最有力的近期选择，有可能将温室气体排放量减少 31-47%，而根据国际海事组织净零框架，2040 年后电燃料将变得更具竞争力。因此，政策制定者可以采取分阶段战略，即现在优先考虑生物燃料，并为 2040 年后的电燃料基础设施做好准备，以避免航运业锁定过渡化石燃料。优先考虑可持续生物燃料以减少近期温室气体排放。扩大可再生电力供应，充分发挥电燃料的气候效益。将区域碳强度目标与当地电力结构保持一致。将监管设计纳入 IMO 净零框架，以实现长期投资稳定性。优先考虑可持续生物燃料以减少近期温室气体排放。扩大可再生电力供应，充分发挥电燃料的气候效益。将区域碳强度目标与当地电力结构保持一致。将监管设计纳入 IMO 净零框架，以实现长期投资稳定性。

title: Beyond the engine room

abstract: Technological progress can help address the environmental impacts of shipping, but implementing solutions remains slow and problematic. Understanding shipping as a complex physical, economic and governance system is the key to accelerating a sustainable transition.

abstract_zh: 技术进步可以帮助解决航运对环境的影响，但解决方案的实施仍然缓慢且存在问题。将航运理解为一个复杂的物理、经济和治理系统是加速可持续转型的关键。

title: Near-Adjacent Heavy Lanthanide Separation and Sensing Using Dimerizing Lanmodulins
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Protein-based recovery, detection, and separation of rare earth elements (REs) have accelerated since the discovery of the lanmodulin (LanM) proteins. While exceptional at total RE recovery, prior proteins, like most ligands, exhibited limited ability to differentiate REs, whether in detection or separations. Here we report two dimerizing LanMs (Al-LanM and Xan-LanM) that address these challenges. Uniquely among biomolecules, these proteins promote luminescence of up to six specific REs, enabling their use as biosensors to prospect for bacteria that accumulate the valuable heavy RE, terbium. The average adjacent-element separation factor (SF) for Al-LanM and structure-guided variants over the range of 11 REs, Nd–Lu, is 2.1, among the best for any ligand, protein or otherwise. By construction and immobilization of tandem dimers of Al-LanM competent to self-dimerize, we nearly double SF(Nd/Dy) relative to the immobilized monomer, establishing that protein dimerization amplifies RE discrimination. Leveraging this on-column dimerization behavior, we achieve separation of Y, Dy, Gd, Sm, and Nd from one another to >95% purities from a mixed-RE leachate derived from allanite ore, with just one pH step per element. In achieving robust protein-based separations with the simplest desorption scheme to date, our work highlights the many knobs biology uses to tune metal ion selectivity and introduces high-performance bioligands to identify heavy RE-accumulating organisms and to separate the most valuable REs, NdIII–LuIII.
title_zh: 使用二聚 Lanmodulins 进行近邻重稀土分离和传感
abstract_zh: 摘要 自从发现兰莫杜林 (LanM) 蛋白以来，基于蛋白质的稀土元素 (RE) 回收、检测和分离已经加速。虽然在总 RE 回收率方面表现出色，但之前的蛋白质与大多数配体一样，无论是在检测还是分离中，区分 RE 的能力都有限。在这里，我们报告了两种二聚化 LanM（Al-LanM 和 Xan-LanM）来应对这些挑战。这些蛋白质在生物分子中独一无二，可促进多达六种特定 RE 的发光，使其能够用作生物传感器来寻找积累有价值的重 RE（铽）的细菌。 Al-LanM 和结构引导变体在 11 个 RE、Nd-Lu 范围内的平均相邻元素分离因子 (SF) 为 2.1，对于任何配体、蛋白质或其他物质来说都是最好的。通过构建和固定能够自二聚化的 Al-LanM 串联二聚体，我们相对于固定单体几乎加倍了 SF(Nd/Dy)，确定了蛋白质二聚化放大了 RE 辨别力。利用这种柱上二聚行为，我们从钠铜矿矿石中提取的混合稀土浸出液中实现了 Y、Dy、Gd、Sm 和 Nd 的相互分离，纯度达到 >95%，每种元素只需一个 pH 阶跃。在通过迄今为止最简单的解吸方案实现稳健的基于蛋白质的分离过程中，我们的工作强调了生物学用于调节金属离子选择性的许多旋钮，并引入高性能生物配体来识别重稀土积累生物体并分离最有价值的稀土，NdIII-LuIII。

title: Design of Chiral Antimony Catalyst for Ring-Opening Reaction of Epoxides with Anilines
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Pnictogen-bonding catalysis has emerged as a promising tool for noncovalent transformations; however, its application in asymmetric catalysis remains in its infancy, largely due to the scarcity of efficient chiral catalysts and activating modes. Herein, we report a new class of chiral antimony catalysts featuring strong σ-hole strength and a tunable chiral environment, which are readily assembled from tetraarylantimony bromides bearing electron-withdrawing substituents and chiral silver phosphates. These catalysts enable the asymmetric ring-opening of epoxides with anilines, affording a range of chiral β-amino alcohols in high yields and with excellent enantioselectivities. Mechanistic studies, including control experiments, NMR spectroscopy, and DFT calculations, reveal that this enhanced σ-hole character is crucial for the electrophilic activation of epoxides. Collectively, this work establishes chiral antimony catalysts as a powerful and general platform for asymmetric pnictogen-bonding catalysis.
title_zh: 环氧化物与苯胺开环反应的手性锑催化剂设计
abstract_zh: 摘要 氮键催化已成为一种有前景的非共价转化工具。然而，其在不对称催化中的应用仍处于起步阶段，这很大程度上是由于缺乏有效的手性催化剂和活化模式。在此，我们报道了一种新型手性锑催化剂，具有强σ-空穴强度和可调节的手性环境，该催化剂很容易由带有吸电子取代基的四芳基溴化锑和手性磷酸银组装而成。这些催化剂能够使环氧化物与苯胺发生不对称开环，以高产率和优异的对映选择性提供一系列手性 β-氨基醇。包括控制实验、核磁共振波谱和 DFT 计算在内的机理研究表明，这种增强的 σ 孔特征对于环氧化物的亲电活化至关重要。总的来说，这项工作将手性锑催化剂建立为不对称磷元素键合催化的强大且通用的平台。

title: Mastering Electrocatalytic Microenvironment Achieves Aqueous Hydrogen Batteries Exceeding 200 Wh kg–1
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract High-safety, low-cost, and long-life aqueous hydrogen gas batteries (AHGBs) driven by hydrogen electrocatalysts are considered one of the most reliable systems in advanced aqueous batteries for large-scale energy storage. However, the rational design of low-loading and high-activity electrocatalysts remains a challenge for bifunctional hydrogen oxidation and evolution reaction (HOR/HER) catalysis to unleash the potential for higher-performance AHGBs. In this study, we propose an atomic engineering approach that precisely tailors the reactive microenvironments for the catalytic interface in AHGBs. A coupling Ru-based catalyst with high activity is developed as a demonstration. Theoretical calculations and in situ spectroscopy reveal that the synergy between Ru and Ni sites effectively accelerates the microenvironmental water dissociation process, while the interfacial hydrogen bond network is significantly optimized, collectively accelerating reaction kinetics and facilitating mass transfer. The assembled nickel–hydrogen (Ni–H2) battery with a low loading of 40.5 μgRu cm–2 exhibits stability over 3000 cycles at a high current density of 30 mA cm–2, more than 4 times that of the battery with Pt/C catalyst. Importantly, a 5 Ah-scale Ni–H2 battery achieves the highest energy density of 204.4 Wh kg–1 among previously reported AHGBs, which even exceeds most state-of-the-art aqueous batteries and conventional LiFePO4 batteries. This work highlights atomic-level design for mastering reactive microenvironments, offering a strategy to develop efficient, low-cost electrocatalysts toward high-energy-density AHGBs in practical energy storage applications.
title_zh: 掌握电催化微环境实现水氢电池超过200 Wh kg–1
abstract_zh: 摘要：由氢电催化剂驱动的高安全性、低成本、长寿命的水系氢气电池（AHGB）被认为是用于大规模储能的先进水系电池中最可靠的系统之一。然而，低负载量和高活性电催化剂的合理设计仍然是双功能氢氧化和析出反应（HOR/HER）催化释放更高性能AHGB潜力的挑战。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种原子工程方法，可以精确定制 AHGB 催化界面的反应微环境。开发了一种高活性的偶联钌基催化剂作为示范。理论计算和原位光谱表明，Ru和Ni位点之间的协同作用有效加速了微环境水的解离过程，同时界面氢键网络显着优化，共同加速了反应动力学并促进了传质。组装的镍氢（Ni-H2）电池具有40.5 μgRu cm-2的低负载量，在30 mA cm-2的高电流密度下表现出超过3000次循环的稳定性，是使用Pt/C催化剂的电池的4倍以上。重要的是，在之前报道的AHGB中，5 Ah规模的Ni-H2电池实现了204.4 Wh kg-1的最高能量密度，甚至超过了大多数最先进的水性电池和传统的LiFePO4电池。这项工作强调了掌握反应微环境的原子级设计，提供了开发高效、低成本电催化剂的策略

title: Atomically thin amorphous carbon with an ultralow dielectric constant
source: Nature Electronics
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) materials exhibit excellent properties at monolayer thickness and are viable replacements for various microelectronic components as scaling gradually approaches the atomic limit. Despite significant advancements in the ongoing 2D revolution of integrated circuits, one crucial building block, namely a 2D ultralow-k (ULK) dielectric, remains unreported. The challenge lies in achieving a dielectric constant less than 3, as traditional low-k dielectrics are inherently unstable at the 2D limit due to their amorphous or porous nature. The realisation of ultrathin dielectrics with low-k is also needed to address current bottlenecks in integrated circuits scaling. Specifically, low-k materials are necessary to minimise parasitic capacitances as the distance between conductive elements shrinks below 10 nm. Moreover, advanced architectures like gate-all-around field effect transistors (GAA FET) require even lower dielectric constants (k<2) at sub-3nm thickness. Here, we show that layer-by-layer grown multilayer amorphous carbon (ML-AC), as thin as 0.8 nm, is a mechanically robust 2D ULK dielectric with k of 1.35 and dielectric strength of 28-31 MV cm-1. The lack of any long-range order, its intrinsic 2D nature, sp2 carbon character and low density are all essential for minimising dielectric permittivity. Moreover, ML-AC overcomes the vulnerability of existing dielectrics to ion diffusion degradation with a record metal ion diffusion time to failure (TTF) of 10^10 s for even a single layer. Therefore, otherwise necessary additional layers occupying up to 3 nm can be eliminated, which is especially significant as metal line widths approach 10 nm. Combined with its low-temperature, direct and conformal growth even on a dielectric, these critical features enable substantial improvements in silicon-based semiconductor electronics and ensure compatibility with future 2D electronics.
title_zh: 具有超低介电常数的原子薄非晶碳
abstract_zh: 二维（2D）材料在单层厚度下表现出优异的性能，并且随着尺寸逐渐接近原子极限，成为各种微电子元件的可行替代品。尽管正在进行的集成电路二维革命取得了重大进展，但一个关键的构建模块，即二维超低 k (ULK) 电介质，仍然没有报道。挑战在于实现小于 3 的介电常数，因为传统的低 k 电介质由于其非晶或多孔性质，在 2D 极限下本质上不稳定。还需要实现低 k 超薄电介质来解决当前集成电路尺寸缩小的瓶颈。具体来说，当导电元件之间的距离缩小到 10 nm 以下时，需要使用低 k 材料来最大限度地减少寄生电容。此外，诸如环栅场效应晶体管 (GAA FET) 等先进架构在厚度低于 3nm 时需要更低的介电常数 (k<2)。在这里，我们证明了薄至 0.8 nm 的逐层生长的多层非晶碳 (ML-AC) 是一种机械坚固的 2D ULK 电介质，k 为 1.35，介电强度为 28-31 MV cm-1。缺乏任何长程有序、其固有的二维性质、sp2碳特征和低密度对于最小化介电常数都是至关重要的。此外，ML-AC 克服了现有电介质对离子扩散退化的脆弱性，即使单层金属离子扩散失效时间 (TTF) 也达到创纪录的 10^10 秒。因此，否则需要占用高达 3 nm 的附加层

title: Dual-Channel Energy Transfer from Ligand-Centered Singlet and Triplet States to Trivalent Lanthanide Ions
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Efficient light harvesting and subsequent energy transfer (EnT) to trivalent lanthanide ions (LnIII) are critical for achieving high-performance luminescent LnIII complexes. However, because of the complexity of the underlying dynamic processes, in-depth investigations of their sensitization mechanisms are still limited. In this work, we systematically studied three neutral LnIII complexes (GdIIIL, TbIIIL, and EuIIIL), all featuring the same carbostyril ligand, using steady-state and transient absorption and emission spectroscopy. Our study revealed efficient intersystem crossing (ISC) from the ligand-centered lowest singlet excited state (S1) to the ligand-centered lowest triplet excited state (T1) in GdIIIL, as well as dual-channel EnT from both ligand-centered S1 and T1 to the metal-centered excited state (LnIII*) in TbIIIL and EuIIIL. More importantly, the competition between ISC and EnT from the ligand-centered S1 determines the predominant sensitization pathway, resulting in the main EnT from T1 in TbIIIL, while EnT is from S1 in EuIIIL. These findings provide deeper insights into the sensitization mechanisms of LnIII complexes and offer valuable guidance for the design of new LnIII-based luminescent materials.
title_zh: 从配体中心单线态和三线态到三价镧系离子的双通道能量转移
abstract_zh: 摘要 高效的光捕获和随后的能量转移 (EnT) 到三价镧系元素离子 (LnIII) 对于实现高性能发光 LnIII 配合物至关重要。然而，由于潜在动态过程的复杂性，对其敏化机制的深入研究仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们使用稳态和瞬态吸收和发射光谱系统地研究了三种中性 LnIII 配合物（GdIIIL、TbIIIL 和 EuIIIL），它们都具有相同的喹诺酮配体。我们的研究揭示了 GdIIIL 中从配体中心最低单重激发态 (S1) 到配体中心最低三重激发态 (T1) 的有效系间穿越 (ISC)，以及从配体中心 S1 和 T1 到 TbIIIL 和 EuIIIL 中金属中心激发态 (LnIII*) 的双通道 EnT。更重要的是，ISC和EnT之间来自以配体为中心的S1的竞争决定了主要的敏化途径，导致TbIIIL中的主要EnT来自T1，而EuIIIL中的EnT来自S1。这些发现为LnIII配合物的敏化机制提供了更深入的见解，并为新型LnIII基发光材料的设计提供了有价值的指导。

title: Decoding TnsC Filament Assembly in CRISPR-Associated Transposons Using Interpretable Deep Learning and Molecular Simulations
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract CRISPR-associated transposons (CASTs) enable programmable DNA integration, yet how the TnsC regulator forms processive filaments on DNA to coordinate RNA-guided transposition in type V-K CAST systems remains unknown. Here, we integrate large-scale molecular simulations, interpretable deep learning using graph attention networks (GATs), and causal inference analyses to define the molecular determinants of TnsC filament nucleation and elongation. We show that TnsC nucleates by inducing localized DNA deformation that propagates along extended filaments, with Granger causality revealing that TnsC motions precede and predict DNA deformation. Interpretable GAT models demonstrate that elongation is determined during early recognition between incoming and DNA-bound subunits, followed by structural reorganization that regenerates the recruitment interface and enables processive assembly. These results elucidate the molecular mechanism of processive TnsC filament assembly and explain why isolated TnsC filaments preferentially elongate in the 5′ → 3′ direction, while accessory transposition factors can reshape the interaction landscape and alter filament growth polarity. Together, these findings advance our understanding of CAST function and inform the engineering of programmable DNA integration platforms. Beyond CAST systems, this work introduces an interpretable GAT approach as a general and transferable deep learning strategy for uncovering molecular mechanisms in biological systems, while demonstrating the power of causal inference for dissecting directional relationships in molecular dynamics.
title_zh: 使用可解释的深度学习和分子模拟解码 CRISPR 相关转座子中的 TnsC 丝组装
abstract_zh: 摘要 CRISPR 相关转座子 (CAST) 能够实现可编程 DNA 整合，但 TnsC 调节因子如何在 DNA 上形成持续丝以协调 V-K 型 CAST 系统中 RNA 引导的转座仍然未知。在这里，我们整合了大规模分子模拟、使用图注意网络 (GAT) 的可解释深度学习以及因果推理分析来定义 TnsC 丝成核和伸长的分子决定因素。我们表明，TnsC 通过诱导沿着延伸丝传播的局部 DNA 变形来成核，格兰杰因果关系揭示了 TnsC 运动先于并预测 DNA 变形。可解释的 GAT 模型表明，伸长是在传入亚基和 DNA 结合亚基之间的早期识别过程中确定的，随后进行结构重组，重新生成招募界面并实现加工组装。这些结果阐明了进行性 TnsC 丝组装的分子机制，并解释了为什么孤立的 TnsC 丝优先沿 5′ → 3′ 方向伸长，而辅助转座因子可以重塑相互作用景观并改变丝生长极性。总之，这些发现增进了我们对 CAST 功能的理解，并为可编程 DNA 集成平台的工程设计提供了信息。除了 CAST 系统之外，这项工作还引入了一种可解释的 GAT 方法，作为一种通用且可转移的深度学习策略，用于揭示生物系统中的分子机制，同时展示因果推理在剖析方向关系方面的力量

title: Black carbon emissions and climate impacts of cost-saving Arctic transit shipping through 2050
source: Nature Sustainability
abstract: Arctic transit routes offer economic gains from shorter voyages but increase regional black carbon deposition on snow and ice. A study now models the economic benefits and climate impacts of Arctic transit shipping through 2050, exploring the trade-offs of different policies.
title_zh: 到 2050 年节约成本的北极过境运输的黑碳排放和气候影响
abstract_zh: 北极过境航线可以通过较短的航程带来经济收益，但会增加冰雪上的区域黑碳沉积。目前，一项研究对 2050 年北极过境运输的经济效益和气候影响进行了建模，探讨了不同政策的权衡。

title: Diradical Character of Cyclic Allenes Enables Their Thermal (2 + 2) Cycloadditions
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract (2 + 2) Cycloadditions are a versatile transformation often employed in the synthesis of cyclobutanes. Such cycloadditions usually require the use of light or another synthetic workaround, given that thermal (2 + 2) cycloadditions are orbital symmetry-forbidden for unstrained all-suprafacial transition states. A unique type of (2 + 2) cycloaddition involves transient strained cyclic allenes, which proceed readily at ambient temperature without external stimuli. In the present study, computations and experiments show that the feasibility of these cycloadditions is tied to the inherent diradical character of the cyclic allenes. Moreover, comparative stereochemical transfer experiments for Diels–Alder and (2 + 2) cycloadditions are consistent with strained cyclic allenes having both closed- and open-shell character, thus rendering them diradicaloids. This study is expected to prompt the further strategic use of diradicaloids for the assembly of complex scaffolds.
title_zh: 环烯的双自由基特征使其能够进行热 (2 + 2) 环加成
abstract_zh: 摘要 (2 + 2) 环加成是一种通用的转化，常用于环丁烷的合成。考虑到热 (2 + 2) 环加成对于无应变的全表面过渡态来说是轨道对称性禁止的，此类环加成通常需要使用光或其他合成解决方法。一种独特类型的 (2 + 2) 环加成涉及瞬态应变环状丙二烯，其在环境温度下无需外部刺激即可轻松进行。在本研究中，计算和实验表明这些环加成的可行性与环状丙二烯固有的双自由基特征有关。此外，Diels-Alder 和 (2 + 2) 环加成的比较立体化学转移实验与具有闭壳和开壳特征的应变环状丙二烯一致，从而使它们成为双自由基。这项研究预计将促进双自由基进一步战略性地用于复杂支架的组装。

title: Iteratively Designed Phospholipid-Targeted Supramolecular Sonosensitizers for Precision Treatment of Pulmonary Infections
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Fungal infections represent a significant global health threat, exacerbated by the scarcity of new therapeutic options, increasing drug resistance, and host toxicity. Sonodynamic therapy (SDT) offers a promising approach to overcoming antimicrobial resistance by enabling the localized generation of cytotoxic reactive oxygen species (ROS) within deep-seated lesions. Nevertheless, reports of SDT for in vivo antifungal treatment remain scarce, largely due to suboptimal ROS generation efficiency, poor biofilm penetration, and a lack of fungal specificity. Herein, we report the iterative design of RuB-C12, a phospholipid-targeted supramolecular sonosensitizer assembled via molecular engineering of ligand and acceptor building blocks into a Ru(II) metallocycle. Upon ultrasound activation, RuB-C12 markedly enhances ROS production while simultaneously improving the fungal membrane affinity and biofilm penetration. Mechanistic studies reveal that RuB-C12 effectively eradicates pathogenic yeasts by disrupting phospholipid phase transitions and perturbing intracellular redox homeostasis. Notably, RuB-C12 demonstrates a superior selectivity index (SI = 10–20) toward mammalian cells compared with the clinically approved amphotericin B (SI < 5). In murine models of wound and pulmonary Candida albicans infections as well as in clinical specimens, RuB-C12-mediated SDT significantly reduces fungal burden without inducing observable systemic toxicity. Collectively, this work highlights host–pathogen lipid disparity as a promising paradigm for developing precision antifungal strategies.
title_zh: 迭代设计的磷脂靶向超分子声敏剂用于肺部感染的精准治疗
abstract_zh: 摘要 真菌感染对全球健康构成重大威胁，新的治疗选择的缺乏、耐药性的增加和宿主毒性加剧了这一威胁。声动力疗法（SDT）通过在深部病变内局部产生细胞毒性活性氧（ROS），为克服抗菌药物耐药性提供了一种有前途的方法。然而，用于体内抗真菌治疗的 SDT 的报道仍然很少，这主要是由于 ROS 生成效率欠佳、生物膜渗透性差以及缺乏真菌特异性。在此，我们报告了 RuB-C12 的迭代设计，RuB-C12 是一种磷脂靶向超分子声敏剂，通过配体和受体构建块的分子工程组装成 Ru(II) 金属环。超声激活后，RuB-C12 显着增强 ROS 产生，同时提高真菌膜亲和力和生物膜渗透性。机理研究表明，RuB-C12 通过破坏磷脂相变和扰乱细胞内氧化还原稳态来有效消除致病酵母。值得注意的是，与临床批准的两性霉素 B (SI < 5) 相比，RuB-C12 对哺乳动物细胞表现出优异的选择性指数 (SI = 10–20)。在伤口和肺部白色念珠菌感染的小鼠模型以及临床标本中，RuB-C12 介导的 SDT 显着降低了真菌负荷，且不会引起可观察到的全身毒性。总的来说，这项工作强调了宿主与病原体的脂质差异是开发精确抗真菌策略的一个有前途的范例

title: Low-Symmetry Crown Ether Design for Coexisting Ferroelectricity and Ferromagnetism in a Two-Dimensional Molecular Crystal
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Multiferroics combining ferroelectricity and ferromagnetism within a single phase are promising materials for magnetoelectric (ME) functionalities. Compared with oxide-based systems, molecular materials offer greater structural tunability for realizing coupled ferroic behavior. Here we report a low-symmetry crown ether design for constructing a layered molecular crystal of [(o-fluoroanilinium+)(benzo[18]crown-6)][MnIICrIII(oxalate)3]−, in which supramolecular ferroelectricity coexists with two-dimensional ferromagnetic layers. This compound undergoes a reversible, single-crystal-to-single-crystal phase transition driven by the reorientation and conformational change of the polar benzo[18]crown-6 molecule, involving a 180° in-plane rotation and transformation of a polar V-shaped conformation into a planar configuration. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction, dielectric measurements, pyroelectric current, P–E hysteresis loops, and magnetic susceptibility measurements support the coexistence of ferroelectricity and ferromagnetism. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations and structural analysis identify the noncollinear supramolecular geometry of benzo[18]crown-6 units, their tilted assemblies, and the bistable motion as the origin of spontaneous polarization. This work demonstrates the effectiveness of the low-symmetry crown ether in designing molecular multiferroics.
title_zh: 二维分子晶体中铁电性和铁磁性共存的低对称冠醚设计
abstract_zh: 摘要 在单相中结合铁电性和铁磁性的多铁性材料是具有磁电（ME）功能的有前景的材料。与基于氧化物的系统相比，分子材料为实现耦合铁电行为提供了更大的结构可调性。在这里，我们报告了一种低对称性冠醚设计，用于构建[(o-氟苯胺+)(苯并[18]冠-6)][MnIICrIII(草酸盐)3]−层状分子晶体，其中超分子铁电性与二维铁磁层共存。该化合物在极性苯并[18]冠6分子的重新取向和构象变化的驱动下经历可逆的单晶到单晶相变，涉及180°面内旋转以及极性V形构象向平面构型的转变。单晶 X 射线衍射、介电测量、热释电流、P-E 磁滞回线和磁化率测量支持铁电性和铁磁性的共存。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和结构分析确定了苯并[18]冠6单元的非共线超分子几何形状、它们的倾斜组装体以及作为自发极化起源的双稳态运动。这项工作证明了低对称性冠醚在设计分子多铁性材料中的有效性。

title: Expanding the Hydrocarbon Landscape: Stereoselective Synthesis of Functionalized ttt -[13]Graphanes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Despite the significant interest in rigid, sp3-rich 3D hydrocarbon frameworks in medicinal and materials chemistry, the [13]graphanyl scaffold has remained synthetically prohibitive and, consequently, underexplored. Herein, we report a scalable, de novo stereoselective synthesis of the ttt-[13]graphanyl architecture utilizing a key dienyne metathesis cascade. To overcome the profound steric shielding at the central carbon vertex, we harnessed radical-mediated photocatalytic decarboxylation to install diverse functional groups, generating a library of centrally derivatized ttt-[13]G analogues. Complementary peripheral functionalization was also achieved via site-selective MHAT chemistry. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations rationalized the empirical reactivity trends, mapping the competitive landscape between Giese additions and hydrogen-atom transfer quenching. Finally, X-ray crystallographic analyses confirmed a substituent-dependent “doming” distortion of the rigid tricyclic framework. Together, these results provide a synthetic foundation to incorporate the [13]graphane architecture into advanced functional molecules, offering a new 3D node for rational molecular design.
title_zh: 扩大碳氢化合物景观：功能化ttt-[13]石墨烷的立体选择性合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管医药和材料化学领域对刚性、富含 sp3 的 3D 碳氢框架非常感兴趣，但 [13] 石墨烷基支架的合成仍然受到限制，因此尚未得到充分开发。在此，我们报告了一种利用关键二烯复分解级联的 ttt-[13]graphanyl 结构的可扩展、从头立体选择性合成。为了克服中心碳顶点的深刻空间屏蔽，我们利用自由基介导的光催化脱羧来安装不同的官能团，生成中心衍生化的 ttt-[13]G 类似物库。互补的外设功能化也通过位点选择性 MHAT 化学实现。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算合理化了经验反应性趋势，绘制了吉斯添加和氢原子转移猝灭之间的竞争格局。最后，X射线晶体学分析证实了刚性三环骨架的依赖于取代基的“拱形”变形。总之，这些结果为将[13]石墨烷结构融入先进的功能分子提供了综合基础，为合理的分子设计提供了新的3D节点。

title: Conceptual Shift in Our Understanding of Degenerate Radical Spin Systems: Spin-Rotation Coupling Turned on Its Head
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract For most chemists, Kramers’ degeneracy refers to the fact that for any radical system, every potential energy surface is at least doubly degenerate (with spin up and spin down, time-reversed solutions) for all nuclear positions X. Yet, as is well-known to the community of spin chemists, one can experimentally detect a splitting of most rotational levels for a doublet system, highlighting that nuclear motion breaks the spin degeneracy of such Born–Oppenheimer (BO) electronic states. Thus, the implications of BO degeneracy are very limited for spectroscopy unless one further includes nuclear-electronic entanglement in a robust fashion; indeed, understanding radical molecules (and the degeneracy of their stationary states) can be quite nonintuitive within the paradigm of BO potential energy surfaces. As an alternative to BO theory, recent developments have suggested characterizing radical potential energy surfaces as functions of both nuclear position X and nuclear momentum P, an approach which has been shown to recover a host of observables outside of BO theory, e.g., vibrational circular dichroism, Raman optical activity, and lambda-doubling. Here, we show that such a technique predicts that different spin states will follow different (nondegenerate) potential energy surfaces and that the differences in these spin-dependent surfaces are quantitatively consistent with experimental spin-rotation couplings─all without contradiction to overall Kramers’ degeneracy. Thus, the present finding suggests that there is still much to learn about spin-resolved molecular reactivity, demanding a conceptual shift in our understanding of coupled spin-nuclear motion, especially in chiral molecules and materials where spin-separation is known to arise.
title_zh: 我们对简并自由基自旋系统理解的概念转变：自旋-旋转耦合的彻底转变
abstract_zh: 摘要 对于大多数化学家来说，克莱默简并性是指对于任何自由基系统，对于所有核位置 X，每个势能面至少是双重简并的（具有自旋向上和自旋向下，时间反转解）。然而，正如自旋化学家群体所熟知的那样，人们可以通过实验检测到双重态系统的大多数旋转能级的分裂，这强调了核运动打破了这种玻恩-奥本海默（BO）电子态的自旋简并性。因此，BO简并性对于光谱学的影响非常有限，除非进一步以一种稳健的方式包括核电子纠缠。事实上，在 BO 势能面的范式中，理解自由基分子（及其稳态的简并性）可能非常不直观。作为 BO 理论的替代方案，最近的发展建议将自由基势能表面表征为核位置 X 和核动量 P 的函数，这种方法已被证明可以恢复 BO 理论之外的许多可观察量，例如振动圆二色性、拉曼旋光性和 lambda 倍增。在这里，我们证明这种技术预测不同的自旋态将遵循不同的（非简并）势能表面，并且这些自旋相关表面的差异在数量上与实验自旋旋转耦合一致——所有这些都不与总体克莱默简并性相矛盾。因此，目前的发现表明，关于自旋分辨分子反应还有很多东西需要了解。

title: Dinuclear Complexes of Linear, Two-Coordinate Iron(II) and Cobalt(II): Geometric Control over Magnetic Exchange between Anisotropic Metal Centers
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Magnetic exchange coupling between high-anisotropy spin centers is a key requirement for single-molecule magnets with high operating temperatures. Here, we report the synthesis and characterization of the dinuclear iron(II) and cobalt(II) complexes [(iPr3Si)(Dipp)NFe]2(m-(NSiMe3)2C6Me3H) (m-Fe2), [(iPr3Si)(Dipp)NFe]2(p-(NSiMe3)2C6Me4) (p-Fe2), and [(iPr3Si)(Dipp)NCo]2(p-(NSiMe3)2C6Me4) (p-Co2), with each metal center residing in a linear, two-coordinate geometry. In these complexes, the two high-magnetic-anisotropy metal centers are linked through a meta- or para-bis(amido)arene, which mediates ferro- or antiferromagnetic superexchange, respectively. Variable-temperature magnetic susceptibility data reveal antiferromagnetic coupling in the para-substituted complexes, giving S = 0 ground states with exchange constants of −3.56(5) cm–1 for p-Fe2 and −9.82(15) cm–1 for p-Co2. In stark contrast, the meta-linker in m-Fe2 mediates weak ferromagnetic exchange (+0.44(1) cm–1), leading to an S = 4 ground state. Here, the coexistence of ferromagnetic coupling and strong single-ion anisotropy gives rise to single-molecule-magnet behavior with a relaxation barrier of 139 cm–1, the highest yet reported for a multinuclear transition metal complex, and the coupling markedly suppresses the fast through-barrier quantum relaxation that plagues related mononuclear species. To gain a microscopic understanding of the magnetic exchange in this family of complexes, we employed a combination of far-infrared magnetospectroscopy and computation. While a spin-only model reproduces the spectroscopic energy levels well, the substantial unquenched orbital angular momentum at the FeII and CoIIcenters inspired a fully ab initio treatment of the electronic structure, crystal-field splitting, and exchange constants. These calculations indicate that both the sign and the magnitude of the exchange constant depend strongly on the linker geometry.
title_zh: 线性双配位铁（II）和钴（II）双核配合物：各向异性金属中心之间磁交换的几何控制
abstract_zh: 摘要 高各向异性自旋中心之间的磁交换耦合是高工作温度单分子磁体的关键要求。在这里，我们报告了双核铁（II）和钴（II）络合物[(iPr3Si)(Dipp)NFe]2(m-(NSiMe3)2C6Me3H) (m-Fe2)、[(iPr3Si)(Dipp)NFe]2(p-(NSiMe3)2C6Me4) (p-Fe2)和[(iPr3Si)(Dipp)NCo]2(p-(NSiMe3)2C6Me4) (p-Co2)，每个金属中心都位于线性、双坐标几何形状中。在这些配合物中，两个高磁各向异性金属中心通过间位或对位双（酰胺基）芳烃连接，分别介导铁磁或反铁磁超交换。变温磁化率数据揭示了对位取代配合物中的反铁磁耦合，给出 S = 0 基态，p-Fe2 的交换常数为 -3.56(5) cm–1，p-Co2 的交换常数为 -9.82(15) cm–1。形成鲜明对比的是，m-Fe2 中的元连接体介导弱铁磁交换 (+0.44(1) cm–1)，导致 S = 4 基态。在这里，铁磁耦合和强单离子各向异性的共存产生了单分子磁体行为，其弛豫势垒为139 cm-1，这是迄今为止报道的多核过渡金属配合物的最高势垒，并且耦合显着抑制了困扰相关单核物种的快速穿过势垒量子弛豫。为了从微观上了解这一系列复合物中的磁交换，我们结合了远红外磁谱和计算。虽然仅自旋模型再现了光谱

title: Organometallic-Free Catalytic Cross-Electrophile Methylation of Aryl Halides
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The “Magic Methyl Effect” stands for the welcoming effect of the methyl group in enhancing the potency of drug precursors. To date, no catalytic chemical route for methylation of aryl halides that excludes organometallic species is known. In this report, we introduce an organometallic-free cross electrophile methylation of aryl halides based on the generation of a methyl anion achieved under chemical conditions. It successfully methylated several strong bonds, such as CAr–Br, CAr–Cl, and CAr–F. This catalytic protocol was further diversified by preparing methyl derivatives of various clinically used antidepressants and antipsychotic drugs. Furthermore, we have demonstrated that the methylated product of one such drug molecule has significantly superior suppressive effects on neural activity as compared to the clinically active nonmethylated parent drug.
title_zh: 芳基卤化物的无有机金属催化交叉电试剂甲基化
abstract_zh: 摘要 “神奇甲基效应”是指甲基对增强药物前体效力的欢迎效应。迄今为止，还没有已知排除有机金属物质的芳基卤化物甲基化的催化化学路线。在本报告中，我们介绍了基于在化学条件下产生甲基阴离子的芳基卤化物的无有机金属交叉亲电子试剂甲基化。它成功地甲基化了几个强键，例如 CAr-Br、CAr-Cl 和 CAr-F。通过制备各种临床使用的抗抑郁药和抗精神病药物的甲基衍生物，该催化方案进一步多样化。此外，我们已经证明，与临床活性非甲基化母体药物相比，一种此类药物分子的甲基化产物对神经活动具有显着优越的抑制作用。

title: Unsymmetric Benzo[ b ]phosphole-Fused Diarylethenes: From Enhanced Photochromic Behavior to Solution-Processable Photoswitchable Organic Resistive Memory Devices
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Several unsymmetric photoswitchable benzo[b]phosphole-fused diarylethenes have been synthesized. Compared with their symmetric counterparts, the photochromic properties of the unsymmetric benzo[b]phosphole-fused diarylethenes, including photocycloreversion efficiency, fatigue resistance, and thermal irreversibility, have been significantly enhanced. Through rational molecular design, the lowest-energy absorption band can be efficiently tuned. One derivative has served as the active component for the fabrication of optical memory storage, and two of them have been employed in the fabrication of photoswitchable organic resistive memory devices, which demonstrate low turn-on voltage, narrow operating bias, large ON/OFF ratio, and prolonged retention time. The devices exhibit distinctive resistive memory behavior in their open and closed forms.
title_zh: 不对称苯并[b]磷稠化二芳基乙烯：从增强的光致变色行为到可溶液加工的光开关有机电阻存储器件
abstract_zh: 摘要 已经合成了几种不对称光开关苯并[b]磷杂环稠合二芳基乙烯。与对称对应物相比，不对称苯并[b]磷杂环稠合二芳基乙烯的光致变色性能，包括光环回复效率、抗疲劳性和热不可逆性，得到了显着增强。通过合理的分子设计，可以有效地调节最低能量吸收带。一种衍生物已作为制造光存储存储的有源元件，其中两种已用于制造光可切换有机电阻存储器件，其具有低开启电压、窄工作偏压、大开/关比和延长的保留时间。这些器件在开放和封闭形式下表现出独特的电阻存储行为。

title: Cation Coordination Preferences toward Stacking Design in Layered Perovskites along the Perovskite [111] Direction
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Crystal structures, particularly those of oxides, are viewed as architectures composed of coordination polyhedra, such as tetrahedra, octahedra, and cuboctahedra. While this perspective has long enabled electronic tuning via elemental substitution within known frameworks, its application to the design of new crystal structures remains limited. In this study, we explore cation coordination preferences as a design guideline for understanding and biasing the stacking periodicity of oxygen-deficient [111]p-layered perovskites (p denotes a primitive cubic perovskite cell), which consist of sequential tetrahedral and octahedral layers. We statistically analyzed coordination environments across a crystallographic database, identifying each cation’s coordination preference. By selecting appropriate cations with strong tetrahedral or octahedral coordination preferences, we successfully obtained two independent series of [111]p-layered perovskite compounds using different approaches: (i) elemental ratio tuning in the Ba–Sc–Ti–Ge–O system and (ii) valence-state control via nitridation in the Sr–V–O–N system. The appropriate ratio of tetrahedral- and octahedral-preferring cations enables tuning of stacking tendencies. Additional parameters, such as cation size and external pressure, further influence the detailed local structures, as revealed by theoretical calculations. These results highlight the role of local coordination preference to rationally design infinite crystal architectures.
title_zh: 层状钙钛矿沿钙钛矿[111]方向堆叠设计的阳离子配位偏好
abstract_zh: 摘要 晶体结构，特别是氧化物的晶体结构，被视为由配位多面体（例如四面体、八面体和立方八面体）组成的结构。虽然这种观点长期以来一直通过已知框架内的元素替代实现电子调谐，但其在新晶体结构设计中的应用仍然有限。在本研究中，我们探索阳离子配位偏好作为设计指南，用于理解和偏置缺氧[111]p层状钙钛矿（p表示原始立方钙钛矿电池）的堆积周期，该钙钛矿由连续的四面体和八面体层组成。我们对晶体数据库中的配位环境进行了统计分析，确定了每个阳离子的配位偏好。通过选择具有强四面体或八面体配位偏好的适当阳离子，我们使用不同的方法成功获得了两个独立系列的[111]p层状钙钛矿化合物：（i）Ba-Sc-Ti-Ge-O系统中的元素比例调整和（ii）Sr-V-O-N系统中通过氮化控制价态。偏好四面体和八面体的阳离子的适当比例能够调节堆积趋势。正如理论计算所揭示的，其他参数，例如阳离子尺寸和外部压力，进一步影响详细的局部结构。这些结果凸显了局部协调偏好在合理设计无限晶体结构中的作用。

title: Mass Spectrometric Footprinting and DFT Calculations Explain the Effect of Curcumin on the Aggregation of Amyloid β 42 (Aβ42)
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Curcumin, a polyphenolic natural product, binds to Aβ42, a protein involved in Alzheimer’s Disease, to inhibit self-aggregation in vitro. Molecular understanding of the binding is important in designing new molecules to inhibit Aβ42 aggregation. We performed OH radical footprinting of Aβ42 in the presence and absence of curcumin by using fast photochemical oxidation of proteins (FPOP), followed by mass spectral analysis, to monitor changes in Aβ42 protein dynamics in the presence of curcumin. The results reveal that curcumin binding reduces oxidative footprinting at the N-terminus and middle region, indicating binding at these sites. Kinetic modeling of the percentage modification shows a significant change in the aggregation of Aβ42 in the presence of curcumin, whereby one aggregate population nearly disappears. The [Aβ42:curcumin] binding complexes were also explored using density functional theory (DFT), optimizating the starting structures at the B3LYP/6–31G(d) level for both the N-terminal/middle and C-terminal/middle regions. The structure of the lowest-energy complex has curcumin binding at the N-terminal plus middle regions, and this was validated by reoptimization using 6–311G(d,p) and applying Grimme’s dispersion function (GD3). This structure was further confirmed by reoptimization in aqueous media using the Conductor-like Polarizable Continuum Model (CPCM). The new structure not only accounts for the observed changes in •OH footprinting of the N-terminal, middle, and C-terminal regions but also forecasts how this approach can provide insight into protein aggregation. A molecular-level understanding of the binding site of curcumin with Aβ42 should be helpful in the design of new aggregation modulators.
title_zh: 质谱足迹和 DFT 计算解释了姜黄素对淀粉样蛋白 β 42 (Aβ42) 聚集的影响
abstract_zh: 摘要 姜黄素是一种多酚天然产物，在体外与 Aβ42（一种与阿尔茨海默氏病有关的蛋白质）结合，抑制自身聚集。对结合的分子理解对于设计抑制 Aβ42 聚集的新分子非常重要。我们通过使用蛋白质快速光化学氧化 (FPOP) 对存在和不存在姜黄素的 Aβ42 进行 OH 自由基足迹分析，然后进行质谱分析，以监测姜黄素存在下 Aβ42 蛋白质动力学的变化。结果表明，姜黄素的结合减少了 N 末端和中间区域的氧化足迹，表明这些位点的结合。百分比修饰的动力学模型显示，在姜黄素存在的情况下，Aβ42 的聚集发生了显着变化，从而导致一个聚集体几乎消失。还使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 探索了 [Aβ42:姜黄素] 结合复合物，优化了 N 端/中间和 C 端/中间区域的 B3LYP/6–31G(d) 水平的起始结构。最低能量复合物的结构在 N 末端和中间区域结合了姜黄素，这通过使用 6-311G(d,p) 重新优化和应用 Grimme 色散函数 (GD3) 进行了验证。通过使用类导体极化连续体模型 (CPCM) 在水介质中重新优化，进一步证实了这种结构。新结构不仅解释了观察到的 N 端、中间和 C 端区域的·OH 足迹变化，而且还预测了这种方法如何提供对蛋白质的深入了解。

title: Cities need robust carbon dioxide removal strategies to meet net-zero targets
source: Nature Climate Change
abstract: Leading European cities race to reach net-zero emissions, but residual emissions are tied to easier-to-abate sectors and temporary, land-intensive carbon removal for compensation. To keep climate neutrality credible and fair, policy must tighten expectations on cutting emissions and set clear rules for carbon removal and credits.
title_zh: 城市需要强有力的二氧化碳清除策略来实现净零目标
abstract_zh: 欧洲主要城市竞相实现净零排放，但残余排放与更容易减排的行业和临时的、土地密集型的碳清除挂钩以作为补偿。为了保持气候中和的可信性和公平性，政策必须收紧对减排的预期，并制定明确的碳清除和信用规则。

title: General C(sp3)–C(sp3) Cross-Coupling of Primary Amines via in Situ Diazene Formation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Primary amines are among the most abundant and readily available functional groups, yet their direct use as alkyl cross-coupling partners remains underdeveloped. We report a general platform for C(sp3)–C(sp3) cross-coupling enabled by the in situ formation and visible-light-induced denitrogenation of unsymmetric diazenes. Central to this approach is the development of N-benzoyloxysulfamides, which are readily prepared in a single step from primary amines and bench-stable O-benzoylhydroxylamines and undergo mild base-promoted conversion to diazenes. Subsequent photosensitized denitrogenation using an inexpensive organic triplet photosensitizer enables the direct union of two amine-derived fragments under operationally simple conditions. This telescoped, one-pot process avoids prefunctionalized organometallic reagents, tolerates a broad range of functional groups, and enables late-stage modification of complex molecules.
title_zh: 通过原位二氮烯形成的一般 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 伯胺交叉偶联
abstract_zh: 摘要 伯胺是最丰富且最容易获得的官能团之一，但它们作为烷基交叉偶联伙伴的直接用途仍然不发达。我们报告了一个通过不对称二氮烯的原位形成和可见光诱导脱氮实现的 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 交叉偶联的通用平台。该方法的核心是 N-苯甲酰氧基磺酰胺的开发，它很容易从伯胺和实验室稳定的 O-苯甲酰羟胺一步制备，并经过弱碱促进转化为二氮烯。随后使用廉价的有机三重态光敏剂进行光敏脱氮，使得两个胺衍生片段在操作简单的条件下直接结合。这种伸缩式一锅法避免了预官能化的有机金属试剂，能够耐受多种官能团，并且能够对复杂分子进行后期修饰。

title: Mapping hunting probability across the tropics in space and time
source: Nature Sustainability
abstract: Hunting wildlife for food and trade purposes (for example, pets, ornaments) can contribute to species extinctions, warranting informed policy and interventions to curb overexploitation. Towards such goals, the authors here estimate the spatial footprint of hunting probability across the global tropics.
title_zh: 绘制热带地区狩猎概率的空间和时间图
abstract_zh: 以食品和贸易为目的狩猎野生动物（例如宠物、装饰品）可能会导致物种灭绝，因此需要制定明智的政策和干预措施来遏制过度开发。为了实现这些目标，作者在这里估计了全球热带地区狩猎概率的空间足迹。

title: TaIAA25 negatively regulates wheat alkaline tolerance by inhibiting plasma membrane H+-ATPase activity
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Soil salinization/alkalization represents a universal challenge that severely constrains crop productivity. Elucidating the molecular mechanisms underpinning saline/alkaline tolerance of wheat (
                    Triticum aestivum
                    ) holds profound significance for global food security and sustainable agriculture. In this study, we functionally characterized a wheat alkaline sensitive locus designated
                    Wheat Alkaline Sensitive 1
                    (
                    WAS1

                    was1
                    mutant populations. This locus encodes TaIAA25, a canonical member of the Auxin/Indole-3-Acetic Acid (Aux/IAA) protein family. A C to T transition in
                    TaIAA25
                    leads to a Pro-to-Ser substitution within its Aux/IAA degron motif. This amino acid substitution enhances the stability of TaIAA25 protein, thereby rendering wheat hypersensitive to alkaline stress. The overexpression of
                    TaIAA25
                    significantly increased sensitivity of wheat to alkaline treatment, whereas
                    iaa25
                    knockout mutants displayed enhanced tolerance to alkaline stress. Consistent with established auxin signaling transduction, TaIAA25 interacts with auxin response factor 16 (TaARF16) to repress the TaARF16-mediated transcriptional activation of small auxin-up RNA gene
                    TaSAUR215
                    . This cascade potentiates the inhibitory effect of D-clade type 2C protein phosphatase (TaPP2C.D) on plasma membrane (PM) H
                    +
                    -ATPase activity. Notably, TaIAA25 also directly interacts with the phosphorylation (P) domain in central loop of PM H
                    +

Collectively, our findings clarified the crucial role of the classical auxin signaling pathway in plant responses to alkaline stress. Furthermore, we revealed a mechanism wherein an Aux/IAA protein directly modulates PM H

title: The genetic architecture of tomato flavor variation through crop domestication and improvement
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
title_zh: 通过作物驯化和改良导致番茄风味变异的遗传结构
abstract_zh:
与传家宝品种相比，在番茄作物改良过程中对产量和抗病性的广泛选择导致现代商业番茄的风味丧失。为了通过驯化和改良研究番茄风味的化学和遗传结构，我们分析了全球收集的 558 个种质中与风味相关的化学物质，其中包括野生近缘种、半驯化和驯化种群，包括未定性的拉丁美洲种质。主要风味挥发物在不同种质中表现出重大差异。全基因组关联研究用于检测基因位点与风味相关化学成分（包括糖、酸和挥发物）之间的关联。鉴定出与编码风味代谢酶的已知基因相关的多个遗传位点以及许多新位点。在新发现的基因座中，有一个编码以前未表征的脂肪酶的基因（
                    SL-LIP100
                    ）经实验证明在脂类风味挥发物的合成中具有重要作用。这种酶负责合成几种重要的五碳和六碳风味挥发物。总之，这项研究为番茄风味在驯化和随后的改良过程中的进化提供了化学和遗传学的见解，确定了水果风味化学物质遗传控制的复杂性，以及一些可用于提高风味相关化学物质含量的新等位基因。

title: Select intratumoral riboflavin-auxotrophic Enterococcus species enhance cell surface MR1 expression and MAIT TCR activation in lung cancer
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells are innate-like T cells capable of MR1-dependent immune surveillance, but how intratumoral bacteria modulate MR1 expression in human lung tumors remains unclear. We studied intratumoral MAIT cells from paired single-cell RNA and TCR sequencing datasets of tumor-infiltrating CD3 T cells isolated from non-small cell lung cancer tumors in patients receiving neoadjuvant PD-1 blockade therapy. MAIT cells were subclustered to identify conventional MAIT-associated TCR clonotypes, which were then used to examine how bacterial exposure impacts cell-surface MR1 expression and downstream MAIT TCR activation. We found that select intratumoral
                    Enterococcus
                    species (spp.) did not directly activate MAIT cells but enhanced MR1-dependent MAIT activation in the presence of exogenous 5-OP-RU by increasing cell-surface MR1 expression on antigen-presenting cells including dendritic cells, B cells, and mononuclear phagocytes. This increase in MR1 cell surface expression is modulated through a posttranscriptional mechanism consistent with altered intracellular processing and trafficking of MR1. These findings reveal a role for tumor-associated bacteria in modulating MR1-dependent innate-like T cell activation and provide a basis for future studies examining whether this process influences response to immune checkpoint blockade.
title_zh: 选择瘤内核黄素营养缺陷型肠球菌增强肺癌细胞表面 MR1 表达和 MAIT TCR 激活
abstract_zh:
粘膜相关不变 T (MAIT) 细胞是先天性 T 细胞，能够进行 MR1 依赖性免疫监视，但瘤内细菌如何调节人肺肿瘤中 MR1 的表达仍不清楚。我们研究了来自接受新辅助 PD-1 阻断治疗的患者非小细胞肺癌肿瘤中分离出的肿瘤浸润 CD3 T 细胞的配对单细胞 RNA 和 TCR 测序数据集的瘤内 MAIT 细胞。对 MAIT 细胞进行亚聚类，以识别传统的 MAIT 相关 TCR 克隆型，然后将其用于检查细菌暴露如何影响细胞表面 MR1 表达和下游 MAIT TCR 激活。我们发现选择瘤内
                    肠球菌属
                    物种 (spp.) 并不直接激活 MAIT 细胞，而是通过增加抗原呈递细胞（包括树突状细胞、B 细胞和单核吞噬细胞）上的细胞表面 MR1 表达，在外源 5-OP-RU 存在的情况下增强 MR1 依赖性 MAIT 激活。 MR1 细胞表面表达的增加是通过与 MR1 细胞内加工和运输改变一致的转录后机制来调节的。这些发现揭示了肿瘤相关细菌在调节 MR1 依赖性先天样 T 细胞激活中的作用，并为未来研究该过程是否影响对免疫检查点封锁的反应提供了基础。

title: Morphogenesis of bacterial colonies in liquid crystalline environments
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Natural bacterial habitats are often complex fluids with viscoelastic and anisotropic responses to stress; for example, they can take the form of liquid crystals (LCs), with elongated microscopic constituents that collectively align while still retaining the ability to flow. However, laboratory studies typically focus on cells in simple liquids or complex fluids with randomly oriented constituents. Here, we show how interactions with LCs shape bacterial proliferation in multicellular colonies. Using experiments, we find that in a nematic LC, cells of the multiple species we tested all form aligned single-cell-wide “chains” as they reproduce. As these chains lengthen, they eventually buckle in a highly localized manner. By combining our measurements with a continuum mechanical theory, we demonstrate that this distinctive morphogenetic program emerges because cells are kept in alignment due to the LC’s elasticity; as each chain lengthens, growth-induced viscous stresses along its contour eventually overcome the elasticity of the surrounding nematic, leading to buckling. Our work thus reveals and provides mechanistic insight into the previously overlooked role of LCs in sculpting bacterial life in complex environments.
title_zh: 液晶环境中细菌菌落的形态发生
abstract_zh: 天然细菌栖息地通常是复杂的流体，对压力具有粘弹性和各向异性反应；例如，它们可以采用液晶（LC）的形式，具有细长的微观成分，这些成分共同排列，同时仍保留流动能力。然而，实验室研究通常集中于简单液体或具有随机定向成分的复杂流体中的细胞。在这里，我们展示了与 LC 的相互作用如何影响多细胞菌落中的细菌增殖。通过实验，我们发现在向列液晶中，我们测试的多个物种的细胞在繁殖时都形成对齐的单细胞范围“链”。随着这些链条变长，它们最终会以高度局部化的方式弯曲。通过将我们的测量与连续介质力学理论相结合，我们证明了这种独特的形态发生程序的出现是因为细胞由于 LC 的弹性而保持对齐；当每条链伸长时，沿着其轮廓生长引起的粘性应力最终克服周围向列相的弹性，导致屈曲。因此，我们的工作揭示了LC在复杂环境中塑造细菌生命过程中所扮演的先前被忽视的角色，并提供了机制上的见解。

title: Expulsion of nuclear DNA to the cytoplasm after viral entry: A mechanism for activation of the cGAS pathway
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Cells respond to viral infection by induction of numerous innate and other host responses to block infection in that cell and surrounding cells. The mechanism(s) by which nuclear replicating DNA viruses and certain RNA viruses elicit responses through the cyclic guanosine monophosphate-adenosine monophosphate synthase (cGAS) cytoplasmic DNA sensor has been elusive. We report here that early events during herpes simplex virus 1 infection induce blebbing of nuclear DNA into the cytoplasm, recruitment of cGAS colocalization with the cytoplasmic DNA, activation of interferon regulatory factor 3, and induction of type 1 human interferon in normal human fibroblasts and keratinocytes. With HSV-1, this is dependent on viral binding and fusion with the surface membrane but independent of transport of the input viral DNA to the nucleus. Infections by herpes simplex virus 2, human cytomegalovirus, or human parainfluenza virus 3 also induce nuclear DNA blebbing, consistent with entry by surface fusion inducing this effect. Extrusion of nuclear DNA through nuclear envelope breaks upon viral entry by fusion represents a mechanism for cells to respond to the physical and/or molecular changes in the infected cell during infection.
title_zh: 病毒进入后将核DNA排出到细胞质：cGAS途径激活的机制
abstract_zh: 细胞通过诱导许多先天和其他宿主反应来阻止该细胞和周围细胞的感染，从而对病毒感染做出反应。核复制 DNA 病毒和某些 RNA 病毒通过环单磷酸鸟苷-单磷酸腺苷合酶 (cGAS) 细胞质 DNA 传感器引起反应的机制尚不清楚。我们在此报告，单纯疱疹病毒 1 感染期间的早期事件诱导核 DNA 起泡进入细胞质，招募与细胞质 DNA 共定位的 cGAS，激活干扰素调节因子 3，并在正常人成纤维细胞和角质形成细胞中诱导 1 型人干扰素。对于 HSV-1，这取决于病毒与表面膜的结合和融合，但与输入的病毒 DNA 向细胞核的转运无关。单纯疱疹病毒 2、人类巨细胞病毒或人类副流感病毒 3 的感染也会诱导核 DNA 起泡，这与诱导这种效应的表面融合进入一致。当病毒通过融合进入时，核DNA通过核膜破裂而挤出，代表了细胞在感染期间对受感染细胞的物理和/或分子变化做出反应的机制。

title: A nose-to-brain circuit underlies anxiety regulation by nasal afferent frequency in mice
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Slow nasal breathing alleviates negative moods, but the precise nose-to-limbic pathways and their causal contributions remain unclear. Here, we identify a pathway in mice from olfactory sensory neurons (OSNs) in the nasal cavity to mitral cells in the olfactory bulb (OB), then to parvalbumin-positive (PV
                    +
                    ) long-projecting interneurons in the perirhinal cortex (PRC), and subsequently to glutamatergic neurons in the posterior basolateral amygdala (pBLA), through which nasal afferent activity bidirectionally regulates anxiety in a frequency-dependent manner. Low-frequency nasal airflow or optogenetic OSN stimulation induced anxiolysis and increased PRC high-gamma power by activating PV
                    +
                    neurons, whereas high-frequency had opposite effects. Chemogenetic silencing of the OB
                    →
                    PRC
                    PV
                    pathway eliminated the frequency-dependent regulation of anxiety-like behaviors driven by OSN stimulation. Selective activation or inhibition of the identified circuit generated opposing behavioral effects (anxiolytic vs. anxiogenic, respectively), paralleling the results of low- and high-frequency OSN stimulations. Strikingly, a 2-wk low-frequency nasal airflow/optogenetic OSN stimulation regimen ameliorated anxiety-like behaviors and restored PRC high-gamma activity in an anxiety model. This study reveals a nose–brain axis bidirectionally modulating anxiety via nasal afferent frequency, providing potential interventional strategies and targets for anxiety disorders.
title_zh: 鼻子到大脑的回路是通过鼻传入频率调节小鼠焦虑的基础

title: Structural rearrangements underlying the activation of STIM1 by ER calcium depletion
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
In resting cells, STIM1, the dimeric endoplasmic reticulum (ER) Ca
                    2+
                    sensor that controls store-operated Ca
                    2+
                    entry (SOCE), is held in a Ca
                    2+
                    -bound inactive state by multiple intramolecular restraints, or brakes. Receptor-evoked release of Ca
                    2+
                    from the ER causes a large conformational change in STIM1 that releases the brakes and exposes the CRAC activation domain (CAD), enabling it to bind and open store-operated Orai1 channels in the plasma membrane. We performed single-molecule Förster resonance energy transfer (smFRET) measurements with purified STIM1 to better understand how Ca
                    2+
                    release from the luminal domain of STIM1 drives the conformational changes in the cytosolic domain that underlie CAD release. We find that Ca
                    2+
                    removal releases the CAD from CC1α1 (the “CC1 clamp”) without obligatory formation of the CC1 coiled-coil that has been associated with CAD release in cells. Surprisingly, the CAD rearranges dramatically during release, as the two hairpin protomers that create its characteristic V-shaped structure are spread apart. Locking the two protomers together by cysteine crosslinking prevents CAD release, suggesting that the CAD must rearrange to escape the CC1 clamp. Our data support a model in which ER depletion-induced dimerization of the luminal SAM domains drives the cytosolic domain into multiple intermediate states including a 3-helix bundle of CC1α1/2/3, releasing the CC1 clamp and allowing the CAD to escape through a “fold-out” mechanism. Subsequent formation of the CC1 coiled-coil enables the CAD to revert to its original shape and extends it toward the plasma membrane to activate Orai1.
